\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.20}
\begin{cor}[{Cauchy for null-homotopic closed paths}]\label{thm:null-homotopic-line-int}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{null-homotopic-line-int}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, m, c, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{null\text{-}homotopic}(u, m, a, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b) = 0 \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-convex-closed}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, m, c, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = m(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b) = 0 \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-disc}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, m, d, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = m(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, d, a, b) = 0 \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-convex-sub}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, v, m, c, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(v) \wedge \\ \quad v \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq v \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = m(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, m, c, a, b) = 0 \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.21}
\begin{prop}[{Holomorphic primitive on a simply connected set}]\label{thm:sc-primitive}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{sc-primitive}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall o \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{simply\text{-}connected}(u) \wedge \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g, z, f(z))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-convex-primitive}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall o \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g, z, f(z))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.22}
\begin{prop}[{Logarithm of a nonvanishing holomorphic function}]\label{thm:holomorphic-log-sc-exists}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-log-sc-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{simply\text{-}connected}(u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (\exp g(z) = f(z))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-log-sc}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{simply\text{-}connected}(u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (\exp g(z) = f(z))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall g, h.; \forall a \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\exp g(z) = f(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\exp h(z) = f(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \forall z \in u.\; (g(z) = (h(z) + (n \cdot ((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-log-convex}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (\exp g(z) = f(z))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall g, h.; \forall a \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\exp g(z) = f(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\exp h(z) = f(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \forall z \in u.\; (g(z) = (h(z) + (n \cdot ((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-log-convex-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (\exp g(z) = f(z))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.24}
\begin{cor}[{Existence and uniqueness of the principal branch of log}]\label{thm:principal-log-exists-unique}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{principal-log-exists-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \exists g. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}, g) \wedge \\ \quad g(1) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}. \\ \quad \quad \exp g(z) = z \wedge \\ \forall g.; \forall z \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}, g) \wedge \\ \quad g(1) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}. \\ \quad \quad \exp g(z) = z \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g(z) = \log\left(z\right) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-log-unique-branch}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g.; \forall z \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}, g) \wedge \\ \quad g(1) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}. \\ \quad \quad \exp g(z) = z \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g(z) = \log\left(z\right) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-log-holomorphic}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}, \\ \quad (\lambda w \in \{u \in \mathbb{C} : \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(u) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(u) \leq 0))\}.\; \log\left(w\right))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-log-spec}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(w) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}(w) \leq 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \log\left(w\right) \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \quad -\pi < \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(\log\left(w\right)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(\log\left(w\right)) < \pi \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exp \log\left(w\right) = w \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-log-one}}
\vnbstmt{\log\left(1\right) = 0}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-log-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad -\pi < \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(a) < \pi \wedge \\ \quad -\pi < \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(b) < \pi \wedge \\ \quad \exp a = \exp b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.25}
\begin{cor}[{n-th roots of a nonvanishing holomorphic function}]\label{thm:holomorphic-root-sc-exists}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-root-sc-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{simply\text{-}connected}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{power}(g(z), n) = f(z))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-root-sc-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, n, g, h.; \forall b \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{simply\text{-}connected}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{power}(g(z), n) = f(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{power}(h(z), n) = f(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{power}(a, n) = 1) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (h(z) = (a \cdot g(z)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-root-convex-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge (\forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (1 \leq n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{power}(g(z), n) = f(z))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-root-convex-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, n, g, h.; \forall b \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}cc}(u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{power}(g(z), n) = f(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{power}(h(z), n) = f(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((\operatorname{power}(a, n) = 1) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (h(z) = (a \cdot g(z)))) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.27}
\begin{prop}[{The winding number is an integer, constant on components}]\label{thm:winding-number-integer}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{winding-number-integer}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, a, b.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge ((m(b) = m(a)) \wedge \neg (z \in \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (\operatorname{winding}(m, c, a, b, z) = k) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{winding-constant-on-connected}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, a, b, \mathit{wca}.; \forall p, q \in \mathit{wca}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = m(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \mathit{wca}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{wca}.\; \neg (x \in \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{winding}(m, c, a, b, p) = \operatorname{winding}(m, c, a, b, q) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{winding-locally-constant}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, c, a, b.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge ((m(b) = m(a)) \wedge \neg (z \in \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{wcz} \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (\mathit{wcz} \in \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b)) \wedge (\operatorname{winding}(m, c, a, b, \mathit{wcz}) = \operatorname{winding}(m, c, a, b, z)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{winding-number-integer}}}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.28}
\begin{prop}[{Integral of a finite principal part}]\label{thm:principal-part-integral}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{principal-part-integral}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall \mathit{ppa}, c, m, d, a, b.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \mathit{ppa} \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)) \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = m(a) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{ppa}((j + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (j + 1)))), n)), m, d, a, b) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{ppa}(1) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(m, d, a, b, c) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{principal-part-integral-step}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{ppa}, c, d, f, a, b. \\ \quad \mathit{ppa} \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(d, f, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(d, a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)) \wedge \\ \quad d(b) = d(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{ppa}((j + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (j + 1)))), (m + 1)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{ppa}((j + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (j + 1)))), (m + 1))), \\ \quad \quad \quad d, f, a, b) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{ppa}(1) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda v \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((v - c)), 1)), d, f, a, b) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.30}
\begin{cor}[{Winding number vanishes on the unbounded component}]\label{thm:winding-zero-unbounded}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{winding-zero-unbounded}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, d, a, b.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, \mathit{wca}.; \forall u, p \in \mathit{wca}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = m(a) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \mathit{wca}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{wca}.\; \neg (x \in \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (u \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{winding}(m, d, a, b, p) = 0 \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{winding-zero-outside-disc}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, d, a, b.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad m(b) = m(a) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{winding}(m, d, a, b, z) = 0 \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.31}
\begin{cor}[{Homotopy invariance of the winding number}]\label{thm:homotopy-winding}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall z, m, c, o, d, a, b. \\ \quad z \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, c, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(o, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{homotopic}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(z)), m, o, a, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{winding}(m, c, a, b, z) = \operatorname{winding}(o, d, a, b, z) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.32}
\begin{prop}[{Winding number of a positively oriented triangle}]\label{thm:triangle-winding-interior}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{triangle-winding-interior}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c.; \forall u \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c)). \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{positively\text{-}oriented}(a, b, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{winding}(\operatorname{tri\text{-}road}(a, b, c), \operatorname{tri\text{-}road\text{-}deriv}(a, b, c), 0, 3, u) = 1 \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{triangle-tri-int-interior}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c.; \forall u \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c)). \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{positively\text{-}oriented}(a, b, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(u)).\; \operatorname{recip}((w - u))), a, b, c) = ((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{triangle-winding-exterior}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c.; \forall u \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{positively\text{-}oriented}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \exists v.\; (v \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c))) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (u \in \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{winding}(\operatorname{tri\text{-}road}(a, b, c), \operatorname{tri\text{-}road\text{-}deriv}(a, b, c), 0, 3, u) = 0 \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.33}
\begin{lem}[{A Cauchy-type integral is analytic off the trace}]\label{thm:analytic-from-integral-formula}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{analytic-from-integral-formula}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, r, i, m, d, a, b.; \forall p \in \mathbb{C}, f.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; (r \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((x - c))) \wedge \\ \quad i \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), i, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad f(z) = (p \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (i(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - z)))), m, d, a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (i(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), m, d, a, b)) \cdot \operatorname{power}((z - c), k)), \\ \quad \quad \quad f(z)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{analytic-at-from-integral-formula}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, r, i, m, d, a, b.; \forall p \in \mathbb{C}, \mathit{aiou}.; \forall f \in (\mathit{aiou} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; (r \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((x - c))) \wedge \\ \quad i \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), i, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \mathit{aiou}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq \mathit{aiou} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad f(z) = (p \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (i(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - z)))), m, d, a, b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f \text{ is analytic at } c \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-kernel-integral-series}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, r, i, m, d, a, b.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; (r \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((x - c))) \wedge \\ \quad i \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), i, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (i(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), m, d, a, b) \cdot \operatorname{power}((z - c), k)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (i(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - z)))), m, d, a, b)) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.35}
\begin{thm}[{Holomorphic implies analytic}]\label{thm:holomorphic-analytic-at}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-analytic-at}}
\vnbstmt{\forall u, f.; \forall c \in u.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow f \text{ is analytic at } c)}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-power-series-disc}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, s, r \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, s) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)))(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi))) \cdot \operatorname{power}((z - c), k)), \\ \quad \quad \quad f(z)) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.39}
\begin{cor}[{Removable singularities}]\label{thm:removable-singularity}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{removable-singularity}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad c \in u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(c)), f) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; (g(z) = f(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{removable-extension-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, g, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad c \in u \wedge \\ \quad g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad k \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), k, c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; (g(z) = k(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g(c) = k(c) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.40}
\begin{prop}[{Derivative of a Cauchy-type integral}]\label{thm:cauchy-type-integral-deriv}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, r, i, m, d, a, b.; \forall p \in \mathbb{C}, \mathit{aiou}.; \forall f \in (\mathit{aiou} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; (r \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((x - c))) \wedge \\ \quad i \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), i, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \mathit{aiou}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq \mathit{aiou} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad f(z) = (p \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (i(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - z)))), m, d, a, b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \mathit{aiou}, f, c, \\ \quad \quad \quad p \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (i(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), 2))), m, d, a, b)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.41}
\begin{prop}[{Cauchy integral formula over a triangle}]\label{thm:triangle-cauchy-formula}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, f.; \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}, u \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c)). \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(n, f) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{positively\text{-}oriented}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \subseteq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(u) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(n, \operatorname{singleton}(u)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - u)))), a, b, c) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.42}
\begin{cor}[{Cauchy formula for the derivative over a triangle}]\label{thm:triangle-cauchy-deriv}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, f.; \forall a, b, c \in \mathbb{C}, u \in \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c)). \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(n, f) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (a = b) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = c) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c = a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{positively\text{-}oriented}(a, b, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \subseteq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, n, f, u) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{tri\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in \operatorname{difference}(n, \operatorname{singleton}(u)).\; (f(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - u)), 2))), a, b, c) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.43}
\begin{prop}[{Morera's theorem}]\label{thm:morera}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{morera}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b, c \in u. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, a, b, c) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{morera-conditional}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall v, g, d. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(v, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad d \in (v \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in v.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, v, g, z, d(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(v, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b, c \in u. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{conv3}(a, b, c) \subseteq u) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{tri\text{-}int}(f, a, b, c) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.44}
\begin{prop}[{Weierstrass: uniform limits on compacta of holomorphic functions are holomorphic}]\label{thm:holomorphic-limit-on-compacta}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-limit-on-compacta}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, m(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, m, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-limit-derivatives}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, m(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, m, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{wcvk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, m(\mathit{wcvk}), w))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{unif-on-compacta-locally}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m, f.; \forall z \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, m, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((m(k)(y) - f(y))) \leq s) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{locally-uniform-on-compacta}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, g, l. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u. \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, z, r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((g(k)(y) - l(y))) \leq s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, g, l) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-closed-ball-compact}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), p_{0}, d \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, y) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}line}(p_{0}, d)), \operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}line}(p_{0}, d)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \end{array}}

\begin{prop}[{Coefficient bound by the maximum on a circle}]\label{thm:power-series-coefficient-bound}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall q, a, r, m.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}(q) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((y - a)) = r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda \mathit{cpsk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (q(\mathit{cpsk}) \cdot \operatorname{power}((y - a), \mathit{cpsk}))))) \leq m \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(q(k)) \leq (m \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(r), k)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.48}
\begin{cor}[{Cauchy's estimates}]\label{thm:cauchy-estimates}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-estimates}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, m \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f^{(k)}(c)) \leq (\operatorname{factorial}(k) \cdot (m \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(r), k))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-estimate-derivative}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, s, r, o, d \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < s \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, s) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < s \wedge \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad o < r \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(y)) \leq d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{restrict}(f, \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, o))^{(k)}(c)) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{factorial}(k) \cdot (d \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(r), k)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{rr-le-of-power-bounds}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, v, a, o, i \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 \leq v) \wedge ((0 < o) \wedge ((o < i) \wedge \forall r \in \mathbb{R}.\; (((o < r) \wedge (r < i)) \Rightarrow ((v \cdot \operatorname{power}(r, k)) \leq a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (v \cdot \operatorname{power}(i, k)) \leq a \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-nth-deriv}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f^{(k)}) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.50}
\begin{cor}[{Every nonconstant polynomial has a zero}]\label{thm:fundamental-theorem-of-algebra}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{fundamental-theorem-of-algebra}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \neg (p((m + 1)) = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p(k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))), ((m + 1) + 1)) = 0 \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-algebraically-closed}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad ((1 \leq n) \wedge \neg (p(n) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p(k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))), (n + 1)) = 0 \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.51}
\begin{prop}[{Complete factorization of a complex polynomial}]\label{thm:cc-poly-factorization}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-poly-factorization}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad (\forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((n + 1) \leq k) \Rightarrow (c(k) = 0)) \wedge \neg (c(n) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), (n + 1)) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; c(n) \cdot \operatorname{cc\text{-}partial\text{-}prod}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (z - a(i))), n) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-partial-prod-congr}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g, h. \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < n) \Rightarrow (g(i) = h(i))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{cc\text{-}partial\text{-}prod}(g, n) \simeq \operatorname{cc\text{-}partial\text{-}prod}(h, n)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-partial-prod-in-cc}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g. \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(i) \in \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{cc\text{-}partial\text{-}prod}(g, n) \in \mathbb{C}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-ps-divide}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), a \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((n + 1) \leq k) \Rightarrow (c(k) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n \leq k) \Rightarrow (d(k) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c((k + 1)) = (d(k) - (a \cdot d((k + 1))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad c(0) = (\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(a, j))), (n + 1)) - (a \cdot d(0))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), (n + 1)) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(a, j))), (n + 1)) + ((z - a) \cdot \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (d(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), n)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} PROVEN 2026-10-26: sum\_\{j$<$=n\} c(j) z\textasciicircum{}j = c(n) prod\_\{i$<$n\} (z - a(i)) when c(n) /= 0 (the notes' monic case is c(n) = 1). The product is CC-PARTIAL-PROD. The induction uses the FTA and POLY-2's division by z - a.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.53}
\begin{prop}[{Entire functions of polynomial growth are polynomials}]\label{thm:entire-polynomial-growth}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, f.; \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, f) \wedge \forall z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq ((a \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{magnitude}(z), m)) + b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad f(z) = \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), (m + 1)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.55}
\begin{prop}[{Maximum modulus principle}]\label{thm:mvp-maximum-modulus}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{mvp-maximum-modulus}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a, z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}mean\text{-}value\text{-}property}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(f(a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = f(a) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{mvp-disc-max-constant}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r). \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}mean\text{-}value\text{-}property}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(f(c))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = f(c) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{mvp-circle-max-constant}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, \mathit{cmvbr} \in \mathbb{R}, t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, (2 \cdot \pi)). \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}mean\text{-}value\text{-}property}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < \mathit{cmvbr} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, \mathit{cmvbr}) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(y)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(f(c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f((c + (r \cdot \exp (+i \cdot t)))) = f(c) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{connected-clopen}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b.; \forall p \in b, q \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq a \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in b. \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \forall y \in a.\; ((y \in \operatorname{ball}(s, x, r)) \Rightarrow (y \in b)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a. \\ \quad \quad \neg (x \in b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \forall y \in a.\; ((y \in \operatorname{ball}(s, x, r)) \Rightarrow \neg (y \in b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad q \in b \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-maximum-modulus}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a, z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(f(a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = f(a) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-has-mean-value-property}}
\vnbstmt{\forall u, f.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{has\text{-}mean\text{-}value\text{-}property}(u, f))}
\vnbpart{\texttt{maximum-modulus-connected}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a, z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(f(a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = f(a) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{maximum-modulus-disc}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r). \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(f(c))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = f(c) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ball-zeros-accumulate}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, g.; \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge ((\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r) \subseteq u) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r).\; (g(z) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zeros\text{-}accumulate\text{-}at}(u, g, a) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.56}
\begin{cor}[{Maximum on the boundary of a bounded domain}]\label{thm:mvp-maximum-modulus-closure}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{mvp-maximum-modulus-closure}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall d, m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq d) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, x) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}mean\text{-}value\text{-}property}(u, \operatorname{restrict}(f, u)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u), \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u)). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq m \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall w \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(w)) \leq m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall w \in u, z \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(w)) = m) \Rightarrow (f(z) = f(w)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{bounded-open-boundary-nonempty}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in u, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq d)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b.\; (b \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u), \operatorname{interior}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-closed-bounded-max}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, g.; \forall b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad k \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \forall r.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow \exists y \in k.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}((y - x)) < r)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad x \in k \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in k.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq b) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (k \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in k, s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(d) \wedge \forall y \in k.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((x - y)) \leq d) \Rightarrow (\lvert (g(x) - g(y)) \rvert \leq s))) \wedge \\ \quad \exists c.\; (c \in k) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in k.\; \forall z \in k.\; (g(z) \leq g(a)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{continuous-constant-on-closure}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, c.; \forall x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u). \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), f, x) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (f(z) = c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(x) = c \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.57}
\begin{prop}[{Schwarz's lemma}]\label{thm:schwarz-lemma}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{schwarz-lemma}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1), f) \wedge \\ \quad f(0) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) < 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(z)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (\neg (a = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(a)) = \operatorname{magnitude}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(r) = 1) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (f(z) = (r \cdot z)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{schwarz-quotient}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1), f) \wedge \\ \quad f(0) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) < 1) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists q. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1), q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (f(w) = (q(w) \cdot w)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(q(w)) \leq 1) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-compact-modulus-max}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), k.; \forall a \in k. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, y) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in k.\; \forall z \in k.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(g(z)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(g(p))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-removable-point}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), a \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(a)), \operatorname{restrict}(g, \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(a)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\begin{prop}[{Gamma is holomorphic in the right half plane}]\label{thm:gamma-holomorphic}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.60}
\begin{prop}[{Analytic continuation of Gamma}]\label{thm:gamma-analytic-continuation}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\}, \\ \quad (\lambda w \in \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\}.\; \operatorname{gamma\text{-}ext}(w))) \wedge \\ \forall \mathit{gxz} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(\mathit{gxz})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gamma\text{-}ext}(\mathit{gxz}) = \Gamma(\mathit{gxz})) \wedge \\ \forall \mathit{gxz} \in \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\}. \\ \quad (\mathit{gxz} + 1) \in \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{gamma\text{-}ext}((\mathit{gxz} + 1)) = (\mathit{gxz} \cdot \operatorname{gamma\text{-}ext}(\mathit{gxz})) \wedge \\ \forall g.; \forall \mathit{gxz} \in \{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\}. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\{z \in \mathbb{C} : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg ((z + n) = 0)\}, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{gyz} \in \mathbb{C}.\; ((0 < \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(\mathit{gyz})) \Rightarrow (g(\mathit{gyz}) = \Gamma(\mathit{gyz}))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g(\mathit{gxz}) = \operatorname{gamma\text{-}ext}(\mathit{gxz}) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.3}
\begin{prop}[{Riemann's removable singularity criterion}]\label{thm:riemann-removable-singularity}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{riemann-removable-singularity}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in u, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(a)), f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}removable\text{-}singularity}(f, a) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{R}. \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(a)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - a)) < r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq m) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-continuous-at-of-modulus}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), y \in u. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \forall b \in u.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((b - y)) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((g(b) - g(y))) \leq s))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, y) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{riemann-removable}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad c \in u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(c)), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, y) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(c)).\; (g(z) = f(z)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{R}. \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(c)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(z)) \leq m) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.4}
\begin{lem}[{Cauchy-type integral: power series inside, series in 1/(u - xi) outside}]\label{thm:cauchy-kernel-integral-series}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-kernel-integral-series}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, r, i, m, d, a, b.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; (r \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((x - c))) \wedge \\ \quad i \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), i, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (i(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), m, d, a, b) \cdot \operatorname{power}((z - c), k)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (i(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - z)))), m, d, a, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{outer-kernel-integral-series}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, r, i, m, d, a, b.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq r \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}((x - c)) \leq r) \wedge \\ \quad i \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), i, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad r < \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (i(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}((w - c), k))), m, d, a, b) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((z - c)), (k + 1))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (i(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - w)))), m, d, a, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{analytic-from-integral-formula}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, r, i, m, d, a, b.; \forall p \in \mathbb{C}, f.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; (r \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((x - c))) \wedge \\ \quad i \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), i, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad f(z) = (p \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (i(w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((w - z)))), m, d, a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges\text{-}to}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (i(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), m, d, a, b)) \cdot \operatorname{power}((z - c), k)), \\ \quad \quad \quad f(z)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cauchy-kernel-series-absolute}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, c, r, i, m, d, a, b.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; (r \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((x - c))) \wedge \\ \quad i \in (u \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), i, y) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(m, d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(m, a, b) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda w \in u.\; (i(w) \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}((w - c)), (k + 1)))), m, d, a, b) \cdot \operatorname{power}((z - c), k))))) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.5}
\begin{prop}[{Laurent expansion of a function holomorphic on an annulus}]\label{thm:laurent-expansion}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{laurent-expansion}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, a, b, o \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < a \wedge \\ \quad a < o \wedge \\ \quad o < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{lxb} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad ((a \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((\mathit{lxb} - c))) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((\mathit{lxb} - c)) \leq b)) \Rightarrow (\mathit{lxb} \in u) \wedge \\ \quad a < \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) < b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}sum}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o), c, z) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{laurent-expansion-annulus}}

\vnbpart{\texttt{annulus-cauchy}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < a \wedge \\ \quad a < b \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad ((a \leq \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c))) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - c)) \leq b)) \Rightarrow (z \in u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, a), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, a), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, b), \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, b), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \end{array}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.6}
\begin{cor}[{Holomorphic on a punctured disc iff Laurent expansion}]\label{thm:laurent-punctured-iff}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{laurent-punctured-iff}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad ((0 < r) \wedge (f \in (\operatorname{annulus}(a, 0, r) \to \mathbb{C}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{annulus}(a, 0, r), f) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists c \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((p < r) \Rightarrow (p < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; c(k))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (0 < m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{recip}(m) < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; c(-(k + 1))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{annulus}(a, 0, r).\; (f(x) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}sum}(c, a, x)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{laurent-punctured-expansion}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, r, o \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad o < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{annulus}(a, 0, r), f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{magnitude}((z - a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((z - a)) < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f(z) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}sum}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, a, o), a, z) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{laurent-punctured-holomorphic}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{C}), a \in \mathbb{C}, r \in \mathbb{R}, f \in (\operatorname{annulus}(a, 0, r) \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{annulus}(a, 0, r).\; (f(x) = \operatorname{laurent\text{-}sum}(c, a, x)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((p < r) \Rightarrow (p < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; c(k))))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 < m) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{recip}(m) < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; c(-(k + 1))))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{annulus}(a, 0, r), f) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{laurent-coefs-radii}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, o \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad o < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in \mathbb{C}.\; (((0 < \operatorname{magnitude}((b - c))) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((b - c)) < r)) \Rightarrow (b \in u)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \forall p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (p < r) \Rightarrow (p < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(k)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (0 < m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(m) < \operatorname{cps\text{-}radius}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(-(k + 1)))) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.11}
\begin{prop}[{Poles of a meromorphic function are locally finite}]\label{thm:meromorphic-poles-finite-in-compact}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s, f, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, s), f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e \in s.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, e) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad |(s \cap k)| \in \mathbb{N} \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.12}
\begin{prop}[{Meromorphic functions form a field}]\label{thm:meromorphic-on-sum}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{meromorphic-on-sum}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a, f, b, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, a), f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}removable\text{-}singularity}(f, x) \vee \exists n.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, x, n) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, b), g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}removable\text{-}singularity}(g, x) \vee \exists n.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(g, x, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{meromorphic\text{-}on}(u, (\lambda z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, (a \cup b)).\; (f(z) + g(z)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{meromorphic-on-product}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a, f, b, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, a), f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}removable\text{-}singularity}(f, x) \vee \exists n.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, x, n) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, b), g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}removable\text{-}singularity}(g, x) \vee \exists n.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(g, x, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{meromorphic\text{-}on}(u, (\lambda z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, (a \cup b)).\; (f(z) \cdot g(z)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{meromorphic-at-sum}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, s, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(g, a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad ((0 < r) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), \operatorname{singleton}(a)).\; (s(z) = (f(z) + g(z)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(s, a) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{meromorphic-at-product}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, g, s, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(g, a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad ((0 < r) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), \operatorname{singleton}(a)).\; (s(z) = (f(z) \cdot g(z)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(s, a) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{meromorphic-at-recip}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 < r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), \operatorname{singleton}(a)).\; \neg (f(z) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < p \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, p), \operatorname{singleton}(a)).\; \neg (f(z) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, p), \operatorname{singleton}(a)).\; (s(z) = \operatorname{recip}(f(z))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(s, a) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-is-meromorphic-at}}
\vnbstmt{\forall u, f.; \forall a \in u.\; (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, a))}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} Closure of M(U) under the pointwise sum and product. The functions are given with their singular sets A and B, and the sum is read on U \textbackslash{} (A u B). At a point, the sum, the product, and the reciprocal of a function not identically zero near the point (Example 4.8) are meromorphic. M(U) as a quotient and the global reciprocal are not formed.
