\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.13}
\begin{thm}[{Casorati-Weierstrass}]\label{thm:casorati-weierstrass}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{casorati-weierstrass}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in u, f.; \forall r \in \mathbb{R}, v \in \mathbb{C}, e \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(a)), f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}essential\text{-}singularity}(f, a) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad 0 < e \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, \operatorname{singleton}(a)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((z - a)) < r) \wedge (\operatorname{magnitude}((f(z) - v)) < e) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{meromorphic-point-cases}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}removable\text{-}singularity}(f, a) \vee \exists n.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, a, n) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.15}
\begin{prop}[{Residue theorem}]\label{thm:residue-theorem}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{residue-theorem}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall e \in \mathbf{Set}, f, p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad |e| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad e \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, e), f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mqe} \in e.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, \mathit{mqe}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(u, e) \wedge \\ \quad p(t) = p(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{null\text{-}homotopic}(u, p, s, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, p, q, s, t) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{residue}(f, x) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, s, t, x))), \\ \quad \quad \quad e) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{residue-theorem-step}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s.; \forall b \in u, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, (s \cup \{b\})), f) \wedge \\ \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{C}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, b, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mqf}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(b)), \mathit{mqf}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall p, q, \mathit{mds}, t. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) \wedge ((\operatorname{trace}(p, \mathit{mds}, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(b))) \wedge (p(t) = p(\mathit{mds})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(\mathit{mqf}, p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, b, r), \operatorname{singleton}(b)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad f(z) = (h(z) + ((d \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - b))) + \operatorname{mqf}(z))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e \in s. \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{C}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, e, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mqf}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(e)), \mathit{mqf}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall p, q, \mathit{mds}, t. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) \wedge ((\operatorname{trace}(p, \mathit{mds}, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(e))) \wedge (p(t) = p(\mathit{mds})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(\mathit{mqf}, p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, e, r), \operatorname{singleton}(e)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad f(z) = (h(z) + ((d \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - e))) + \operatorname{mqf}(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, s), g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall e \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{C}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, e, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mqf}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(e)), \mathit{mqf}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall p, q, \mathit{mds}, t. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) \wedge ((\operatorname{trace}(p, \mathit{mds}, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(e))) \wedge (p(t) = p(\mathit{mds})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(\mathit{mqf}, p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, e, r), \operatorname{singleton}(e)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad g(z) = (h(z) + ((d \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - e))) + \operatorname{mqf}(z))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{residue}(g, e) = \operatorname{residue}(f, e) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p, q, \mathit{mds}, t. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{trace}(p, \mathit{mds}, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(u, (s \cup \{b\})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad p(t) = p(\mathit{mds}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(g, p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) + ((((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i) \cdot \operatorname{residue}(f, b)) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, \mathit{mds}, t, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{meromorphic-residue-decomposition}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}meromorphic\text{-}at}(f, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{residue}(f, a) \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mdf}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a)), \mathit{mdf}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge ((\operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(a))) \wedge (p(t) = p(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(\mathit{mdf}, p, q, s, t) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), \operatorname{singleton}(a)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad f(z) = (h(z) + ((\operatorname{residue}(f, a) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - a))) + \operatorname{mdf}(z))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{residue-theorem-induction}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, e \in \mathbf{Set}, f, p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad |e| = n \wedge \\ \quad e \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, e), f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{mqe} \in e. \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \mathbb{C}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \mathit{mqe}, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mqf}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(\mathit{mqe})), \mathit{mqf}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge ((\operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(\mathbb{C}, \operatorname{singleton}(\mathit{mqe}))) \wedge (p(t) = p(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(\mathit{mqf}, p, q, s, t) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \mathit{mqe}, r), \operatorname{singleton}(\mathit{mqe})). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad f(z) = (h(z) + ((d \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - \mathit{mqe}))) + \operatorname{mqf}(z))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(u, e) \wedge \\ \quad p(t) = p(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{null\text{-}homotopic}(u, p, s, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}(f, p, q, s, t) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{residue}(f, x) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, s, t, x))), \\ \quad \quad \quad e) \end{array}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.17}
\begin{prop}[{Residue of the logarithmic derivative}]\label{thm:log-derivative-residue-at-zero}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{log-derivative-residue-at-zero}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall c \in u, f, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge (\operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, c, m) \wedge (1 \leq m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}((\lambda w \in u.\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(w)))), c, 1) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{residue}((\lambda w \in u.\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(w)))), c) = m \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{log-derivative-residue-at-pole}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, c, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, c, n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}((\lambda w \in u.\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(w)))), c, 1) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{residue}((\lambda w \in u.\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(w)))), c) = -n \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{log-derivative-at-zero}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n_{15} \in \mathbb{N}, u.; \forall c \in u, f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, c, n_{15})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r_{15} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < r_{15} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r_{15}) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists h_{15} \in (\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r_{15}) \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r_{15}), h_{15}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z_{15} \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r_{15}), \operatorname{singleton}(c)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (f(z_{15}) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, z_{15}) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(z_{15}))) = (\operatorname{h15}(z_{15}) + (n_{15} \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z_{15} - c)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{log-derivative-at-pole}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, c, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, c, n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r), \operatorname{singleton}(c)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r), \operatorname{singleton}(c)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\neg (f(z) = 0) \wedge ((\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, z) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(z))) = (h(z) + (-n \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - c)))))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{simple-pole-of-decomposition}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, c, r, d, h. \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \neg (d = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r), h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r), \operatorname{singleton}(c)). \\ \quad \quad f(z) = (h(z) + (d \cdot \operatorname{recip}((z - c)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, c, 1) \wedge (\operatorname{residue}(f, c) = d) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} f'/f is the function z |-$>$ f'(z)/f(z) on the open set where f is holomorphic. The point is a zero of order m $>$= 1 (HAS-ZERO-OF-ORDER) or a pole of order N (IS-POLE).

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.19}
\begin{prop}[{Argument principle}]\label{thm:argument-principle}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{argument-principle}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}, f.; \forall \mathit{mzs} \in \mathbf{Set}, p, q, \mathit{mds}, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, s), f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s.\; \exists n.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, x, n) \wedge \\ \quad |\mathit{mzs}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{difference}(u, s).\; ((f(x) = 0) \Rightarrow (x \in \mathit{mzs})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{mzs}.\; (f(x) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{mzs}.\; \exists m.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(\operatorname{difference}(u, s), f, x, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(p, \mathit{mds}, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(u, (\mathit{mzs} \cup s)) \wedge \\ \quad p(t) = p(\mathit{mds}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{null\text{-}homotopic}(u, p, \mathit{mds}, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda z \in \operatorname{difference}(u, (\mathit{mzs} \cup s)).\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{difference}(u, s), f, z) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(z)))), p, q, \mathit{mds}, t) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda \mathit{mqx} \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{zero\text{-}order}(\operatorname{difference}(u, s), f, \mathit{mqx}) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, \mathit{mds}, t, \mathit{mqx}))), \mathit{mzs}) + \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda \mathit{mqx} \in \mathbb{C}.\; (-\operatorname{pole\text{-}order}(f, \mathit{mqx}) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, \mathit{mds}, t, \mathit{mqx}))), s) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{argument-principle-holomorphic}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall e \in \mathbf{Set}, f, p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad |e| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad e \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x_{16} \in u.\; ((f(x_{16}) = 0) \Rightarrow (x_{16} \in e)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x_{16} \in e.\; (f(x_{16}) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x_{16} \in e.\; \exists m_{16}.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, x_{16}, m_{16}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(u, e) \wedge \\ \quad p(t) = p(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{null\text{-}homotopic}(u, p, s, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda z_{16} \in \operatorname{difference}(u, e).\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, z_{16}) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(z_{16})))), p, q, s, t) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{zero\text{-}order}(u, f, x) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, s, t, x))), \\ \quad \quad \quad e) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.20}
\begin{prop}[{Rouche's theorem}]\label{thm:rouche-theorem}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall \mathit{mpf} \in \mathbf{Set}, f.; \forall \mathit{mzf}, \mathit{mpg} \in \mathbf{Set}, g.; \forall \mathit{mzg} \in \mathbf{Set}, p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad |\mathit{mpf}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{mpf} \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \mathit{mpf}), f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{mpf}.\; \exists n.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}pole}(f, x, n) \wedge \\ \quad |\mathit{mzf}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{difference}(u, \mathit{mpf}).\; ((f(x) = 0) \Rightarrow (x \in \mathit{mzf})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{mzf}.\; (f(x) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{mzf}.\; \exists m.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \mathit{mpf}), f, x, m) \wedge \\ \quad |\mathit{mpg}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{mpg} \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{difference}(u, \mathit{mpg}), g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathit{mpg}.\; \begin{cor}[{Counting zeros by the logarithmic integral}]\label{thm:argument-principle-holomorphic}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall e \in \mathbf{Set}, f, p, q, s, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad |e| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad e \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x_{16} \in u.\; ((f(x_{16}) = 0) \Rightarrow (x_{16} \in e)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x_{16} \in e.\; (f(x_{16}) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x_{16} \in e.\; \exists m_{16}.\; \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, x_{16}, m_{16}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}road}(p, q, s, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(p, s, t) \subseteq \operatorname{difference}(u, e) \wedge \\ \quad p(t) = p(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{null\text{-}homotopic}(u, p, s, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{recip}(((2 \cdot \pi) \cdot +i)) \cdot \operatorname{line\text{-}int}((\lambda z_{16} \in \operatorname{difference}(u, e).\; (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, z_{16}) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(f(z_{16})))), p, q, s, t) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; (\operatorname{zero\text{-}order}(u, f, x) \cdot \operatorname{winding}(p, q, s, t, x))), \\ \quad \quad \quad e) \end{array}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.24}
\begin{prop}[{Number of solutions of f(z) = w as a winding number}]\label{thm:zeros-count-winding}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, r, q \in \mathbb{R}, w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad r < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, q) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; \neg (f(y) = w) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \{z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) : (f(z) = w)\} \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \quad |\{z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) : (f(z) = w)\}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{zero\text{-}order}(u, (\lambda \mathit{c4nx} \in u.\; (f(\mathit{c4nx}) - w)), x)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \{z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r) : (f(z) = w)\}) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{winding}((\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; f(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r)(t))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, \operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, r)(t)) \cdot \operatorname{circle\text{-}deriv}(c, r)(t)), \\ \quad \quad \quad 0, (2 \cdot \pi), w) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.25}
\begin{thm}[{Local n-to-one structure of a holomorphic map}]\label{thm:local-n-to-one}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{local-n-to-one}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a \in u, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, (\lambda x \in u.\; (f(x) - f(a))), a, n) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists v, w. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), v) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad v \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad a \in v \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), w) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in v.\; (f(z) \in w) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y \in w.\; \exists b \in v.\; (f(b) = y) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y \in w.\; (\neg (y = f(a)) \Rightarrow (|\{b \in v : (f(b) = y)\}| = n)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{multiplicity-local-simple}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, a, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, (\lambda x \in u.\; (f(x) - f(a))), a, n) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{difference}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r), \operatorname{singleton}(a)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (f(z) = f(a)) \wedge \neg (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, z) = 0) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-local-power-form}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, a, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(u, f, a, m) \wedge (1 \leq m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r_{7} \in \mathbb{R}, k_{7}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < r_{7} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r_{7}) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r_{7}), k_{7}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{k7}(a) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r_{7}), k_{7}, a) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z_{7} \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a, r_{7}).\; (f(z_{7}) = \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{k7}(z_{7}), m)) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.26}
\begin{cor}[{Open mapping theorem}]\label{thm:open-mapping-theorem-holomorphic}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{open-mapping-theorem-holomorphic}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, o. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x_{13}, y_{13} \in u.\; \neg (f(x_{13}) = f(y_{13})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), o) \wedge \\ \quad o \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \{w_{14} \in \mathbb{C} : \exists z_{14} \in o.\; (f(z_{14}) = w_{14})\}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-local-openness}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, o.; \forall a \in o. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x_{13}, y_{13} \in u.\; \neg (f(x_{13}) = f(y_{13})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), o) \wedge \\ \quad o \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e_{13}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e_{13}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall v_{13} \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((v_{13} - f(a))) < e_{13}) \Rightarrow \exists z_{13} \in o.\; (f(z_{13}) = v_{13}) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.27}
\begin{prop}[{Holomorphic inverse function theorem}]\label{thm:holomorphic-inverse-function-theorem}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-inverse-function-theorem}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \neg (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, a) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists v, w, g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), v) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad a \in v \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad v \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), w) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad g \in (w \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in v.\; ((f(z) \in w) \wedge (g(f(z)) = z)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall y \in w.\; ((g(y) \in v) \wedge (f(g(y)) = y)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(w, g) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-inverse-holomorphic}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, v, w.; \forall g \in (w \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad v \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), w) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in w.\; ((g(y) \in v) \wedge (f(g(y)) = y)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{rgy} \in w. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), w), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), g, \mathit{rgy}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in v.\; \neg (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, x) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(w, g) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.1}
\begin{lem}[{An exhaustive sequence of compact sets}]\label{thm:locally-compact-separable-exhaustion}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{locally-compact-separable-exhaustion}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}locally\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists x.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}exhaustion}(s, x) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-open-has-compact-exhaustion}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall p \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists x.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}exhaustion}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u), x) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-has-compact-exhaustion}}
\vnbstmt{\exists x.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}exhaustion}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, x)}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-is-compact-exhaustion}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}exhaustion}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-exhaustive}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge ((p \subseteq u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, p)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p \subseteq \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-compact}}
\vnbstmt{\forall u.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)))}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-covers}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \Rightarrow \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.2}
\begin{prop}[{C(U) is a Frechet space for uniform convergence on compacta}]\label{thm:cc-cont-fns-frechet}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-cont-fns-frechet}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-fn-module-is-module}}
\vnbstmt{\forall u.\; ((u \subseteq \mathbb{C}) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))))}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-seminorms-family}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-uniform-iff-compacta}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, m, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (p \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((m(k)(z) - f(z))) \leq s) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, m, f) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-fr-conv-iff-unif-on-compacta}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), s, f) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, f) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.7}
\begin{thm}[{Montel: bounded closed subsets of H(U) are compact}]\label{thm:cc-montel}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-montel}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, \operatorname{image}(s, \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \wedge \exists g \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u).\; \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, \operatorname{subseq}(s, i), g)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-montel-subsequence}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, \operatorname{image}(s, \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{subseq}(s, a)(i)(z) - \operatorname{subseq}(s, a)(j)(z))) < b \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-montel-tail}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((s(i)(z) - s(j)(z))) < a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u).\; \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, g) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-pointwise-diagonal}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s, d. \\ \quad u \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in u.\; (s(k)(z) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u. \exists a \in \mathbb{R}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(s(k)(z)) \leq a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u), d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \exists \ell \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cmk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(i(\mathit{cmk}))(d(j))), \ell) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.8}
\begin{prop}[{Bounded subsets of H(U) are equicontinuous}]\label{thm:cc-hol-bounded-equicontinuous}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-hol-bounded-equicontinuous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a.; \forall b \in u, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge (\operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, a) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \forall f \in a, z \in u.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((z - b)) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((f(z) - f(b))) < s))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-holomorphic-deriv-estimate}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall y \in \mathbb{C}, q, m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, y, (2 \cdot q)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cmy} \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, y, (2 \cdot q)).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(\mathit{cmy})) \leq m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, y)) \leq (m \cdot \operatorname{recip}(q)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-holomorphic-lipschitz-at-centre}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, q, m \in \mathbb{R}, z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < q \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, (3 \cdot q)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, (3 \cdot q)).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(y)) \leq m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((f(z) - f(c))) \leq ((m \cdot \operatorname{recip}(q)) \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((z - c))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.10}
\begin{thm}[{Ascoli-Arzela}]\label{thm:complex-analysis-5.10}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ascoli-arzela-sequential}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad m \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, m(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}equicontinuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pointwise\text{-}bounded}(s, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists g \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, g) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}uniformly}(s, \operatorname{subseq}(m, l), g) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-montel}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, \operatorname{image}(s, \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \wedge \exists g \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u).\; \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, \operatorname{subseq}(s, i), g)) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{ascoli-arzela-sequential}}}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/rake-\allowbreak{}ascoli-\allowbreak{}diagonal.scm} --- 10 recorded steps.}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Lemmas.} \texttt{ascoli-pointwise-diagonal}, \texttt{ascoli-sequential-from-diagonal}.}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Oracles.} \texttt{arith}, \texttt{ineq}, \texttt{crs}.  \textbf{Bill:} \texttt{proven modulo 0}.}
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{cc-montel}}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.13}
\begin{lem}[{Equicontinuous sequence converging on a dense set converges everywhere}]\label{thm:equicont-dense-conv-ptwise-cauchy}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{equicont-dense-conv-ptwise-cauchy}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall m \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R})). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}equicontinuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, m) \wedge \exists q.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}on}(s, m, q))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ptwise\text{-}cauchy}(s, m) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-unif-cauchy-on-compact}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, q, t, s. \\ \quad a \subseteq \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, a), q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in a.\; (t(k)(z) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a, s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, y \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((y - x)) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((t(k)(y) - t(k)(x))) < s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}. \exists \ell \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda \mathit{cmk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; t(\mathit{cmk})(q(j))), \ell) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, z \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((p \leq i) \wedge (p \leq j)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((t(i)(z) - t(j)(z))) < s) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ascoli-dense-bridge}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \\ \quad m \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, m(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}equicontinuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, m) \wedge \\ \quad \exists q.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}on}(s, m, q)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, g) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}uniformly}(s, m, g) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.

\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-deriv-cont-lin}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u).\; (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-hol-fn-module-is-module}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-deriv-continuous-on-hol}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, s(k), w))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, w))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-deriv-linear}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, g.; \forall a, b \in \mathbb{C}, z \in u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, (\lambda w \in u.\; ((a \cdot f(w)) + (b \cdot g(w)))), z) \\ \quad \quad =\; (a \cdot \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, z)) + (b \cdot \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g, z)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.21}
\begin{lem}[{The seminorms of f' are bounded by seminorms of f}]\label{thm:cc-deriv-seminorm-estimate}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-deriv-seminorm-estimate}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \mathbb{R}, y \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{cmy} \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, ((4 \cdot n) + 3)).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(\mathit{cmy})) \leq m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, y)) \leq (m \cdot (4 \cdot (n + 1))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-ball-inside}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, y \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, y, (1/2 \cdot \operatorname{recip}((n + 1)))) \subseteq \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, ((4 \cdot n) + 3)) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.22}
\begin{prop}[{Normally convergent series of holomorphic functions differentiate term by term}]\label{thm:cc-series-holomorphic}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-series-holomorphic}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}(g, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(w))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall z \in u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(w)))), z) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda \mathit{cdi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g(\mathit{cdi}), z))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-derived-series-normally-convergent}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}(g, \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda z \in u.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g(i), z))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust}(u, n)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-normal-convergence-uniform}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, s, a. \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}, y \in s.\; (g(i)(y) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}(g, s) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \mathbb{N}. \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, z \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad (p \leq n) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}((\operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}limit}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(z))) - \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(z)), n))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; a \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-normal-convergence-pointwise}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, s.; \forall z \in s. \\ \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}, y \in s.\; (g(i)(y) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}normally\text{-}convergent}(g, s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}converges}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(z))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-partial-sums-diff}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u.; \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), z \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda w \in u.\; \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(i)(w)), n)), \\ \quad \quad \quad z, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda \mathit{cdi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, g(\mathit{cdi}), z)), n)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.23}
\begin{prop}[{Hurwitz's theorem}]\label{thm:cc-hurwitz}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-hurwitz}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in u.\; \neg (s(k)(z) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\exists c \in \mathbb{C}.\; \forall \mathit{hcz} \in u.\; (f(\mathit{hcz}) = c) \vee \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = 0)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-hurwitz-local}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), a \in \mathbb{C}, c \in u, p, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad f(c) = a \wedge \\ \quad 0 < p \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in u.\; (((x \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, p)) \wedge \neg (x = c)) \Rightarrow \neg (f(x) = a)) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (n \leq k) \Rightarrow \exists z \in u.\; ((z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r)) \wedge (s(k)(z) = a)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} PROVEN 2026-10-18. Convergence in H(U) is UNIF-ON-COMPACTA; 'f is a constant' is: some c in CC has f(z) = c for every z in u. The route differs from the notes: instead of the zero-counting integral of Corollary 4.21, which the library lacks, the zeros of f - a do not accumulate (2.12), |f - a| is bounded below on a small circle, and the mean value bound for 1/(f\_k - a) gives the contradiction.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.24}
\begin{rem}[{Hurwitz's theorem for a value a, and its contrapositive}]\label{thm:cc-hurwitz-value}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-hurwitz-value}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), a \in \mathbb{C}, f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z \in u.\; \neg (s(k)(z) = a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\exists c \in \mathbb{C}.\; \forall \mathit{hcz} \in u.\; (f(\mathit{hcz}) = c) \vee \forall z \in u.\; \neg (f(z) = a)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-hurwitz-eventually}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), a \in \mathbb{C}, c \in u, r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \neg \exists \mathit{hcc} \in \mathbb{C}.\; \forall z \in u.\; (f(z) = \mathit{hcc}) \wedge \\ \quad f(c) = a \wedge \\ \quad 0 < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (n \leq k) \Rightarrow \exists \mathit{hzz} \in u.\; ((\mathit{hzz} \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, c, r)) \wedge (s(k)(\mathit{hzz}) = a)) \end{array}}
%
\end{rem}

The first sentence is stated for a sequence none of whose terms takes the value a; the statement for infinitely many n is stated in its contrapositive form, locally: if f is not constant and f(c) = a, then in every ball about c, f\_k takes the value a for all large k.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.25}
\begin{prop}[{A limit of injective holomorphic functions is constant or injective}]\label{thm:cc-hurwitz-injective}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, z, w \in u.\; ((s(k)(z) = s(k)(w)) \Rightarrow (z = w)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{C}.\; \forall \mathit{hcz} \in u.\; (f(\mathit{hcz}) = c) \vee \\ \quad \quad \forall z, w \in u.\; ((f(z) = f(w)) \Rightarrow (z = w)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.26}
\begin{prop}[{Laurent coefficients are continuous linear functionals on H(U)}]\label{thm:laurent-coef-cont-lin}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{laurent-coef-cont-lin}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, o \in \mathbb{R}, q \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(a, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \subseteq u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ring\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda z \in \mathbb{C}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(z))), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u).\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, a, o)(q))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{laurent-coef-sup-bound}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, o, m \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq m \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(y)) \leq m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(k)) \leq ((o \cdot \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{recip}(o), (k + 1))) \cdot m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(-(k + 1))) \leq ((o \cdot \operatorname{power}(o, k)) \cdot m) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{laurent-coef-add}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f, g, h.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, o \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (h(z) \simeq (f(z) + g(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(h, c, o)(k) = (\operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(k) + \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(g, c, o)(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(h, c, o)(-(k + 1)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(-(k + 1)) + \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(g, c, o)(-(k + 1)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{laurent-coef-scale}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s \in \mathbb{C}, u, f, h.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, o \in \mathbb{R}, k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad 0 < o \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{trace}(\operatorname{circle\text{-}path}(c, o), 0, (2 \cdot \pi)) \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; (h(z) \simeq (s \cdot f(z))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(h, c, o)(k) = (s \cdot \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(h, c, o)(-(k + 1)) = (s \cdot \operatorname{laurent\text{-}coefs}(f, c, o)(-(k + 1))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\end{prop}

\begin{prop}[{Absolute summability vs summability of log(1 + a\_k)}]\label{thm:prop-6-8}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{prop-6-8}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (m \leq q) \Rightarrow \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((1 + a(q))) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}((1 + a(q))) \leq 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(\log\left((1 + a((m + k)))\right)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{prop-6-8-forward}}

\vnbpart{\texttt{prop-6-8-backward}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (m \leq q) \Rightarrow \neg ((\operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((1 + a(q))) = 0) \wedge (\operatorname{real\text{-}part}((1 + a(q))) \leq 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(\log\left((1 + a((m + k)))\right)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))) \end{array}}

\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{6.13}
\begin{cor}[{A normally convergent product of nonzero holomorphic functions is nonzero}]\label{thm:corollary-6-13}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (\mathbb{N} \to (u \to \mathbb{C})). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; \exists w \in u.\; \neg ((1 + f(i)(w)) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}normal\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, \operatorname{prod\text{-}fun}(u, f)) \wedge \exists v \in u.\; \neg (\operatorname{prod\text{-}fun}(u, f)(v) = 0)) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{6.21}
\begin{thm}[{Weierstrass factorization theorem}]\label{thm:theorem-6-21}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(\mathbb{C}, f, 0, m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; \neg (a(q) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \exists \mathit{c6m} \in \mathbb{N}. \forall q \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (\mathit{c6m} \leq q) \Rightarrow (r \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(a(q))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (\neg (z = 0) \wedge \forall q \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((n \leq q) \Rightarrow \neg (a(q) = z))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}zero\text{-}of\text{-}order}(\mathbb{C}, f, z, \operatorname{count\text{-}hits}(a, z, n)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\mathbb{C}, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists u \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (0 \leq r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{power}((r \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{magnitude}(a(k)))), (u(k) + 1)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((u(k) + 1))))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad f(z) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; (\operatorname{power}(z, m) \cdot \exp g(z)) \cdot \operatorname{prod\text{-}fun}(\mathbb{C}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\lambda x \in \mathbb{C}.\; (((1 - (x \cdot \operatorname{recip}(a(k)))) \cdot \exp \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda \mathit{clhk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; ({\mathit{clhk}}^{\ast\!-1} \cdot \operatorname{power}((x \cdot \operatorname{recip}(a(k))), \mathit{clhk}))), (u(k) + 1))) - 1))))(z) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall e, n, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(e) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(e) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(e))) \wedge \operatorname{generates}(e, n, u))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \mathbb{N}, a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(l, a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists f.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(l, a), e, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c, b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((c \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(c, b) \wedge \exists g.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(c, b), e, g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (l = c) \wedge (a = b) \end{array}}

\begin{prop}[{Holomorphy of a map between Riemann surfaces is local}]\label{thm:diff-on-local}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall f \in (u \to \mathbb{C}), v.; \forall a \in v, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), v) \wedge \\ \quad v \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, v, \operatorname{restrict}(f, v), a, l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, a, l) \end{array}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{10.6}
\begin{prop}[{Composition of holomorphic maps}]\label{thm:holomorphic-chain}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-chain}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, g, x, u, f, l, d. \\ \quad m \subseteq \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad g \in (m \to \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, m), \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, g, x) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in m.\; (g(y) \in u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, g(x), l) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}deriv\text{-}at}((\lambda t \in m.\; \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(g(t))), x, \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}deriv\text{-}at}((\lambda t \in m.\; \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(g(t))), x, \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(d)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}deriv\text{-}at}((\lambda t \in m.\; \operatorname{real\text{-}part}(f(g(t)))), x, \operatorname{real\text{-}part}((l \cdot d))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}deriv\text{-}at}((\lambda t \in m.\; \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}(f(g(t)))), x, \operatorname{imag\text{-}part}((l \cdot d))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{diff-on-chain}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, u, s, f, g, a, l, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, f, a, l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, s, g, f(a), m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in u.\; (f(y) \in s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}on}(k, u, (\lambda x \in u.\; g(f(x))), a, \operatorname{mul}(k)(m, l)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{10.11}
\begin{lem}[{Disc automorphisms fixing 0 are rotations}]\label{thm:disc-automorphism-is-rotation}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{disc-automorphism-is-rotation}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}holomorphic\text{-}automorphism}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1), i) \wedge (i(0) = 0)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(r) = 1) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (i(z) = (r \cdot z)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{automorphism-inverse-holomorphic}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}holomorphic\text{-}automorphism}(u, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, i^{-1}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{holomorphic-injective-deriv-nonzero}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, f.; \forall a \in u. \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x_{9}, y_{9} \in u.\; ((f(x_{9}) = f(y_{9})) \Rightarrow (x_{9} = y_{9})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{deriv\text{-}on}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, u, f, a) = 0) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{disc-automorphism-rotation}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}holomorphic\text{-}automorphism}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1), i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1), i^{-1}) \wedge \\ \quad i(0) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}(r) = 1) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, 0, 1).\; (i(z) = (r \cdot z)) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}

\begin{prop}[{A bounded simple holomorphic function on U}]\label{thm:sc-bounded-simple}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{simply\text{-}connected}(u) \wedge ((a \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \neg (a \in u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{holomorphic\text{-}on}(u, h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z, w \in u.\; ((h(z) = h(w)) \Rightarrow (z = w)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{R}.\; \forall z \in u.\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(h(z)) \leq m) \end{array}}

\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.7}
\begin{lem}[{Causal precedence in a bundle is a partial order with minimal elements}]\label{thm:precedes-partial-order}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{precedes-partial-order}}
\vnbstmt{\forall c.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}partial\text{-}order}(\operatorname{bnodes}(c), \operatorname{precedes}(c)))}
\vnbpart{\texttt{finite-strict-minimal}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \forall x, y, z.\; ((([x, y] \in r) \wedge ([y, z] \in r)) \Rightarrow ([x, z] \in r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x.\; \neg ([x, x] \in r) \wedge \\ \quad |s| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \exists w.\; (w \in s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in s.\; \forall z \in s.\; \neg ([z, m] \in r) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{bundle-minimal}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge (\forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c)) \wedge \exists w.\; (w \in s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in s.\; \forall z \in s.\; \neg ([z, m] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.8}
\begin{lem}[{A minimal node of a content-closed node set is a sent node}]\label{thm:bundle-minimal-sent}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, s, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y. \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad y \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), x) = \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), y) \wedge \\ \quad \quad y \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad x \in s \wedge \\ \quad n \in s \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; \neg ([z, n] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sent}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), n) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, u, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bundle}(c) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{bspace}(c)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{bspace}(c)), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), n)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{bnodes}(c). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subterm}(\operatorname{tokens}(\operatorname{bspace}(c)), \operatorname{keys}(\operatorname{bspace}(c)), u, \operatorname{node\text{-}content}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), z)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg ([z, n] \in \operatorname{precedes\text{-}strict}(c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{originates}(\operatorname{bspace}(c), u, n) \end{array}}
