\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.21}
\begin{cor}[{Borel sets are Lusin}]\label{thm:borel-polish-lusin}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{borel-polish-lusin}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall b \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge \exists x.\; (x \in b)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}lusin}(s, b) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{borel-from-inter-disjoint-union}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \subseteq \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to b).\; (\{q \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (q \in g(n))\} \in b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall g \in (\mathbb{N} \to b). \\ \quad \quad \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}, x \in g(i).\; ((x \in g(j)) \Rightarrow (i = j)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(a, \mathbb{N}, g(a)) \in b \wedge \\ \quad \forall u.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \Rightarrow (u \in b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s) \subseteq b \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.25}
\begin{prop}[{Lusin separation theorem}]\label{thm:souslin-separation}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{souslin-separation}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, b) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; \neg (x \in b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{borel\text{-}separated}(s, a, b) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{baire-separation}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}baire\text{-}continuous}(s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}baire\text{-}continuous}(s, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{image}(f, (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N})).\; \neg (x \in \operatorname{image}(g, (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{borel\text{-}separated}(s, \operatorname{image}(f, (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N})), \operatorname{image}(g, (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{separation-step}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall f, g \in ((\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}) \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), u, v \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \neg \operatorname{borel\text{-}separated}(s, \operatorname{image}(f, \operatorname{cyl}(u, n)), \operatorname{image}(g, \operatorname{cyl}(v, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists q_{1}, q_{2} \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg \operatorname{borel\text{-}separated}(s, \operatorname{image}(f, \operatorname{cyl}(\operatorname{upd}(u, n, q_{1}), (n + 1))), \operatorname{image}(g, \operatorname{cyl}(\operatorname{upd}(v, n, q_{2}), (n + 1)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{borel-separated-union}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a, b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \forall k, l \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{borel\text{-}separated}(s, a(k), b(l))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{borel\text{-}separated}(s, \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, a(n)), \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(n, \mathbb{N}, b(n))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.26}
\begin{cor}[{Souslin's theorem}]\label{thm:souslin-theorem}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{souslin-theorem}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge (e \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists x.\; (x \in e) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), e)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{souslin-complement-borel}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad e \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x.\; (x \in e) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{pts}(s), e)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.27}
\begin{cor}[{Separation of a disjoint sequence of Souslin sets}]\label{thm:souslin-disjoint-envelopes}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\exists \mathit{mbx}.\; (\mathit{mbx} \in a(k)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, a(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k, l \in \mathbb{N}, x \in a(k).\; (\neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \neg (x \in a(l))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a(k) \subseteq e(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall k, l \in \mathbb{N}, x \in e(k).\; (\neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \neg (x \in e(l))) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.28}
\begin{prop}[{Borel sieve partitions of a Borel set}]\label{thm:dense-piece-borel}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{dense-piece-borel}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(t)), r.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t), a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(t)(x, s(n)) < a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{ball}(t, s(k), r), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(k), (\lambda \mathit{mbj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ball}(t, s(\mathit{mbj}), r))(j))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(t) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{dense-piece-cover}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(t)), r.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(t), a. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{dist}(t)(x, s(n)) < a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad x \\ \quad \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(\operatorname{ball}(t, s(k), r), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{big\text{-}union}(j, \mathrm{OS}(k), (\lambda \mathit{mbj} \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ball}(t, s(\mathit{mbj}), r))(j))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{dense-piece-disjoint}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.30}
\begin{prop}[{Injective continuous images of Borel sets are Borel}]\label{thm:lusin-souslin-borel-domain}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{lusin-souslin-borel-domain}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall b \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(p), s, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(p, b), s, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, a \in b.\; ((i(x) = i(a)) \Rightarrow (x = a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{image}(i, b) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{lusin-souslin}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall t, s, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(t, s, h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, a \in \operatorname{pts}(t).\; ((h(x) = h(a)) \Rightarrow (x = a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{image}(h, \operatorname{pts}(t)) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.31}
\begin{cor}[{Borel = Lusin in Polish spaces}]\label{thm:polish-borel-iff-lusin}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{polish-borel-iff-lusin}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge (e \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s)) \Leftrightarrow (\exists x.\; (x \in e) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}lusin}(s, e)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{lusin-borel}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((e \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}lusin}(s, e))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{borel-polish-lusin}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall b \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge \exists x.\; (x \in b)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}lusin}(s, b) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%

%

%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.32}
\begin{thm}[{Injective Borel maps preserve Borel sets}]\label{thm:injective-borel-image}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{injective-borel-image}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, s, i.; \forall b \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(\operatorname{pts}(a), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(a), \operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, c \in \operatorname{pts}(a).\; ((i(x) = i(c)) \Rightarrow (x = c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{image}(i, b) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{borel-injection-image}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, z, h.; \forall b \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(z) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(\operatorname{pts}(a), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(a), \operatorname{pts}(z), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(z), h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, c \in \operatorname{pts}(a).\; ((h(x) = h(c)) \Rightarrow (x = c)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{image}(h, b) \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(z) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{separable-countably-separated}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(p) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}countably\text{-}separated}(\operatorname{pts}(p), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(p)) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.36}
\begin{prop}[{Countably separated spaces embed in separable metric spaces}]\label{thm:countably-separated-iff}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{countably-separated-iff}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countably\text{-}separated}(s, b) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists z. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(z) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(s, b, \operatorname{pts}(z), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(z), i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y \in s.\; ((i(x) = i(y)) \Rightarrow (x = y)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{countably-separated-embeds}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countably\text{-}separated}(s, b) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists z. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(z) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(s, b, \operatorname{pts}(z), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(z), i) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y \in s.\; ((i(x) = i(y)) \Rightarrow (x = y)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{countably-separated-of-injection}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, b, z, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(z) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(s, b, \operatorname{pts}(z), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(z), i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y \in s.\; ((i(x) = i(y)) \Rightarrow (x = y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}countably\text{-}separated}(s, b) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{measurable-map-of-generators}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, c, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(s, a) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad c \subseteq \operatorname{power}(b) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (s \to b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e \in c.\; (\{x \in s : (f(x) \in e)\} \in a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}map}(s, a, b, \operatorname{sigma\text{-}generated}(b, c), f) \end{array}}

\end{prop}

\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{souslin-iff-closed-family}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists x.\; (x \in e) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists t \in (\mathit{nstar} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in \mathit{nstar}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, t(p)) \wedge (\operatorname{souslin\text{-}set}(s, t) = e) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{closed-family-souslin}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall v \in (\mathit{nstar} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge (\forall p \in \mathit{nstar}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, v(p)) \wedge \exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{souslin\text{-}set}(s, v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, \operatorname{souslin\text{-}set}(s, v)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{souslin-closed-family}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}souslin}(s, e)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists t \in (\mathit{nstar} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall p \in \mathit{nstar}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, t(p)) \wedge (\operatorname{souslin\text{-}set}(s, t) = e) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{souslin-closed-graph-closed}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall v \in (\mathit{nstar} \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s))). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge \forall p \in \mathit{nstar}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, v(p))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{product2\text{-}ms}(s, \operatorname{baire\text{-}ms}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \{w \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \times \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{baire\text{-}ms})) : \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{nth}(1, w) \in v(\operatorname{restrict}(\operatorname{nth}(2, w), \mathrm{OS}(n))))\}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{dist0-closed}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (a \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, \\ \quad \quad \quad \{y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) : \forall e \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \Rightarrow \exists \mathit{m38a} \in a.\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(y, \mathit{m38a}) < e))\}) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.44}
\begin{prop}[{Closed/open approximation of Borel sets}]\label{thm:borel-closed-open-approx}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{borel-closed-open-approx}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), a) \wedge ((a(\operatorname{pts}(s)) = 1) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists f, u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f \subseteq e \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad e \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad a(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(u, f)) \leq b \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad (a(u) - b) \leq a(e) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad a(e) \leq (a(f) + b) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{borel-closed-open-approx-finite}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), b. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), a) \wedge ((a(\operatorname{pts}(s)) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists f, u. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge ((f \subseteq e) \wedge ((e \subseteq u) \wedge (a(\operatorname{complement\text{-}in}(u, f)) \leq b))))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.46}
\begin{prop}[{Outer regularity for locally finite measures}]\label{thm:borel-outer-regular}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{borel-outer-regular}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u.; \forall e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad (\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, a(n)) \wedge (u(a(n)) \in \mathbb{R})) \wedge (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(b, \mathbb{N}, a(b)) = \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(e) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{einf}(\{v \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} : \exists \mathit{mru} \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s)).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, \mathit{mru}) \wedge ((e \subseteq \mathit{mru}) \wedge (v = u(\mathit{mru}))))\}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{borel-outer-approx}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists c. \\ \quad \quad (\forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, c(n)) \wedge (a(c(n)) \in \mathbb{R})) \wedge (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(d, \mathbb{N}, c(d)) = \operatorname{pts}(s))) \wedge \\ \quad a(e) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists u.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge ((e \subseteq u) \wedge (a(u) \leq (a(e) + b)))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\begin{prop}[{Regularity is tightness of the whole space}]\label{thm:regular-iff-tight}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge (u(\operatorname{pts}(s)) \in \mathbb{R}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}measure}(s, u) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; u(\operatorname{pts}(s)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{esup}(\{v \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star} : \exists k \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{pts}(s)).\; ((k \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, k)) \wedge (v = u(k))))\}) \end{array}}

\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.51}
\begin{prop}[{Ulam's theorem}]\label{thm:polish-probability-regular}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{polish-probability-regular}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}polish}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge (u(\operatorname{pts}(s)) = 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}measure}(s, u) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{tight-of-full-balls}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u.; \forall x \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{pts}(s)) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall r.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow (u(\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(i, \mathbb{N}, \operatorname{ball}(s, x(i), r))) = u(\operatorname{pts}(s)))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k. \\ \quad \quad \quad (k \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, k)) \wedge (u(\operatorname{pts}(s)) \leq (u(k) + a))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.52}
\begin{cor}[{Regularity on complete spaces via separable support}]\label{thm:regular-iff-separable-support}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge (u(\operatorname{pts}(s)) = 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}regular\text{-}measure}(s, u) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists e \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s).\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, e)) \wedge (u(e) = 1)) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{6.12}
\begin{lem}[{Splitting a compact set across two open sets}]\label{thm:compact-split-open-cover}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, k, u, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, v) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq (u \cup v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a, b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, b)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad a \subseteq u \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad b \subseteq v \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad k = (a \cup b) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%

%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{7.6}
\begin{cor}[{Separability when r0 is infinite}]\label{thm:measure-ball-separable}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{measure-ball-separable}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow ((0 < u(\operatorname{ball}(s, x, r))) \wedge (u(\operatorname{ball}(s, x, r)) \in \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall r. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; ((c \cdot u(\operatorname{ball}(s, y, r))) \leq u(\operatorname{ball}(s, x, r)))) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z.\; (z \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ball-greedy-net}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u.; \forall b \in \operatorname{pts}(s), d \in \mathbb{R}, l, h, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h) \wedge \\ \quad (h + h) < l \wedge \\ \quad u(\operatorname{ball}(s, b, (d + l))) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (a \leq u(\operatorname{ball}(s, x, h))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)). \forall p \in \operatorname{ball}(s, b, d). \exists i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad p \in \operatorname{ball}(s, f(i), l) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ball-packing-bounded}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u.; \forall b \in \operatorname{pts}(s), d \in \mathbb{R}, h.; \forall c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{pts}(s)), a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(k) \in \operatorname{ball}(s, b, d)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j, k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j < k) \Rightarrow ((h + h) < \operatorname{dist}(s)(c(j), c(k)))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (a \leq u(\operatorname{ball}(s, c(k), h))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \neg (u(\operatorname{ball}(s, b, (d + (h + h)))) \in \mathbb{R}) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, u.; \forall a \in \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}separable}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < a \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), r. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge (r < a)) \Rightarrow ((0 < u(\operatorname{ball}(s, x, r))) \wedge (u(\operatorname{ball}(s, x, r)) \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}finite}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \end{array}}

\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{7.38}
\begin{prop}[{Self-similar dimension equation}]\label{thm:self-similar-dimension}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbf{Set}, a \in (x \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad ((|x| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((2 \leq |x|) \wedge \forall w \in x.\; (1 < a(w)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < l \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda w \in x.\; {a(w)}^{-l}), x) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 0 < b \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{commutative\text{-}ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), (\lambda w \in x.\; {a(w)}^{-b}), x) = 1 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad b = l \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{8.24}
\begin{thm}[{Riesz-Markov for compact spaces}]\label{thm:construction-of-measures-8.24}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{rmz-riesz-markov}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge (\exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u, f) \wedge (\operatorname{rintegral}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u, f) = a(f))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{rmz-riesz-markov-dense}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, x))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u, f) \wedge (\operatorname{rintegral}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u, f) = x(f))) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{10.14}
\begin{lem}[{Extension from a dense set via Cauchy nets}]\label{thm:construction-of-measures-10.14}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense}(s, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a), t, f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(s, t, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(a, g, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(s, t, h) \wedge \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(a, h, f)) \Rightarrow (h = g) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{A.8}
\begin{prop}[{Lipschitz comparison via balls}]\label{thm:lipschitz-bound-iff-balls}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{lipschitz-bound-iff-balls}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((\operatorname{pts}(t) = \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y) \leq (k \cdot \operatorname{dist}(t)(x, y))) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ball}(t, x, r) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(s, x, (k \cdot r))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{lipschitz-lower-iff-balls}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((\operatorname{pts}(t) = \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; ((k \cdot \operatorname{dist}(t)(x, y)) \leq \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ball}(s, x, (k \cdot r)) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(t, x, r)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{lipschitz-equivalent-iff-balls}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, a, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(t) \wedge ((\operatorname{pts}(t) = \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(a) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; ((a \cdot \operatorname{dist}(t)(x, y)) \leq \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (\operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y) \leq (k \cdot \operatorname{dist}(t)(x, y))) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ball}(s, x, (a \cdot r)) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(t, x, r)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{ball}(t, x, r) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(s, x, (k \cdot r))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\begin{thm}[{The Lebesgue measure of an interval is its length}]\label{thm:lebesgue-measure-ccint}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{lebesgue-measure-ccint}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a \leq b))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ccint}(a, b) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(\mathbb{R}, \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{res}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s))), \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))))(\operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) \\ \quad \quad =\; (b - a) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{lebesgue-measure-ooint}}

\vnbpart{\texttt{lebesgue-measure-coint}}

\vnbpart{\texttt{lebesgue-measure-point}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{singleton}(x) \\ \quad \in\; \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(\mathbb{R}, \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{res}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s))), \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda s \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(s)))))(\operatorname{singleton}(x)) \\ \quad =\; 0 \end{array}}

%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c. \\ \quad ((s \subseteq \mathbb{R}) \wedge (c \in \mathbb{R})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))(\{z \in \mathbb{R} : ((z - c) \in s)\}) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))(s) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}

%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall a, b.\; (((a \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (a \leq b))) \Rightarrow (u(\operatorname{ccint}(a, b)) = (b - a))) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u(s) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{res}(\operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols}))), \operatorname{caratheodory\text{-}sets}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\mathbb{R}, \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}, (\lambda \mathit{ols} \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}intervals}.\; \operatorname{interval\text{-}length}(\mathit{ols})))))(s) \end{array}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.8}
\begin{thm}[{Cauchy-Schwarz and Minkowski inequalities for an inner product}]\label{thm:cips-schwarz}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cips-schwarz}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y))) \leq (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sip-schwarz}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y)) \leq (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cips-minkowski}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y) \rVert \leq (\lVert x \rVert + \lVert y \rVert) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sip-minkowski}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y))} \leq (\sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x)} + \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y)}) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.10}
\begin{prop}[{Polarization identity for a sesquilinear form}]\label{thm:ses-polarization}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sesquilinear\text{-}form}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 4 \cdot f(x, y) \\ \quad \quad =\; (((f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) - f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)))) + (+i \cdot f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y))))) - (+i \cdot f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y))), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y)))))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/sip-\allowbreak{}b.scm} --- 72 recorded steps.}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Lemmas.} \texttt{cc-i-in}, \texttt{cc-one-in}, \texttt{cc-neg-closed}, \texttt{rr-subset-cc}, \texttt{ses-expand}, \texttt{csip-cact-one}, \texttt{csip-cact-neg-one}, \texttt{csip-cact-neg-i}, \texttt{cc-conjugate-fixes-rr}, \texttt{cc-conjugate-i}, \texttt{cc-conjugate-neg}, \texttt{ses-type}.}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Oracles.} \texttt{arith}, \texttt{crs}, \texttt{ineq}.  \textbf{Bill:} \texttt{proven modulo 0}.}
%
\end{proof}
%
\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} Stated for a form on the carrier of a complex semi-inner-product space (IS-SESQUILINEAR-FORM(v, sqf)), not on a bare complex vector space.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.12}
\begin{cor}[{Sesquilinear forms agreeing on the diagonal are equal}]\label{thm:functional-analysis-1.12}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ses-polarization}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sesquilinear\text{-}form}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 4 \cdot f(x, y) \\ \quad \quad =\; (((f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) - f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)))) + (+i \cdot f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y))))) - (+i \cdot f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y))), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y)))))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ses-add-left}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f.; \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sesquilinear\text{-}form}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y), z) = (f(x, z) + f(y, z)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ses-add-right}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f.; \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sesquilinear\text{-}form}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(x, \operatorname{vadd}(v)(y, z)) = (f(x, y) + f(x, z)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ses-homog-left}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f.; \forall a \in \mathbb{C}, x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sesquilinear\text{-}form}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{cact}(v)(a, x), y) = (a \cdot f(x, y)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ses-homog-right}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f.; \forall k \in \mathbb{C}, x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sesquilinear\text{-}form}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad f(x, \operatorname{cact}(v)(k, y)) = (\operatorname{conjugate}(k) \cdot f(x, y)) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{ses-polarization}}}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.25}
\begin{prop}[{Vector space operations are continuous in a normed space}]\label{thm:frm-add-continuous}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{frm-add-continuous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, c, f, g, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, c) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, c), f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, c), g, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, c), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)(f(n), g(n))), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{frm-scal-continuous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(d)), b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)), l \in \operatorname{carr}(d), x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d), s, l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a), b, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{act}(m)(s(n), b(n))), \operatorname{act}(m)(l, x)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{frm-add-continuous}}}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.26}
\begin{prop}[{The inner product norm is a norm; the inner product is continuous}]\label{thm:ip-normed-ag-is-normed-ag}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ip-normed-ag-is-normed-ag}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ip-metric-space-is-metric-space}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cips-minkowski}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y) \rVert \leq (\lVert x \rVert + \lVert y \rVert) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.45}
\begin{lem}[{Simple functions are dense in L2}]\label{thm:functional-analysis-1.45}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{integral-simple-approx}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}sigma\text{-}algebra}(a, b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}simple\text{-}fn}(a, b, c(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, c(n), c((n + 1))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}sup}(a, c)(x) = f(x)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{dominated-convergence}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, c, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to (a \to \operatorname{rr\text{-}pos\text{-}star})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, c(n)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ptwise\text{-}le}(a, c(n), g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, g) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in a.\; \operatorname{econverges\text{-}to}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; c(n)(x)), f(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{econverges\text{-}to}((\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, c(n))), \operatorname{integral}(a, b, u, f)) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.49}
\begin{prop}[{L\textasciicircum{}p\_mu(X) is a Banach space}]\label{thm:functional-analysis-1.49}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{lp-norm-triangle}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq p \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \|{(\lambda x \in a.\; (f(x) + g(x)))}\|_{p} \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \operatorname{eplus}(\|{f}\|_{p}, \|{g}\|_{p}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{lp-norm-homogeneous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, f, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((p \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < p))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \|{(\lambda x \in a.\; (c \cdot f(x)))}\|_{p} = \operatorname{etimes}(\lvert c \rvert, \|{f}\|_{p}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{lp-norm-zero-iff}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, p, f, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 < p \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \|{(\lambda \mathit{sx} \in a.\; (f(\mathit{sx}) - g(\mathit{sx})))}\|_{p} = 0 \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}null\text{-}set}(a, b, u, s) \wedge \forall x \in a.\; (\neg (x \in s) \Rightarrow (f(x) = g(x))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{minkowski}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g.; \forall p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge (1 \leq p)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad I_{p}({\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}eplus}(a, f, g)}) \leq \operatorname{eplus}(I_{p}({f}), I_{p}({g})) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.52}
\begin{prop}[{Bounded iff continuous for a linear map of normed spaces}]\label{thm:frm-cont-lin-iff-bound}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{frm-cont-lin-iff-bound}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \exists g \in \mathbb{N}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq g) \Rightarrow (b(j)(x) \leq r)) \Rightarrow (f(k)(t(x)) \leq (h \cdot r)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{frm-bound-of-cont-lin}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \mathbb{N}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq g) \Rightarrow (b(j)(x) \leq r)) \Rightarrow (f(k)(t(x)) \leq (h \cdot r)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{frm-cont-lin-of-bound}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \exists g \in \mathbb{N}, h. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq g) \Rightarrow (b(j)(x) \leq r)) \Rightarrow (f(k)(t(x)) \leq (h \cdot r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{is-bounded-linear-arrow-def}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}arrow}(a, b, f) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(b) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(b)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(a) = \operatorname{scal}(b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x_{1}, x_{2} \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x_{1}, x_{2})) = \operatorname{vadd}(b)(f(x_{1}), f(x_{2})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x_{1} \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(a)), x_{2} \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad f(\operatorname{act}(a)(x_{1}, x_{2})) = \operatorname{act}(b)(x_{1}, f(x_{2})) \wedge \\ \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (0 \leq k) \wedge \forall x_{1} \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(b)(f(x_{1})) \leq (k \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x_{1}))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.54}
\begin{prop}[{The operator norm is a norm on L(E,F)}]\label{thm:dual-norm-spec}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{dual-norm-spec}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f) \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \quad 0 \leq \operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\lvert f(x) \rvert \leq (\operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(x))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq d) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\lvert f(x) \rvert \leq (d \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f) \leq d \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{dual-norm-nonneg-nvs}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 \leq \operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{dual-norm-le-bound-nvs}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad 0 \leq c \wedge \\ \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\lvert f(w) \rvert \leq (c \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(w))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f) \leq c \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{dual-norm-is-bound-nvs}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, f) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lvert f(x) \rvert \leq (\operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, f) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(x)) \end{array}}

\end{prop}

\begin{prop}[{Extension of a bounded operator from a dense subspace}]\label{thm:functional-analysis-1.61}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, t, a, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(t) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense}(s, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(s, a), t, f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(s, t, g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(a, g, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}uniformly\text{-}continuous}(s, t, h) \wedge \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(a, h, f)) \Rightarrow (h = g) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\begin{thm}[{Banach-Steinhaus: uniform boundedness}]\label{thm:frechet-banach-steinhaus}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (g \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(c))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in g.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, h(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fr\text{-}bounded}(c, f, \{y \in \operatorname{vec}(c) : \exists i \in g.\; (y = h(i)(x))\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fr\text{-}equicont}(a, b, c, f, g, h) \end{array}}

\end{thm}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.76}
\begin{cor}[{Existence of a norming functional}]\label{thm:hahn-banach-seminorm}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{hahn-banach-seminorm}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, s, f, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(d) \wedge \\ \quad (d = \operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \vee (d = \operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(d, m, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s.\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(f(x)) \leq p(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear}(m, a) \wedge (\operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(s, a, f) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(a(x)) \leq p(x)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{hahn-banach-extend-one}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, f, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad v \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (v \in s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, \operatorname{span\text{-}add\text{-}one}(m, s, v), g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(s, g, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{span\text{-}add\text{-}one}(m, s, v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \lvert g(w) \rvert \leq (\operatorname{dual\text{-}norm\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(w)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{hahn-banach}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}finite\text{-}dimensional}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, \operatorname{vec}(m), g) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(s, g, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall w \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\lvert g(w) \rvert \leq (\operatorname{dual\text{-}norm\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(w))) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.19}
\begin{prop}[{Orthogonal projection onto a closed subspace of a Hilbert space}]\label{thm:hilbert-projection-exists}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{hilbert-projection-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in k, b \in {k}^{\perp}.\; (i = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{hilbert-decomposition-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a_{1}, a_{2}, b_{1}, b_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad a_{1} \in k \wedge \\ \quad a_{2} \in k \wedge \\ \quad b_{1} \in {k}^{\perp} \wedge \\ \quad b_{2} \in {k}^{\perp} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a_{1}, b_{1}) = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a_{2}, b_{2}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (a_{1} = a_{2}) \wedge (b_{1} = b_{2}) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\end{cor}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.22}
\begin{thm}[{Riesz representation}]\label{thm:riesz-representation}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{riesz-representation}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(v, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) \leq (\lVert x \rVert \cdot \lVert e \rVert)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq c) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) \leq (c \cdot \lVert x \rVert))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \lVert e \rVert \leq c \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{riesz-representation-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f, e_{1}, e_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad e_{1} \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad e_{2} \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e_{1})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e_{2})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad e_{1} = e_{2} \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{riesz-representation}}}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/hilbert-\allowbreak{}projection.scm} --- 44 recorded steps.}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Lemmas.} \texttt{hilbert-space-is-cips}, \texttt{riesz-representation-exists}, \texttt{cips-ip-magnitude-le}, \texttt{cips-ip-bound-least}.}
%

%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{riesz-representation-unique}}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{8.24-8.26}
\begin{prop}[{Seminormed spaces with a countable family: the metric}]\label{thm:functional-analysis-8.24-8.26}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{frm-cont-lin-iff-bound}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \exists g \in \mathbb{N}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq g) \Rightarrow (b(j)(x) \leq r)) \Rightarrow (f(k)(t(x)) \leq (h \cdot r)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{frm-scal-continuous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(d)), b \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)), l \in \operatorname{carr}(d), x \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d), s, l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a), b, x) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{act}(m)(s(n), b(n))), \operatorname{act}(m)(l, x)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{8.30}
\begin{thm}[{Open mapping theorem for Frechet spaces}]\label{thm:functional-analysis-8.30}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{open-mapping-theorem}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(c).\; \exists x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (y = t(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}lin\text{-}map}(a, b, c, f, t) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{open-mapping-bounded-inverse}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(c, a, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (g(t(x)) = x) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(c).\; (t(g(y)) = y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(c, f, a, b, g) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}

\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-montel}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, \operatorname{image}(s, \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists i. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(i) \wedge \exists g \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u).\; \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, \operatorname{subseq}(s, i), g)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-hol-bounded-equicontinuous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u, a.; \forall b \in u, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge (\operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, a) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \forall f \in a, z \in u.\; ((\operatorname{magnitude}((z - b)) < l) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}((f(z) - f(b))) < s))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-montel-pointwise-limit}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), g \in (u \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}bounded}(u, \operatorname{image}(s, \mathbb{N})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in u.\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; s(k)(z)), g(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (g \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)) \wedge \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, g) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{Hahn-Banach}
\begin{thm}[{Hahn-Banach for a sublinear functional}]\label{thm:hbs-hahn-banach-sublinear}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{hbs-hahn-banach-sublinear}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, s, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sublinear}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (f(z) \leq p(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, \operatorname{vec}(m), a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(s, a, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (a(x) \leq p(x)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{hahn-banach-seminorm-rr}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, s, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s.\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})(f(x)) \leq p(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear}(m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(s, a, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field})(a(x)) \leq p(x)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{hahn-banach-seminorm}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, s, f, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(d) \wedge \\ \quad (d = \operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \vee (d = \operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(d, m, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s.\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(f(x)) \leq p(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}k\text{-}linear}(m, a) \wedge (\operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(s, a, f) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(a(x)) \leq p(x)))) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.

m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{rm\text{-}kms}(s, q)), u)))))), \\ \quad \quad \quad g) \\ \quad \quad =\; m(g) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{pex-positive-extension}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a.; \forall \ell \in (a \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \forall f, g \in a.\; ((\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(x) + g(x))) \in a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{R}, f \in a.\; ((\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (c \cdot f(x))) \in a) \wedge \\ \quad (\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; 1) \in a \wedge \\ \quad \forall f, g \in a. \\ \quad \quad \ell((\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (f(x) + g(x)))) = (\ell(f) + \ell(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{R}, f \in a.\; (\ell((\lambda x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (c \cdot f(x)))) = (c \cdot \ell(f))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall f \in a.\; (\forall b \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; (0 \leq f(b)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \ell(f))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(a, m, \ell)) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}

\section{Topological vector spaces (Thayer, notes)}
%
\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.4}
\begin{prop}[{A separating family of seminorms defines a vector space topology}]\label{thm:seminorm-top-is-tvs}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{seminorm-top-is-tvs}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, x, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, x, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(d, m, \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sntop-is-top-space}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, x, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, x, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sntop-hausdorff}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, x, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, x, f) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sntop-add-continuous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, x, f, \mathit{tvx}, y, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, x, f) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{tvx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(m)(\mathit{tvx}, y) \in u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists v \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathit{tvx} \in v \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (y \in w) \wedge \forall a \in v, b \in w.\; (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, b) \in u) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sntop-scal-continuous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, x, f, r, \mathit{tvx}, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, x, f) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \mathit{tvx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(r, \mathit{tvx}) \in u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{tvd}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{tvd}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists w \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, f)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{tvx} \in w \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(m)), a \in w. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(\operatorname{add}(\operatorname{scal}(m))(s, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{scal}(m))(r))) < \mathit{tvd}) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{act}(m)(s, a) \in u \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sntop-open-basic}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a, f, u, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, m, a, f) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, a, f))) \wedge (x \in u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{snf} \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((|\mathit{snf}| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((\mathit{snf} \subseteq a) \wedge \exists e.\; (\operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(e) \wedge (\operatorname{sn\text{-}ball}(m, f, \mathit{snf}, x, e) \subseteq u)))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} Arbitrary index set ix and arbitrary normed field fld. 'Vector space topology'
   is IS-TVS: Hausdorff topology on VEC m with addition and scalar multiplication continuous
   in neighbourhood form. The topology is SEMINORM-TOP, opens defined by the closed basic
   sets SN-BALL over finite index sets. The earlier countable/metric results
   (frm-*) stand beside it.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.5}
\begin{cor}[{R\textasciicircum{}n is a topological vector space}]\label{thm:rn-is-tvs}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{rn-is-tvs}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rn}(n)), \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rn}(n)), \{0\}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rn}(n))))) \end{array}}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(m), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(m), \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(m)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nvs-norm-is-seminorm}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(m), \operatorname{vnrm}(m)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nvs-norm-family}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(m), \{0\}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(m))) \end{array}}

\end{cor}
