\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.8}
\begin{prop}[{The C\textasciicircum{}k(U) seminorms and convergence uniformly on compacta}]\label{thm:cc-exhaust-seminorms-family}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-exhaust-seminorms-family}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-fr-conv-iff-unif-on-compacta}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), s, f) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{unif\text{-}on\text{-}compacta}(u, s, f) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.12}
\begin{prop}[{Continuity of a linear map between seminormed spaces by seminorm bounds}]\label{thm:sn-cont-iff-bound}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{sn-cont-iff-bound}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x_{1}, f_{1}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, a, x_{1}, f_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(a, x_{1}, f_{1}), \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(b, x_{2}, f_{2}), t) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall j \in x_{2}. \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f \subseteq x_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), \mathit{sbt} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \forall i \in f.\; (\operatorname{f1}(i)(x) \leq \mathit{sbt})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \mathit{sbt}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sn-cont-of-bound}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, x_{1}, f_{1}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, a, x_{1}, f_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, b, x_{2}, f_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in x_{2}. \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad f \subseteq x_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), \mathit{sbt} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \forall i \in f.\; (\operatorname{f1}(i)(x) \leq \mathit{sbt})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \mathit{sbt}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(a, x_{1}, f_{1}), \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(b, x_{2}, f_{2}), t) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sn-bound-of-cont}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, x_{1}, f_{1}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}, t.; \forall j \in x_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, a, x_{1}, f_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(a, x_{1}, f_{1}), \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(b, x_{2}, f_{2}), t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f \subseteq x_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), \mathit{sbt} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \forall i \in f.\; (\operatorname{f1}(i)(x) \leq \mathit{sbt})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \mathit{sbt}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sn-bound-combine}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, x_{1}, f_{1}, b, x_{2}, f_{2}, t.; \forall g \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, a, x_{1}, f_{1}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(d, b, x_{2}, f_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, b, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in x_{2}. \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad f \subseteq x_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), \mathit{sbt} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \forall i \in f.\; (\operatorname{f1}(i)(x) \leq \mathit{sbt})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \\ \quad |g| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad g \subseteq x_{2} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f \subseteq x_{1} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in g, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), \mathit{sbt} \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq \mathit{sbt}) \wedge \forall i \in f.\; (\operatorname{f1}(i)(x) \leq \mathit{sbt})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{f2}(j)(t(x)) \leq (c \cdot \mathit{sbt}) \end{array}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.13}
\begin{cor}[{Continuity of a linear functional by a seminorm bound}]\label{thm:functional-cont-iff-bound}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, a, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family\text{-}on}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, x, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(m, \operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(m, x, a), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}top}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space\text{-}as\text{-}module}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \{0\}, (\lambda k \in \{0\}.\; \operatorname{vnrm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}nvs}))), \\ \quad \quad \quad f) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists \mathit{sbf} \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad \quad \quad |\mathit{sbf}| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \mathit{sbf} \subseteq x \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{sbx} \in \operatorname{vec}(m), t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq t) \wedge \forall i \in \mathit{sbf}.\; (a(i)(\mathit{sbx}) \leq t)) \Rightarrow (\lvert f(\mathit{sbx}) \rvert \leq (c \cdot t)) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y)) \leq (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y)) \end{array}}

\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.20}
\begin{prop}[{Closest point of a closed convex set}]\label{thm:real-convex-closest-point-unique}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{real-convex-closest-point-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(v, s) \wedge \\ \quad \exists e.\; (e \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall b \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad b = a \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{real-convex-closest-point}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}real\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(v, s) \wedge \\ \quad \exists e.\; (e \in s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in s. \forall b \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{real-convex-closest-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, x, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(v, s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in s \wedge \\ \quad b \in s \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{real-convex-closest-iff-variational}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, s, x, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(v, s) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (a \in s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall d \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(d, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(d, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(x))) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall c \in s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(c, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a))) \leq 0 \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} C is required NONEMPTY (for C empty the notes' statement is false). Closest is minimality of the squared distance, |a - x|\textasciicircum{}2 $<$= |b - x|\textasciicircum{}2 for every b in C, not an infimum. Existence goes through the complexification of H and the complex closest-point theorem for a midpoint-closed set (hilbert-closest-point-midpoint), not through the notes' minimizing sequence. The variational characterisation real-convex-closest-iff-variational is not in the notes.

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sesquilinear\text{-}form}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 4 \cdot f(x, y) \\ \quad \quad =\; (((f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) - f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)))) + (+i \cdot f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y))))) - (+i \cdot f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y))), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y)))))) \end{array}}

\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.10}
\begin{prop}[{Two functionals with the same hyperplane are proportional}]\label{thm:hyperplane-functionals-proportional}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, g, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, \operatorname{vec}(m), f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, \operatorname{vec}(m), g) \wedge \\ \quad \exists \mathit{hpa} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \neg (f(\mathit{hpa}) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \exists \mathit{hpa} \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \neg (g(\mathit{hpa}) = 0) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; ((f(z) = f(a)) \Leftrightarrow (g(z) = g(b))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists c \in \mathbb{R}.\; (\neg (c = 0) \wedge \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (f(z) = (c \cdot g(z)))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.12}
\begin{prop}[{An open convex cone misses a nontrivial subspace}]\label{thm:open-cone-misses-subspace}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, t, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}tvs}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, t) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{opens}(t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, c) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in c, r \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < r) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{act}(m)(r, x) \in c)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \neg (e \in c) \wedge \\ \quad \exists d_{1}, d_{2} \in \operatorname{vec}(m). \forall a, b \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{vadd}(m)(\operatorname{act}(m)(a, d_{1}), \operatorname{act}(m)(b, d_{2})) = \operatorname{vzero}(m)) \Rightarrow ((a = 0) \wedge (b = 0)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists s. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge (\exists v \in s.\; \neg (v = \operatorname{vzero}(m)) \wedge \forall \mathit{vx} \in s.\; \neg (\mathit{vx} \in c))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\begin{prop}[{The Minkowski functional of a symmetric absorbing convex set is a seminorm}]\label{thm:minkowski-functional-is-seminorm}

\vnbpart{\texttt{minkowski-functional-is-seminorm}}

\vnbpart{\texttt{mink-inf-subadditive}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}absorbing\text{-}subset}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vzero}(m) \in s \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y))) \leq (\operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, x)) + \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{mink\text{-}set}(m, s, y))) \end{array}}

\begin{prop}[{The strict epigraph of a continuous convex functional is open convex}]\label{thm:strict-epigraph-open-convex}

\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.36}
\begin{cor}[{Hahn-Banach for a convex dominating functional}]\label{thm:hahn-banach-convex}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{hahn-banach-convex}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p, s, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, s, f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall z \in s.\; (f(z) \leq p(z)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}functional\text{-}on}(m, \operatorname{vec}(m), a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(s, a, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (a(x) \leq p(x)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{homog-minorant-sublinear}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}convex\text{-}functional}(m, p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}sublinear}(m, \operatorname{homog\text{-}minorant}(m, p)) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.40}
\begin{prop}[{Extremal subsets: transitivity, intersections, inverse images}]\label{thm:extremal-subset-trans}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{extremal-subset-trans}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, c, b, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(v, c, b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(v, b, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(v, c, a) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{extremal-subset-inter}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, f, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(v) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (x \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{vec}(v))) \wedge \\ \quad a \in (x \to \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{vec}(v))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall l \in x.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(v, f(l), a(l)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z.\; (z \in \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(v) : \forall l \in x.\; (w \in f(l))\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(v, \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(v) : \forall l \in x.\; (w \in f(l))\}, \\ \quad \quad \quad \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(v) : \forall l \in x.\; (w \in a(l))\}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{extremal-subset-preimage}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, d, f, b, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(c, d, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(c) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(d, b, a) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z.\; (z \in \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(c) : (f(w) \in b)\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}extremal\text{-}subset}(c, \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(c) : (f(w) \in b)\}, \{w \in \operatorname{vec}(c) : (f(w) \in a)\}) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\begin{prop}[{The canonical map into the bidual is an isometry}]\label{thm:bidual-eval-isometry}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{bidual-eval-isometry}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}({{m}^{*}}^{*})(\iota_{m}({x})) = \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(x) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{bidual-eval-in-bidual}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \iota_{m}({x}) \in \operatorname{vec}({{m}^{*}}^{*}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{bidual-eval-additive}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \iota_{m}({\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, y)}) = \operatorname{vadd}({{m}^{*}}^{*})(\iota_{m}({x}), \iota_{m}({y})) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{bidual-eval-homogeneous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, r, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \iota_{m}({\operatorname{act}(m)(r, x)}) = \operatorname{act}({{m}^{*}}^{*})(r, \iota_{m}({x})) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{norming-functional-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge (x \in \operatorname{vec}(m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists g. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}bounded\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(m, g) \wedge ((\operatorname{dual\text{-}norm}(m, g) \leq 1) \wedge (g(x) = \operatorname{vnrm}(m)(x)))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\begin{thm}[{Open mapping theorem}]\label{thm:topological-vector-spaces-4.7}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{open-mapping-theorem}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(c).\; \exists x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (y = t(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}lin\text{-}map}(a, b, c, f, t) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{open-mapping-bounded-inverse}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(c, a, g) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (g(t(x)) = x) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(c).\; (t(g(y)) = y) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(c, f, a, b, g) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{fom-baire-approx}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(c).\; \exists x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (y = t(x)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{fnb} \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{feta}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{feta}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(c), k \in \mathbb{N}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i \leq \mathit{fnb}) \Rightarrow (f(i)(z) < \mathit{feta})) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{fx} \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq n) \Rightarrow (b(j)(\mathit{fx}) < l)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i \leq k) \Rightarrow (f(i)(\operatorname{vadd}(c)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(c)(t(\mathit{fx})))) < h)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{fom-open-of-approx}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, l. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{fnb} \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{feta}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(\mathit{feta}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \operatorname{vec}(c), k \in \mathbb{N}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i \leq \mathit{fnb}) \Rightarrow (f(i)(z) < \mathit{feta})) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq n) \Rightarrow (b(j)(x) < l)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i \leq k) \Rightarrow (f(i)(\operatorname{vadd}(c)(z, \operatorname{vneg}(c)(t(x)))) < h)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open\text{-}lin\text{-}map}(a, b, c, f, t) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.9}
\begin{thm}[{Closed graph theorem}]\label{thm:topological-vector-spaces-4.9}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{closed-graph-theorem}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}closed\text{-}graph}(a, b, c, f, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{fbs-graph-frechet}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}closed\text{-}graph}(a, b, c, f, t) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (g(k)(x) = (b(k)(x) + f(k)(t(x)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, g) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.15}
\begin{thm}[{Uniform boundedness theorem}]\label{thm:topological-vector-spaces-4.15}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{frechet-banach-steinhaus}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (g \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(c))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in g.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, h(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fr\text{-}bounded}(c, f, \{y \in \operatorname{vec}(c) : \exists i \in g.\; (y = h(i)(x))\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fr\text{-}equicont}(a, b, c, f, g, h) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{fbs-baire-ball}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, g, h.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (g \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(c))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fr\text{-}bounded}(c, f, \{y \in \operatorname{vec}(c) : \exists i \in g.\; (y = h(i)(x))\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}, m \in \operatorname{vec}(a), p. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a, b), m, p) \\ \quad \quad \quad \subseteq\; \operatorname{closure}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a, b), \{\mathit{bx} \in \operatorname{vec}(a) : \forall \mathit{bi} \in g.\; (f(k)(h(\mathit{bi})(\mathit{bx})) \leq n)\}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{fbs-uniform-ball}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, g, h.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (g \to (\operatorname{vec}(a) \to \operatorname{vec}(c))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in g.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, h(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fr\text{-}bounded}(c, f, \{y \in \operatorname{vec}(c) : \exists i \in g.\; (y = h(i)(x))\}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists m \in \mathbb{N}, l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists n. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in g, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq m) \Rightarrow (b(j)(x) < l)) \Rightarrow (f(k)(h(i)(x)) \leq n) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.20}
\begin{lem}[{Extension of a dominated seminorm from a subspace}]\label{thm:seminorm-extension}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{seminorm-extension}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s.\; (p(x) \leq q(x)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext}(m, s, p, q)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{extends\text{-}on}(s, \operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext}(m, s, p, q), p) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext}(m, s, p, q)(y) \leq q(y)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sxt-inf-extends}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dmx} \in s.\; (p(\mathit{dmx}) \leq q(\mathit{dmx})) \wedge \\ \quad x \in s \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, x)) = p(x) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sxt-inf-le-q}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, s, p, q, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(m) = \operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}on}(m, s, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, m, q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in s.\; (p(x) \leq q(x)) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{inf}(\operatorname{seminorm\text{-}ext\text{-}set}(m, s, p, q, y)) \leq q(y) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{seminorm-extension}}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.2}
\begin{prop}[{C\textasciicircum{}k(U) is complete}]\label{thm:topological-vector-spaces-5.2}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-cont-fns-frechet}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-hol-fns-closed}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u.; \forall s \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u)), f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), s, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad f \in \operatorname{cc\text{-}hol\text{-}fns}(u) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.3}
\begin{thm}[{Mean value theorem along a segment}]\label{thm:topological-vector-spaces-5.3}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, f, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\operatorname{vec}(m) \to \mathbb{R}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, 1). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous\text{-}at}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \operatorname{seg\text{-}curve}(m, f, a, b), x) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad ((0 < x) \wedge (x < 1)) \Rightarrow \exists l.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diff\text{-}at}(\operatorname{seg\text{-}curve}(m, f, a, b), x, l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists h \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad 0 < h \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad h < 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists v. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}dir\text{-}diff\text{-}at}(m, f, \operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, \operatorname{act}(m)(h, b)), b, v) \wedge (v = (f(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, b)) - f(a)))) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/directional-\allowbreak{}derivative.scm} --- 106 recorded steps.}
%

%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Oracles.} \texttt{arith}, \texttt{crs}, \texttt{ineq}.  \textbf{Bill:} \texttt{proven modulo 0}.}
%
\end{proof}

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} dir-deriv-mvt is stated for f in FUN(vec(m), RR) on a normed vector space (not a function ON the open set U); its hypotheses involve only the segment (continuity of t -$>$ f(a + t eta) on [0, 1], differentiability inside), so the notes' form follows by extending f off U. The conclusion has 0 $<$ theta $<$ 1 (stronger than 0 $<$= theta $<$= 1) and the derivative is a directional derivative IS-DIR-DIFF-AT; no C\textasciicircum{}1 hypothesis is needed.

\begin{thm}[{Baire category theorem}]\label{thm:topological-vector-spaces-A.2}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complete}(s) \wedge \exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{pts}(s))) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}nonmeager}(s, \operatorname{pts}(s)) \end{array}}

\end{thm}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{A.4}
\begin{thm}[{The topology of a topological group is given by left-invariant pseudometrics}]\label{thm:top-group-pseudometrics-define-topology}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{top-group-pseudometrics-define-topology}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (u \subseteq \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad u \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall a \in u. \exists s. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), s) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists r. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r) \wedge (\operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), s), a, r) \subseteq u) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{bk-metric-pseudometric}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}pseudometric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(g, a)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{bk-metric-left-invariant}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}invariant}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(g, a), g) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{bk-ball-open}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, g, b.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(g), r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}topology}(s, g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}bk\text{-}sequence}(s, g, b) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(\operatorname{bk\text{-}metric}(g, b), a, r) \in \operatorname{opens}(s) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} The family is \{ BK-METRIC(g, vs) : IS-BK-SEQUENCE(s, g, vs) \}.  Each member is a pseudometric (bk-metric-pseudometric), left invariant (bk-metric-left-invariant) and continuous: its balls are open (bk-ball-open).  The family defines the topology: for U a subset of PTS s, U is open iff every a in U lies in a ball of some member that is inside U (top-group-pseudometrics-define-topology).  No Hausdorff or countability hypothesis.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{A.5}
\begin{prop}[{Subadditive regularisation on a monoid}]\label{thm:subadd-reg-subadditive}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{subadd-reg-subadditive}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall g \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \mathbb{R}), x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (0 \leq g(x)) \wedge \\ \quad g(\operatorname{iden}(m)) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{carr}(m). \\ \quad \quad g(\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{opr}(m)(x, y), z)) \leq (2 \cdot \operatorname{max}(g(x), \operatorname{max}(g(y), g(z)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{subadd\text{-}reg}(m, g, \operatorname{opr}(m)(x, y)) \leq (\operatorname{subadd\text{-}reg}(m, g, x) + \operatorname{subadd\text{-}reg}(m, g, y)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{subadd-reg-bounds}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall g \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \mathbb{R}), x \in \operatorname{carr}(m). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (0 \leq g(x)) \wedge \\ \quad g(\operatorname{iden}(m)) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{carr}(m). \\ \quad \quad g(\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{opr}(m)(x, y), z)) \leq (2 \cdot \operatorname{max}(g(x), \operatorname{max}(g(y), g(z)))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad ((\operatorname{subadd\text{-}reg}(m, g, x) \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (((1/2 \cdot g(x)) \leq \operatorname{subadd\text{-}reg}(m, g, x)) \wedge (\operatorname{subadd\text{-}reg}(m, g, x) \leq g(x)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{gauge-product-bound-ind}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b \in \mathbb{N}, m.; \forall g \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \mathbb{R}), n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(m)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (0 \leq g(x)) \wedge \\ \quad g(\operatorname{iden}(m)) = 0 \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, y, z \in \operatorname{carr}(m). \\ \quad \quad g(\operatorname{opr}(m)(\operatorname{opr}(m)(x, y), z)) \leq (2 \cdot \operatorname{max}(g(x), \operatorname{max}(g(y), g(z)))) \wedge \\ \quad n \leq b \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad g(\operatorname{mprod}(m, u, n)) \leq (2 \cdot \operatorname{series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda i \in \mathbb{N}.\; g(u(i))), n)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%

%

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hausdorff}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}countable\text{-}nbhd\text{-}base}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists d. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pts}(d) = \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}left\text{-}invariant}(d, \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(d)) = \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \end{array}}

\end{prop}

Hypotheses IS-HAUSDORFF(s) and HAS-COUNTABLE-NBHD-BASE(s, e) (new).  Conclusion: some metric space md with PTS md = PTS s, IS-LEFT-INVARIANT(md, g) (new, Definition A.3) and OPENS(METRIC-TOP md) = OPENS(s). \renewcommand{\thethm}{A.13}
\begin{thm}[{Ascoli-Arzela}]\label{thm:topological-vector-spaces-A.13}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ascoli-arzela-sequential}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \\ \quad m \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, m(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}equicontinuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pointwise\text{-}bounded}(s, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists g \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, g) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}uniformly}(s, \operatorname{subseq}(m, l), g) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ascoli-dense-bridge}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \\ \quad m \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, m(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}equicontinuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, m) \wedge \\ \quad \exists q.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}on}(s, m, q)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, g) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}uniformly}(s, m, g) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{equicont-dense-conv-implies-unif-cauchy}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge \\ \quad m \in (\mathbb{N} \to (\operatorname{pts}(s) \to \mathbb{R})) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}equicontinuous}(s, \operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, m) \wedge \\ \quad \exists q.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}on}(s, m, q)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unif\text{-}cauchy}(s, m) \end{array}}

\end{thm}

\vnbpart{\texttt{singleton-subspace-compact}}

\vnbpart{\texttt{principal-ideal-membership}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, x. \\ \quad (x \in \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(s, a)) \Leftrightarrow ((x \in \operatorname{carr}(s)) \wedge \exists r \in \operatorname{carr}(s).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(s)(r, a))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.5}
\begin{cor}[{Euclid's lemma in a Euclidean domain}]\label{thm:euclid-lemma}

\vnbpart{\texttt{euclid-lemma}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, p.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}domain}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}element}(s, p) \wedge \operatorname{divides}(s, p, \operatorname{mul}(s)(a, b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{divides}(s, p, a) \vee \operatorname{divides}(s, p, b) \end{array}}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall p, a \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ideal}(s, \\ \quad \quad \quad \{x \in \operatorname{carr}(s) : \exists u, v \in \operatorname{carr}(s).\; (x = \operatorname{add}(s)(\operatorname{mul}(s)(u, p), \operatorname{mul}(s)(v, a)))\}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{euclidean-domain-is-euclidean-ring}}
\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}domain}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(s))}
%
\end{cor}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.8}
\begin{prop}[{A Euclidean domain is a UFD}]\label{thm:euclidean-domain-is-ufd}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{euclidean-domain-is-ufd}}
\vnbstmt{\forall s.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}domain}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}ufd}(s))}
\vnbpart{\texttt{factorization-exists-bounded}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b \in \mathbb{N}, s, n.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}degree\text{-}function}(s, n) \wedge ((n(a) < b) \wedge \neg (a = \operatorname{zero}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unit}(s, u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists \mathit{gun} \in \mathbb{N}, p \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, \mathit{gun}) \to \operatorname{carr}(s)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}seq}(s, p, \mathit{gun}) \wedge (a = \operatorname{mul}(s)(u, \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(s, p, \operatorname{interval}(1, \mathit{gun})))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{factorization-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, s, p.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, q \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, m) \to \operatorname{carr}(s)), u.; \forall v \in \operatorname{carr}(s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}domain}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}seq}(s, p, n) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}seq}(s, q, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unit}(s, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unit}(s, v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(s)(u, \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(s, p, \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) = \operatorname{mul}(s)(v, \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(s, q, \operatorname{interval}(1, m))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad n = m \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists s_{2} \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{interval}(1, n), \operatorname{interval}(1, m)). \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{associated}(s, p(i), q(\operatorname{s2}(i))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.9}
\begin{prop}[{Division with remainder in F[x]}]\label{thm:poly-division-with-remainder}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{poly-division-with-remainder}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge \neg (b = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists s, r \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((a = \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{poly}(k))(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(k))(b, s), r)) \wedge ((r = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(k))) \vee (\operatorname{deg}(k, r) < \operatorname{deg}(k, b)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{poly-division-bounded}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall b \in \mathbb{N}, k.; \forall a, \mathit{pb} \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge ((\operatorname{deg}(k, a) < b) \wedge \neg (\mathit{pb} = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)). \\ \quad \quad \quad a = \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(k))(\mathit{pb}, s) \vee \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{deg}(k, \operatorname{add}(\operatorname{poly}(k))(a, \operatorname{neg}(\operatorname{poly}(k))(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{poly}(k))(\mathit{pb}, s)))) < \operatorname{deg}(k, \mathit{pb}) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.16}
\begin{lem}[{Elementary column/row matrices are invertible}]\label{thm:elem-f-invertible}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-f-invertible}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n, k, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge ((l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge \neg (k = l))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(a, n, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(a, n, k, l)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-g-invertible}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n, r, k, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{carr}(a) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(a, n, \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(a, n, r, k, l)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-f-inverse}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n, k, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge ((l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge \neg (k = l))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(a, n, k, l), \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(a, n, l, k)) = \operatorname{identmat}(a, n) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-g-inverse}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n, r, k, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{carr}(a) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(a, n, r, k, l), \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(a, n, \operatorname{neg}(a)(r), k, l)) = \operatorname{identmat}(a, n) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.18}
\begin{lem}[{A E\_n[k,l] shifts column k to column l}]\label{thm:galois-theory-1.18}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n, p, k, l.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m), c \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(a))) \wedge ((k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(a, p, \operatorname{matunit}(a, n, k, l)), i, c) = \left(\text{if }(c = l)\text{ then }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, k)\text{ else }\operatorname{zero}(a)\right) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.20}
\begin{prop}[{Elementary operations as matrix multiplication}]\label{thm:galois-theory-1.20}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-f-action}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n, p, k, l.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m), c \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(a, p, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(a, n, k, l)), i, c) \\ \quad \quad =\; \left(\text{if }(c = k)\text{ then }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, l)\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(c = l)\text{ then }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, k)\text{ else }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, c)\right)\right) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-g-action}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n, p, r, k, l.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m), c \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{carr}(a) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(a, p, \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(a, n, r, k, l)), i, c) \\ \quad \quad =\; \left(\text{if }(c = l)\text{ then }\operatorname{add}(a)(\operatorname{entry}(p, i, l), \operatorname{mul}(a)(\operatorname{entry}(p, i, k), r))\text{ else }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, c)\right) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-h-action}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n, p, r, k.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m), c \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(a))) \wedge ((r \in \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge (k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(a, p, \operatorname{elem\text{-}h}(a, n, r, k)), i, c) \\ \quad \quad =\; \left(\text{if }(c = k)\text{ then }\operatorname{mul}(a)(\operatorname{entry}(p, i, k), r)\text{ else }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, c)\right) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.23}
\begin{prop}[{Elementary operations: s-minors of B lie in the ideal of those of A}]\label{thm:galois-theory-1.23}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{sdet-col-swap}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, k, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(r, n, k, l)), s) = \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sdet-row-swap}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, k, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(r, m, k, l), a), s) = \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sdet-col-add}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, c, k, l, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(r, n, c, k, l)), s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{sda}, b \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s), t \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((t = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \vee ((t = c) \vee (t = \operatorname{neg}(r)(c)))) \wedge (x = \operatorname{add}(r)(\mathit{sda}, \operatorname{mul}(r)(t, b))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sdet-row-add}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, c, k, l, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(r, m, c, k, l), a), s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{sda}, b \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s), t \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((t = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \vee ((t = c) \vee (t = \operatorname{neg}(r)(c)))) \wedge (x = \operatorname{add}(r)(\mathit{sda}, \operatorname{mul}(r)(t, b))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sdet-col-scale}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, c, k, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}h}(r, n, c, k)), s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{sda} \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s).\; ((x = \mathit{sda}) \vee (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, \mathit{sda}))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sdet-row-scale}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, a, c, k, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{elem\text{-}h}(r, m, c, k), a), s) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{sda} \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s).\; ((x = \mathit{sda}) \vee (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, \mathit{sda}))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sdet-divisor-equiv}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, c, a, b.; \forall x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, b, s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(r, m, n, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s).\; \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.24}
\begin{cor}[{gcd of s-minors is invariant up to a unit}]\label{thm:sdet-gcd-associated}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{sdet-gcd-associated}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall m, n, g \in \mathbb{N}, a, b \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(s)), d, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}domain}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(s, m, n, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}gcd\text{-}set}(s, \operatorname{sdet}(s, m, n, a, g), d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}gcd\text{-}set}(s, \operatorname{sdet}(s, m, n, b, g), e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{associated}(s, d, e) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sdet-divisor-equiv}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, c, a, b.; \forall x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, b, s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(r, m, n, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s).\; \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sdet-gcd-invariant}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, s, a, b, d, e. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd\text{-}set}(\operatorname{sdet}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, a, s), d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd\text{-}set}(\operatorname{sdet}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, b, s), e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (d = e) \vee (d = -e) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{diagonal-chain-sdet-gcd}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, d, s. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(d, i, i), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \leq m \wedge \\ \quad s \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd\text{-}set}(\operatorname{sdet}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d, s), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; \operatorname{entry}(d, k, k)), \operatorname{interval}(1, s))) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.27}
\begin{prop}[{Smith normal form over a Euclidean domain (existence and uniqueness)}]\label{thm:smith-normal-form-unique}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{smith-normal-form-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall m, n \in \mathbb{N}, a, d, \mathit{dd} \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(s)), k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}domain}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(s, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{divides}(s, \operatorname{entry}(d, i, i), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(s, m, n, a, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(s, m, n, \mathit{dd}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{divides}(s, \operatorname{entry}(\mathit{dd}, i, i), \operatorname{entry}(\mathit{dd}, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(s, m, n, a, \mathit{dd}) \wedge \\ \quad (k + 1) \leq m \wedge \\ \quad (k + 1) \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{associated}(s, \operatorname{entry}(d, (k + 1), (k + 1)), \operatorname{entry}(\mathit{dd}, (k + 1), (k + 1))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{smith-normal-form}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, n, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (p \in \operatorname{mat}(k, n, \operatorname{carr}(a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \operatorname{mat}(k, n, \operatorname{carr}(a)), b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(a, k, n, p, d) \wedge \operatorname{smith\text{-}staircase}(a, k, n, d, b) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{smith-diagonalization}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, n, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (p \in \operatorname{mat}(k, n, \operatorname{carr}(a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \operatorname{mat}(k, n, \operatorname{carr}(a)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(a, k, n, p, d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(a, k, n, d) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{smith-equiv-divisor}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, p, e, c, i, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(r, m, n, p, e) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dvi}, \mathit{dvj}. \\ \quad \quad ((\mathit{dvi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge (\mathit{dvj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{entry}(p, \mathit{dvi}, \mathit{dvj}) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{entry}(e, i, j) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{smith-staircase}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n, d, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{smith\text{-}staircase}(a, m, n, d, k) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(a, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad k \leq m \wedge \\ \quad k \leq n \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k).\; \neg (\operatorname{entry}(d, i, i) = \operatorname{zero}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m), j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \neg (i \leq k) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(d, i, j) = \operatorname{zero}(a)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.28}
\begin{cor}[{U A V in normal form with U, V invertible}]\label{thm:smith-normal-form}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{smith-normal-form}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, n, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (p \in \operatorname{mat}(k, n, \operatorname{carr}(a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \operatorname{mat}(k, n, \operatorname{carr}(a)), b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(a, k, n, p, d) \wedge \operatorname{smith\text{-}staircase}(a, k, n, d, b) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{smith-diagonalization}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, n, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (p \in \operatorname{mat}(k, n, \operatorname{carr}(a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \operatorname{mat}(k, n, \operatorname{carr}(a)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(a, k, n, p, d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(a, k, n, d) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{euclidean-invertible-iff-elem-gen}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(r, n, u) \Leftrightarrow (u \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{euclidean-unit-det-elem-gen}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, u), s) = \operatorname{one}(r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.29}
\begin{lem}[{Submodule of an n-generated module over a Euclidean domain has $<$= n generators}]\label{thm:galois-theory-1.29}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{submodule-fg}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), m. \\ \quad ((\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge (\operatorname{generates}(d, n, u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (k \leq n)) \wedge \exists w \in \operatorname{mat}(k, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)).\; \operatorname{spans}(d, k, w, m) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{spans-submodule-fg}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), m, a \in \operatorname{power}(\operatorname{vec}(d)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, u, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, a) \wedge \\ \quad a \subseteq m \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (k \leq n)) \wedge \exists w \in \operatorname{mat}(k, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)).\; \operatorname{spans}(d, k, w, a) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{submodule-fg}}}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/submodule-\allowbreak{}fg-\allowbreak{}proof.scm} --- 45 recorded steps.}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.30}
\begin{lem}[{Elementary matrices preserve generating / free generating}]\label{thm:galois-theory-1.30}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{generates-transport}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, u, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d))) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{scal}(d), n, m) \wedge \operatorname{generates}(d, n, u)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, \operatorname{matact}(d, m, u)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{free-transport}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, v, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge ((v \in \operatorname{mat}(m, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d))) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{scal}(d), m, a) \wedge \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, m, v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, m, \operatorname{matact}(d, a, v)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{spans-transport}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, u, m, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{scal}(d), n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, u, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, \operatorname{matact}(d, m, u), a) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.31}
\begin{prop}[{Principal sequence of a submodule of a free module (Euclidean domain)}]\label{thm:galois-theory-1.31}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{principal-sequence-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, u, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists s, a.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}principal\text{-}sequence}(d, n, m, s, a) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{principal-sequence-exists-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, u, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists s, a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}principal\text{-}sequence}(d, n, m, s, a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall s_{2}, m_{2}.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}principal\text{-}sequence}(d, n, m, s_{2}, m_{2}) \Rightarrow (a = m_{2})) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{principal-sequence-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, m, s, s_{2}, a, m_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}principal\text{-}sequence}(d, n, m, s, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}principal\text{-}sequence}(d, n, m, s_{2}, m_{2}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = m_{2} \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{submodule-of-free-is-free}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k. \\ \quad \quad \quad (((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (k \leq n)) \wedge \exists w \in \operatorname{mat}(k, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)).\; (\operatorname{spans}(d, k, w, m) \wedge \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, k, w))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
