\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.32}
\begin{lem}[{Quotient E/F by a diagonal submodule is a sum of A/(a\_i) and A's}]\label{thm:galois-theory-1.32}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{quotient-by-diagonal-subgroup}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, m, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, n, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, \operatorname{matact}(d, m, s), a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, a), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, (\lambda i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(\operatorname{entry}(m, i, i)))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad f) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{first-isomorphism-module}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, i, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(m, n, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(n).\; \exists x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; (i(x) = y) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; ((i(x) = \operatorname{vzero}(n)) \Leftrightarrow (x \in a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(m, a), n, \operatorname{descend}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(m, a), i)) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.33}
\begin{prop}[{Structure theorem for f.g. modules over a Euclidean domain}]\label{thm:galois-theory-1.33}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{fg-abelian-group-structure-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall e, n, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(e) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(e) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(e))) \wedge \operatorname{generates}(e, n, u))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \mathbb{N}, a, f. \\ \quad \quad \quad (l \leq n) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(l, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(l, a), e, f)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{fg-abelian-group-structure-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall e, l, a, f, c, b, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(e) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(l, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(c, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(l, a), e, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(c, b), e, g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (l = c) \wedge (a = b) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{fg-abelian-group-cyclic-decomposition}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall e, n, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(e) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(e) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(e))) \wedge \operatorname{generates}(e, n, u))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \mathbb{N}, a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(l, a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists f.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(l, a), e, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c, b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((c \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(c, b) \wedge \exists g.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(c, b), e, g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (l = c) \wedge (a = b) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cyclic-sum-iso-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l, a, c, b, h. \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(l, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(c, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(l, a), \operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(c, b), h) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (l = c) \wedge (a = b) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.34}
\begin{prop}[{Finitely generated abelian groups are sums of cyclic groups}]\label{thm:galois-theory-1.34}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{fg-abelian-group-structure-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall e, n, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(e) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(e) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(e))) \wedge \operatorname{generates}(e, n, u))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \mathbb{N}, a, f. \\ \quad \quad \quad (l \leq n) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(l, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(l, a), e, f)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{fg-abelian-group-cyclic-decomposition}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall e, n, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(e) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(e) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(e))) \wedge \operatorname{generates}(e, n, u))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l \in \mathbb{N}, a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(l, a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists f.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(l, a), e, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c, b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((c \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(c, b) \wedge \exists g.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(c, b), e, g))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (l = c) \wedge (a = b) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{fg-abelian-group-structure-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall e, l, a, f, c, b, g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(e) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(l, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(c, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(l, a), e, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(c, b), e, g) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (l = c) \wedge (a = b) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cyclic-sum-iso-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l, a, c, b, h. \\ \quad l \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(l, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invariant\text{-}factors}(c, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}module}(\operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(l, a), \operatorname{cyclic\text{-}sum}(c, b), h) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (l = c) \wedge (a = b) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.36}
\begin{prop}[{Cyclic vector: annihilating polynomial and companion matrix}]\label{thm:cyclic-vector-companion}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, t, v.; \forall \mathit{nv} \in \mathbb{N}, \mathit{av}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}module}(d, d, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cyclic\text{-}vector}(d, t, v) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq \mathit{nv} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, \mathit{nv}).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{scal}(d))) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}annihilating\text{-}poly}(d, t, v, \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d), \mathit{av}, \mathit{nv})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, \mathit{nv}, \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \mathit{nv})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, \mathit{nv}, \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \mathit{nv})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}matrix\text{-}of}(d, \mathit{nv}, \operatorname{krylov}(d, t, v, \mathit{nv}), t, \operatorname{companion}(\operatorname{scal}(d), \mathit{av}, \mathit{nv})) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}minimal\text{-}poly}(d, t, \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(\operatorname{scal}(d), \mathit{av}, \mathit{nv})) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\begin{prop}[{Characteristic polynomial of a companion matrix}]\label{thm:charpoly-of-companion}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v \in \mathbb{N}, r.; \forall \mathit{av} \in (\operatorname{interval}(1, (v + 1)) \to \operatorname{carr}(r)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (v + 1)).\; (\operatorname{av}(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(r))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{char\text{-}poly}(r, \operatorname{companion}(r, \mathit{av}, (v + 1)), (v + 1)) = \operatorname{monic\text{-}poly}(r, \mathit{av}, (v + 1)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.45}
\begin{cor}[{A degree n polynomial has at most n roots}]\label{thm:poly-roots-at-most-degree}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, k.; \forall p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)), l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (p = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{poly}(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m). \\ \quad \quad (l(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, p, l(i)) = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((l(i) = l(j)) \Rightarrow (i = j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m \leq \operatorname{deg}(k, p) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.47}
\begin{prop}[{Evaluation at n points is bijective on degree $<$ n polynomials iff the points are distinct}]\label{thm:eval-at-points-bijective-iff-distinct}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{eval-at-points-bijective-iff-distinct}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)).\; (h(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{eval\text{-}at\text{-}points}(k, h, m) \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{poly\text{-}le}(k, m), (\operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)) \to \operatorname{carr}(k))) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (h(i) = h(j)) \Rightarrow (i = j) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{poly-interpolation-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, k, h, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)).\; (h(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)). \\ \quad \quad (h(i) = h(j)) \Rightarrow (i = j) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)).\; (v(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(k, p, m) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)).\; (\operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, p, h(i)) = v(i))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{poly-interpolation-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, k, h.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)).\; (h(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)). \\ \quad \quad (h(i) = h(j)) \Rightarrow (i = j) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(k, p, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{deg\text{-}bound}(k, q, m) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (m + 1)). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, p, h(i)) = \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, q, h(i)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad p = q \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.48}
\begin{cor}[{Polynomials over an infinite field are determined by their functions}]\label{thm:poly-determined-by-values}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{poly}(k)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge \neg (|\operatorname{carr}(k)| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (p = q) \Leftrightarrow \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; (\operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, p, a) = \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, q, a)) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}

\begin{cor}[{Functions on a finite field are polynomials}]\label{thm:finite-field-maps-are-polynomials}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge (|\operatorname{carr}(k)| = (m + 1))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\lambda p \in \operatorname{poly\text{-}le}(k, m).\; (\lambda t \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; \operatorname{poly\text{-}eval}(k, p, t))) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{poly\text{-}le}(k, m), (\operatorname{carr}(k) \to \operatorname{carr}(k))) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}

\begin{prop}[{x\textasciicircum{}d = 1 has at most d roots; finite multiplicative group of a field is cyclic}]\label{thm:unity-roots-at-most-d}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall d, m \in \mathbb{N}, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(k) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq d \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m). \\ \quad \quad (l(i) \in \operatorname{carr}(k)) \wedge (\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(k, l(i), d) = \operatorname{one}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((l(i) = l(j)) \Rightarrow (i = j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad m \leq d \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.1}
\begin{prop}[{Order is compatible with addition and multiplication by naturals}]\label{thm:rr-lt-add}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{rr-lt-add}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall x, y, u, v. \\ \quad ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((y \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((u \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((v \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((x < y) \wedge (u \leq v)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (x + u) < (y + v) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{rr-lt-scale-pos}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall c, x, y. \\ \quad ((c \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((x \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((y \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge ((0 < c) \wedge (x < y))))) \Rightarrow ((c \cdot x) < (c \cdot y)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{zz-in-rr}}
\vnbstmt{\forall k \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (k \in \mathbb{R})}
%
\end{prop}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.9}
\begin{prop}[{Fundamental theorem of arithmetic}]\label{thm:prime-factorization-exists}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{prime-factorization-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (1 \leq a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}, p. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p(i)) \wedge (a = \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, p, \operatorname{interval}(1, k)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{prime-factorization-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, p.; \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, q. \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; \operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(q(i)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, p, \operatorname{interval}(1, k)) = \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, q, \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad k = m \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists s \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{interval}(1, k), \operatorname{interval}(1, m)). \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, k). \\ \quad \quad \quad q(s(i)) = p(i) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (1 \leq a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((a \cdot n) \leq b) \wedge (b < ((a \cdot n) + a))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall n, m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((((a \cdot n) \leq b) \wedge (b < ((a \cdot n) + a))) \wedge (((a \cdot m) \leq b) \wedge (b < ((a \cdot m) + a)))) \Rightarrow (n = m) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nn-division}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \neg (b = 0) \Rightarrow \exists q, r \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a = ((q \cdot b) + r)) \wedge ((r + 1) \leq b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{zz-division}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \neg (b = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists q, r \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((a = ((q \cdot b) + r)) \wedge ((r = 0) \vee ((\lvert r \rvert + 1) \leq \lvert b \rvert))) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.12}
\begin{prop}[{Division with remainder (unique)}]\label{thm:nn-division-remainder}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{nn-division-remainder}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (1 \leq a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists n, r \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((b = ((a \cdot n) + r)) \wedge (r < a)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nn-division-remainder-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, n, r, m, s. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b = ((a \cdot n) + r) \wedge \\ \quad r < a \wedge \\ \quad b = ((a \cdot m) + s) \wedge \\ \quad s < a \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (n = m) \wedge (r = s) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nn-division}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \neg (b = 0) \Rightarrow \exists q, r \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((a = ((q \cdot b) + r)) \wedge ((r + 1) \leq b)) \end{array}}

\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.15}
\begin{lem}[{Two steps of the Euclidean algorithm halve a}]\label{thm:euclid-two-steps-halve}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d, f, g. \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad f \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad g \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad b = ((a \cdot c) + d) \wedge \\ \quad d < a \wedge \\ \quad 1 \leq d \wedge \\ \quad a = ((d \cdot f) + g) \wedge \\ \quad g < d \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (2 \cdot g) < a \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.17}
\begin{cor}[{gcd(a,b) lies in the ideal (a, b) (Bezout)}]\label{thm:zz-gcd-in-bezout-set}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{zz-gcd-in-bezout-set}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, g. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge ((b \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd}(a, b, g))) \Rightarrow (g \in \operatorname{zz\text{-}bezout\text{-}set}(a, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{zz-bezout}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge (b \in \mathbb{Z})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \operatorname{zz\text{-}bezout\text{-}set}(a, b).\; (\operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, a) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{zz-bezout-set-is-ideal}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b. \\ \quad ((a \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge (b \in \mathbb{Z})) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}ideal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, \operatorname{zz\text{-}bezout\text{-}set}(a, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{zz-bezout-set-membership}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, z. \\ \quad (z \in \operatorname{zz\text{-}bezout\text{-}set}(a, b)) \Leftrightarrow ((z \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \exists x, y \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (z = ((x \cdot a) + (y \cdot b)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{zz-is-gcd}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd}(a, b, d) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(d, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall e \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(e, a) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(e, b)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(e, d) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%

\begin{prop}[{Inclusion-exclusion for finite families of subsets}]\label{thm:inclusion-exclusion}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall i \in \mathbf{Set}, f.; \forall s \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad ((|i| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (|s| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |\{x \in s : \forall k \in i.\; \neg (x \in f(k))\}| \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field})), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda \mathit{ief} \in \operatorname{power}(i).\; (\operatorname{power}(-1, |\mathit{ief}|) \cdot |\{x \in s : \forall k \in \mathit{ief}.\; (x \in f(k))\}|)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{power}(i)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\begin{prop}[{The Euler totient is multiplicative}]\label{thm:euler-phi-multiplicative}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((1 \leq m) \wedge ((1 \leq n) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(m, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}((m \cdot n)) = (\operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(m) \cdot \operatorname{euler\text{-}phi}(n)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.24}
\begin{lem}[{Multiplicative f bounded if f(p\textasciicircum{}k) $<$= 1 for large prime powers}]\label{thm:multiplicative-bounded}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f.; \forall b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}multiplicative}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \forall p.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}prime\text{-}nat}(p) \wedge (b < \operatorname{power}(p, k))) \Rightarrow (\lvert f(\operatorname{power}(p, k)) \rvert \leq 1)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{mbb} \in \mathbb{R}.\; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq n) \Rightarrow (\lvert f(n) \rvert \leq \mathit{mbb})) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.31}
\begin{thm}[{Chinese remainder theorem for Z}]\label{thm:zz-chinese-remainder}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, n. \\ \quad ((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (n \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Z}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall i, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((i < k) \wedge ((j < k) \wedge \neg (i = j))) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(n(i), n(j)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{Z}). \exists x \in \mathbb{Z}. \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (i < k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(n(i), (x - a(i))) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.39}
\begin{prop}[{Product of cyclic groups is cyclic iff orders pairwise coprime}]\label{thm:cyclic-product-generator}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cyclic-product-generator}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, c, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(b) \wedge \\ \quad |\operatorname{carr}(a)| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad |\operatorname{carr}(b)| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(a, c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(b, d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(\operatorname{group\text{-}prod}(a, b), [c, d]) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(|\operatorname{carr}(a)|, |\operatorname{carr}(b)|) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cyclic-family-product-generator}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m \in \mathbb{N}, f, a. \\ \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad ((1 \leq i) \wedge (i \leq m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(f(i)) \wedge ((|\operatorname{carr}(f(i))| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(f(i), a(i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(\operatorname{group\text{-}famprod}(f, m), \operatorname{group\text{-}famtuple}(a, m)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall b, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad ((1 \leq b) \wedge ((b \leq m) \wedge ((1 \leq j) \wedge ((j \leq m) \wedge \neg (b = j))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}coprime}(|\operatorname{carr}(f(b))|, |\operatorname{carr}(f(j))|) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.3}
\begin{prop}[{Ideals of a Euclidean domain are principal}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-2.3}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{euclidean-ideal-has-generator}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(s) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}ideal}(s, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in i.\; \forall a \in i.\; (a \in \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(s, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{principal-ideal-membership}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, x. \\ \quad (x \in \operatorname{principal\text{-}ideal}(s, a)) \Leftrightarrow ((x \in \operatorname{carr}(s)) \wedge \exists r \in \operatorname{carr}(s).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(s)(r, a))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.3}
\begin{lem}[{A E\_n[k,l] shifts column k to column l}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-3.3}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n, p, k, l.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m), c \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(a))) \wedge ((k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge (l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(a, p, \operatorname{matunit}(a, n, k, l)), i, c) = \left(\text{if }(c = l)\text{ then }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, k)\text{ else }\operatorname{zero}(a)\right) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/matunit-\allowbreak{}shift-\allowbreak{}proof.scm} --- 80 recorded steps.}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.5}
\begin{prop}[{Elementary column operations as matrices}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-3.5}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-f-action}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n, p, k, l.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m), c \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(a, p, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(a, n, k, l)), i, c) \\ \quad \quad =\; \left(\text{if }(c = k)\text{ then }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, l)\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(c = l)\text{ then }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, k)\text{ else }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, c)\right)\right) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-g-action}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n, p, r, k, l.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m), c \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{carr}(a) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(a, p, \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(a, n, r, k, l)), i, c) \\ \quad \quad =\; \left(\text{if }(c = l)\text{ then }\operatorname{add}(a)(\operatorname{entry}(p, i, l), \operatorname{mul}(a)(\operatorname{entry}(p, i, k), r))\text{ else }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, c)\right) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-h-action}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n, p, r, k.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m), c \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(a))) \wedge ((r \in \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge (k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(a, p, \operatorname{elem\text{-}h}(a, n, r, k)), i, c) \\ \quad \quad =\; \left(\text{if }(c = k)\text{ then }\operatorname{mul}(a)(\operatorname{entry}(p, i, k), r)\text{ else }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, c)\right) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.6}
\begin{cor}[{Elementary matrices are invertible}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-3.6}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-f-inverse}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n, k, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge ((l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge \neg (k = l))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(a, n, k, l), \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(a, n, l, k)) = \operatorname{identmat}(a, n) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-g-inverse}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n, r, k, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{carr}(a) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(a, n, r, k, l), \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(a, n, \operatorname{neg}(a)(r), k, l)) = \operatorname{identmat}(a, n) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-h-inverse}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n, r, s, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{carr}(a) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{carr}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(a)(r, s) = \operatorname{one}(a) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}h}(a, n, r, k), \operatorname{elem\text{-}h}(a, n, s, k)) = \operatorname{identmat}(a, n) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-f-invertible}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n, k, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge ((l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge \neg (k = l))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(a, n, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(a, n, k, l)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-g-invertible}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n, r, k, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad r \in \operatorname{carr}(a) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(a, n, \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(a, n, r, k, l)) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.8}
\begin{lem}[{Column reduction of the first row over a field}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-3.8}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{col-reduce-first-row}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((1 \leq m) \wedge ((1 \leq n) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)))))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(2, n).\; (\operatorname{entry}(b, 1, j) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{entry}(b, 1, 1) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \vee (\operatorname{entry}(b, 1, 1) = \operatorname{one}(r)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{column-step-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists e.\; (\operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, e) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}column\text{-}step}(r, m, n, e)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{clear-first-row}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n.; \forall p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(a)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad 1 \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(p, 1, 1) = \operatorname{zero}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c, i, b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(a, m, n, p, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad b \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(c, i, b) = \operatorname{zero}(a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{gauge}(a)(\operatorname{entry}(p, 1, 1)) \leq \operatorname{gauge}(a)(\operatorname{entry}(c, i, b)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists q. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(a, m, n, p, q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(q, 1, 1) = \operatorname{entry}(p, 1, 1) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\neg (j = 1) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(q, 1, j) = \operatorname{zero}(a))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{class-min-pivot}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n.; \forall p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(a)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad 1 \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \exists d \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m), f \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(p, d, f) = \operatorname{zero}(a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(a, m, n, p, b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(b, 1, 1) = \operatorname{zero}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c, i, j. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(a, m, n, p, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(c, i, j) = \operatorname{zero}(a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{gauge}(a)(\operatorname{entry}(b, 1, 1)) \leq \operatorname{gauge}(a)(\operatorname{entry}(c, i, j)) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{col-reduce-first-row}}}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/la-\allowbreak{}z6-\allowbreak{}col.scm} --- 70 recorded steps.}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((s \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge (a \in \mathrm{Bij}(s, s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{monalg}(r, \operatorname{multi\text{-}index\text{-}monoid}(s)), \operatorname{monalg}(r, \operatorname{multi\text{-}index\text{-}monoid}(s)), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda f \in \operatorname{finsupp}(r, \operatorname{multi\text{-}index\text{-}monoid}(s)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(r, \operatorname{multi\text{-}index\text{-}monoid}(s), (\lambda b \in (s \to \mathbb{N}).\; \operatorname{mi\text{-}reindex}(s, a, b)), f))) \end{array}}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, h, s. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}monoid}(m) \wedge \\ \quad h \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in (\operatorname{carr}(m) \to \operatorname{carr}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (s(h(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (h(s(u)) = u) \wedge \\ \quad \forall u, v \in \operatorname{carr}(m).\; (h(\operatorname{opr}(m)(u, v)) = \operatorname{opr}(m)(h(u), h(v))) \wedge \\ \quad h(\operatorname{iden}(m)) = \operatorname{iden}(m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}iso\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{monalg}(a, m), \operatorname{monalg}(a, m), (\lambda f \in \operatorname{finsupp}(a, m).\; \operatorname{monalg\text{-}pullback}(a, m, h, f))) \end{array}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.18}
\begin{prop}[{det is multilinear and alternating in rows and columns}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-3.18}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-row-linear}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, b, c, p, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \neg (i = p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(b, i, k) = \operatorname{entry}(a, i, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \neg (i = p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(c, i, k) = \operatorname{entry}(a, i, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(c, p, k) = \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(d, \operatorname{entry}(a, p, k)), \operatorname{entry}(b, p, k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, n, c) = \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(d, \operatorname{det}(r, n, a)), \operatorname{det}(r, n, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-col-linear}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, b, c, p, d. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j, i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \neg (j = p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(b, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(a, i, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j, i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \neg (j = p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(c, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(a, i, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(c, i, p) = \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(d, \operatorname{entry}(a, i, p)), \operatorname{entry}(b, i, p)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, n, c) = \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(d, \operatorname{det}(r, n, a)), \operatorname{det}(r, n, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-swap-rows}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, b, p, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (p = q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad (\neg (i = p) \wedge \neg (i = q)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(b, i, k) = \operatorname{entry}(a, i, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{entry}(b, p, k) = \operatorname{entry}(a, q, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{entry}(b, q, k) = \operatorname{entry}(a, p, k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, n, b) = \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, a)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-swap-cols}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, b, p, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (p = q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j, i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad (\neg (j = p) \wedge \neg (j = q)) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(b, i, j) = \operatorname{entry}(a, i, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{entry}(b, i, p) = \operatorname{entry}(a, i, q)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{entry}(b, i, q) = \operatorname{entry}(a, i, p)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, n, b) = \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, a)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-alternating-rows}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, p, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (p = q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{entry}(a, p, k) = \operatorname{entry}(a, q, k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, n, a) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-equal-cols-zero}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, p, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad q \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (p = q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{entry}(a, i, p) = \operatorname{entry}(a, i, q)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, n, a) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-transpose}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{transpose}(a, n, n)) = \operatorname{det}(r, n, a) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.19}
\begin{cor}[{det and elementary column operations}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-3.19}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-elem-f-col}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, k, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(r, n, k, l))) = \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, a)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-elem-g-col}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, c, k, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(r, n, c, k, l))) = \operatorname{det}(r, n, a) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-elem-h-col}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, c, k. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}h}(r, n, c, k))) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, \operatorname{det}(r, n, a)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-mul-elem-f-col}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, k, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(r, n, k, l))) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, a), \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(r, n, k, l))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-mul-elem-g-col}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, c, k, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(r, n, c, k, l))) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, a), \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{elem\text{-}g}(r, n, c, k, l))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-mul-elem-h-col}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.20}
\begin{cor}[{det(A V) = det A det V for invertible V}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-3.20}

\vnbpart{\texttt{det-mul-invertible}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, v. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}field\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(r, n, v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, v)) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, a), \operatorname{det}(r, n, v)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-multiplicative}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, p, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))) \wedge (q \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, q)) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, p), \operatorname{det}(r, n, q)) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.22}
\begin{prop}[{Expansion by minors}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-3.22}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-expand-row}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, (n + 1), a) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mpow}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}monoid}(r), \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{one}(r)), (i + j)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(a, i, j), \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{minor}(a, i, j, n))))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-expand-col}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, (n + 1), a) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda e \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)).\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mpow}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}monoid}(r), \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{one}(r)), (e + j)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(a, e, j), \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{minor}(a, e, j, n))))), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-cofactor}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{det}(r, (n + 1), a) \simeq \operatorname{finsum}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(r), (\lambda j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)).\; \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{mpow}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}multiplicative\text{-}monoid}(r), \operatorname{neg}(r)(\operatorname{one}(r)), (j + 1)), \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(a, 1, j), \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{minor}(a, 1, j, n))))), \operatorname{interval}(1, (n + 1)))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\begin{prop}[{Adjugate: A adj(A) = det A I (Cramer)}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-3.25}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{adj-mul}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{adj}(r, n, a), a) = \operatorname{matscale}(r, \operatorname{det}(r, (n + 1), a), \operatorname{identmat}(r, (n + 1))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{mul-adj}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{adj}(r, n, a)) = \operatorname{matscale}(r, \operatorname{det}(r, (n + 1), a), \operatorname{identmat}(r, (n + 1))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cramer-inverse}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}((n + 1), (n + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, (n + 1), a), b) = \operatorname{one}(r) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{matscale}(r, b, \operatorname{adj}(r, n, a))) = \operatorname{identmat}(r, (n + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{matmul}(r, \operatorname{matscale}(r, b, \operatorname{adj}(r, n, a)), a) = \operatorname{identmat}(r, (n + 1)) \end{array}}

\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.27}
\begin{prop}[{det is multiplicative}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-3.27}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-multiplicative}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, p, q. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((p \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))) \wedge (q \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, p, q)) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, p), \operatorname{det}(r, n, q)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-alternating-form}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, d, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad d \in (\operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \to \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dfa}, b, c, p, s. \\ \quad \quad \mathit{dfa} \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad p \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad s \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall i, k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (i = p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(b, i, k) = \operatorname{entry}(\mathit{dfa}, i, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall i, k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (i = p) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{entry}(c, i, k) = \operatorname{entry}(\mathit{dfa}, i, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(c, p, k) = \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(s, \operatorname{entry}(\mathit{dfa}, p, k)), \operatorname{entry}(b, p, k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad d(c) = \operatorname{add}(r)(\operatorname{mul}(r)(s, d(\mathit{dfa})), d(b)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dfa}, p, q. \\ \quad \quad \mathit{dfa} \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad p \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad q \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (p = q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{entry}(\mathit{dfa}, p, k) = \operatorname{entry}(\mathit{dfa}, q, k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad d(\mathit{dfa}) = \operatorname{zero}(r) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad d(a) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, a), d(\operatorname{identmat}(r, n))) \end{array}}

\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{3.31}
\begin{cor}[{gcd of s-minors is an invariant (integers)}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-3.31}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{sdet-gcd-invariant}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, s, a, b, d, e. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd\text{-}set}(\operatorname{sdet}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, a, s), d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd\text{-}set}(\operatorname{sdet}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, b, s), e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (d = e) \vee (d = -e) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sdet-divisor-equiv}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, s, c, a, b.; \forall x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, b, s). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(r, m, n, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{sdet}(r, m, n, a, s).\; \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}
%

((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(d, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(d, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall b \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, b) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(b, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(b, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(b, j, j)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad b = d \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{integer-normal-form-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, a. \\ \quad ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, a, d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(d, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(d, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{diagonal-normal-form-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, d, a. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(d, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(a, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(d, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(a, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(a, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{elem\text{-}equiv}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad d = a \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{diagonal-normal-form-unique-invertible}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, d, a, b, c. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(d, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m).\; ((i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \Rightarrow (0 \leq \operatorname{entry}(a, i, i))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(d, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{ci}, j. \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \mathit{ci} \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(a, \mathit{ci}, \mathit{ci}), \operatorname{entry}(a, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, c) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, b, d), c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad d = a \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{diagonal-chain-sdet-gcd}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, n, d, s. \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad d \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}diagonal}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i, j. \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \quad i \leq j \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(\operatorname{entry}(d, i, i), \operatorname{entry}(d, j, j)) \wedge \\ \quad s \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad s \leq m \wedge \\ \quad s \leq n \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}is\text{-}gcd\text{-}set}(\operatorname{sdet}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, m, n, d, s), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, s).\; \operatorname{entry}(d, k, k)), \operatorname{interval}(1, s))) \end{array}}

\begin{cor}[{Invertible integer matrices are products of elementary matrices}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-3.38}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{zz-invertible-iff-elementary-product}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, u) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists p, q \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n). \\ \quad \quad u = \operatorname{matmul}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, p, q) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{euclidean-invertible-iff-elem-gen}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}mat}(r, n, u) \Leftrightarrow (u \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{euclidean-unit-det-elem-gen}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, u), s) = \operatorname{one}(r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad u \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-gen-det-unit}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (p \in \operatorname{elem\text{-}gen}(r, n)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists s \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, p), s) = \operatorname{one}(r)) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%

\begin{cor}[{Absolute determinant of change of basis is independent of choices}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-3.45}
%

\vnbpart{\texttt{norm-independent}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, s, s_{2}, a, b, m, c, m_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad s \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad s_{2} \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, s_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, s_{2}) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, a, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{spans}(d, n, b, m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, b) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad m_{2} \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{matact}(d, c, s) \wedge \\ \quad b = \operatorname{matact}(d, m_{2}, s_{2}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \lvert \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, m_{2}) \rvert = \lvert \operatorname{det}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, c) \rvert \end{array}}

\begin{cor}[{Subgroup of a free abelian group of rank n is free of rank $<$= n}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-3.46}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d.; \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)), m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{scal}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists k. \\ \quad \quad \quad (((k \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (k \leq n)) \wedge \exists w \in \operatorname{mat}(k, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)).\; (\operatorname{spans}(d, k, w, m) \wedge \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, k, w))) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, n, u, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad u \in \operatorname{mat}(n, 1, \operatorname{vec}(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{generates}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{submodule\text{-}norm}(d, m) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}module}(d, m))| = \operatorname{submodule\text{-}norm}(d, m) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cyclic-dsum-card}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, m. \\ \quad ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((m \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \mathbb{Z})) \wedge \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (1 \leq \operatorname{entry}(m, i, i)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, (\lambda \mathit{fmi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(\operatorname{entry}(m, \mathit{fmi}, \mathit{fmi}))))) \in \mathbf{Set} \wedge \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, (\lambda \mathit{fmi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(\operatorname{entry}(m, \mathit{fmi}, \mathit{fmi})))))| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{direct\text{-}sum}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, n, (\lambda \mathit{fmi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(\operatorname{entry}(m, \mathit{fmi}, \mathit{fmi})))))| \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; \operatorname{entry}(m, k, k)), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{principal-sequence-of-presentation}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, n, u, s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}module}(d) \wedge ((\operatorname{scal}(d) = \operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(d, m) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}norm\text{-}data}(d, m, n, u, s, a)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b, c. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}principal\text{-}sequence}(d, n, m, b, c) \wedge \operatorname{rel\text{-}free}(d, n, \operatorname{matact}(d, c, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{dsum-card}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n, f. \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (\operatorname{vec}(f(i)) \in \mathbf{Set}) \wedge \\ \quad \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; (|\operatorname{vec}(f(i))| \in \mathbb{N}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f)| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad |\operatorname{dsum\text{-}vec}(n, f)| \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{prod\text{-}ring}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}ring}, (\lambda k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n).\; |\operatorname{vec}(f(k))|), \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{zz-mod-card}}
\vnbstmt{\forall b \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((1 \leq b) \Rightarrow (|\operatorname{vec}(\operatorname{zz\text{-}mod}(b))| = b))}
\vnbpart{\texttt{card-cartesian}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad ((|a| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (|b| \in \mathbb{N})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad |(a \times b)| = (|a| \cdot |b|) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.3}
\begin{prop}[{C is algebraically closed}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-4.3}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}), m \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \neg (p((m + 1)) = 0) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (p(k) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, k))), ((m + 1) + 1)) = 0 \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.18}
\begin{prop}[{r algebraic over a ring A iff finitely generated A-module V with rV in V}]\label{thm:algebraic-iff-invariant-module}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{algebraic-iff-invariant-module}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge (r \in \mathbb{C})) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, r) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists v. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}fg\text{-}cc\text{-}module\text{-}over}(a, v) \wedge (\exists z \in v.\; \neg (z = 0) \wedge \forall \mathit{amrv} \in v.\; ((r \cdot \mathit{amrv}) \in v))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{algebraic-of-invariant-module}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r, v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}fg\text{-}cc\text{-}module\text{-}over}(a, v) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z \in v.\; \neg (z = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{amrv} \in v.\; ((r \cdot \mathit{amrv}) \in v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, r) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{invariant-module-of-algebraic}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, r)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists v. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}fg\text{-}cc\text{-}module\text{-}over}(a, v) \wedge (\exists z \in v.\; \neg (z = 0) \wedge \forall \mathit{amrv} \in v.\; ((r \cdot \mathit{amrv}) \in v))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{algebraic-monic-of-invariant-space}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r, v, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}space\text{-}dim\text{-}le}(a, v, m) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z \in v.\; \neg (z = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{amrv} \in v.\; ((r \cdot \mathit{amrv}) \in v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad n \leq m \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists c \in (\mathbb{N} \to a). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((n + 1) \leq k) \Rightarrow (c(k) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad c(n) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(r, j))), (n + 1)) = 0 \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{invariant-space-of-relation}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r, g, c. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad g \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((g + 1) \leq k) \Rightarrow (c(k) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad c(g) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(r, j))), (g + 1)) = 0 \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists v. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}space\text{-}dim\text{-}le}(a, v, g) \wedge (\exists z \in v.\; \neg (z = 0) \wedge \forall \mathit{amrv} \in v.\; ((r \cdot \mathit{amrv}) \in v))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.19}
\begin{cor}[{Algebraic elements over A form a subring}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-subring}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{algebraic-numbers-subring}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(\{q \in \mathbb{C} : \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, q)\}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{algebraic-add-mul}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, r) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, (r + s)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, (r \cdot s)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{algebraic-neg}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, r)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(a, -r) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{algebraic-of-ring-element}}
\vnbstmt{\forall b, a.\; ((\operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(b) \wedge (a \in b)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}over}(b, a))}
%
\end{cor}
%
