\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.22}
\begin{prop}[{theta algebraic of degree $<$= n over K iff K-subspace V of dim $<$= n with theta V $<$= V}]\label{thm:algebraic-degree-iff-invariant-space}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{algebraic-degree-iff-invariant-space}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, h, n. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subfield\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(k) \wedge ((h \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge (n \in \mathbb{N}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}of\text{-}degree\text{-}le}(k, h, n) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \exists v. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}space\text{-}dim\text{-}le}(k, v, n) \wedge (\exists z \in v.\; \neg (z = 0) \wedge \forall \mathit{amrv} \in v.\; ((h \cdot \mathit{amrv}) \in v))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{algebraic-degree-of-invariant-space}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, r, v, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subring\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(a) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{C} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}space\text{-}dim\text{-}le}(a, v, m) \wedge \\ \quad \exists z \in v.\; \neg (z = 0) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{amrv} \in v.\; ((r \cdot \mathit{amrv}) \in v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}algebraic\text{-}of\text{-}degree\text{-}le}(a, r, m) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{algebraic-degree-iff-invariant-space}}}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/algebraic-\allowbreak{}numbers.scm} --- 67 recorded steps.}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Lemmas.} \texttt{monic-of-leading}, \texttt{invariant-space-of-relation}, \texttt{cc-space-dim-le-mono}, \texttt{algebraic-degree-of-invariant-space}.}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Oracles.} \texttt{crs}, \texttt{arith}, \texttt{ineq}.  \textbf{Bill:} \texttt{proven modulo 0}.}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.24}
\begin{prop}[{The field of algebraic numbers is algebraically closed}]\label{thm:algebraic-numbers-algebraically-closed}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{algebraic-numbers-algebraically-closed}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, c, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}subfield\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(k) \wedge ((c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{algebraic\text{-}numbers\text{-}over}(k))) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge \neg (c((m + 1)) = 0)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \operatorname{algebraic\text{-}numbers\text{-}over}(k). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), ((m + 1) + 1)) = 0 \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{algebraic-numbers-factorization}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, c, n. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subfield\text{-}of\text{-}cc}(k) \wedge \\ \quad c \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{algebraic\text{-}numbers\text{-}over}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{pfk} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((n + 1) \leq \mathit{pfk}) \Rightarrow (c(\mathit{pfk}) = 0)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (c(n) = 0) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{C}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall i \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((i < n) \Rightarrow (r(i) \in \operatorname{algebraic\text{-}numbers\text{-}over}(k))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}series\text{-}partial\text{-}sum}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; (c(j) \cdot \operatorname{power}(z, j))), (n + 1)) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad =\; c(n) \cdot \operatorname{cc\text{-}partial\text{-}prod}((\lambda \mathit{cfi} \in \mathbb{N}.\; (z - r(\mathit{cfi}))), n) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{algebraic-numbers-algebraically-closed}}}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/algebraic-\allowbreak{}numbers.scm} --- 51 recorded steps.}
%

%

%

%

\vnbprf{\textbf{Oracles.} \texttt{crs}, \texttt{ineq}, \texttt{arith}, \texttt{sos}.  \textbf{Bill:} \texttt{proven modulo 0}.}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.44}
\begin{lem}[{Finite abelian group with at most d elements of order dividing d is cyclic}]\label{thm:finite-group-cyclic-criterion}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad |\operatorname{carr}(g)| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \forall d \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad (1 \leq d) \Rightarrow (|\{y \in \operatorname{carr}(g) : (\operatorname{gpow}(g, y, d) = \operatorname{iden}(g))\}| \leq d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists x.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}generator}(g, x) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%

\begin{prop}[{Isom(X): convergence is pointwise, compact}]\label{thm:compact-groups-1.5}
%

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge ((a \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s))) \wedge (g \in \operatorname{isometry\text{-}group}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{isometry\text{-}group\text{-}ms}(s), a, g) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s).\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(s, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; a(k)(x)), g(x)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{isometry-group-compact}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.12}
\begin{lem}[{Convex hull of a totally bounded set is totally bounded}]\label{thm:conv-hull-totally-bounded}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{conv-hull-totally-bounded}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((e \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}totally\text{-}bounded\text{-}in}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), e))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}totally\text{-}bounded\text{-}in}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), \operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(m, e)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{conv-hull-finite-totally-bounded}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall m.; \forall a \in \mathbf{Set}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}vector\text{-}space}(m) \wedge ((|a| \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (a \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}totally\text{-}bounded\text{-}in}(\operatorname{nvs\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m), \operatorname{conv\text{-}hull}(m, a)) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.7}
\begin{lem}[{Connected component of a topological group is a closed normal subgroup}]\label{thm:top-group-component-normal-subgroup}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{top-group-component-normal-subgroup}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normal\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{top-group-open-subgroup-complement-open}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), h) \wedge (h \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \{z \in \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) : \neg (z \in h)\} \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{top-group-open-connected-subgroup-is-component}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), h) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), h) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h = \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{connected-component-connected}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, x)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{connected-component-intro}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, c, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}space}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}connected\text{-}t}(s, c) \wedge ((x \in c) \wedge (y \in c)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad y \in \operatorname{connected\text{-}component}(s, x) \end{array}}

\end{lem}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.33}
\begin{lem}[{Open normal subgroup of a compact metric group has finite index}]\label{thm:top-group-compact-finitely-many-cosets}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, h. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), h) \wedge \\ \quad h \in \operatorname{opens}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad f \subseteq \operatorname{pts\text{-}left\text{-}cosets}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad |f| \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{big\text{-}union}(u, f, u) \simeq \operatorname{pts}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g))) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/cg4-\allowbreak{}cosets.scm} --- 7 recorded steps.}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Lemmas.} \texttt{top-group-space-is-top-space}, \texttt{top-group-group-is-group}, \texttt{top-group-group-topology}, \texttt{top-group-compact-finitely-many-cosets-gt}.}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Oracles.} none.  \textbf{Bill:} \texttt{proven modulo 0}.}
%
\end{proof}
%
\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} Generalised: in a compact topological group G, finitely many left cosets of any open subgroup H cover G. This is G/H finite, stated without the quotient (no DESCEND). Neither the invariant metric nor normality is needed: the cosets are an open cover.

\begin{prop}[{One-parameter group segments extend}]\label{thm:one-parameter-group-extension-unique}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall g, l, i, a, b.; \forall t \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group\text{-}segment}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), l, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}one\text{-}parameter\text{-}group}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}one\text{-}parameter\text{-}group}(\operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}space}(g), \operatorname{top\text{-}group\text{-}group}(g), b) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l).\; (a(t) = i(t)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall t \in \operatorname{ccint}(0, l).\; (b(t) = i(t)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(t) = b(t) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.3}
\begin{prop}[{Cauchy-Schwarz inequality}]\label{thm:fourier-integrals-1.3}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cips-schwarz}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) \cdot \operatorname{conjugate}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y))) \leq (\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sip-schwarz}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y) \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, y)) \leq (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x) \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sip-schwarz-csip-as-sip}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(r). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(r) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{r}(x, y) \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{r}(x, y)) \leq (\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{r}(x, x) \cdot \langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{r}(y, y)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.4}
\begin{prop}[{The Hilbert norm is a norm}]\label{thm:fourier-integrals-1.4}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ip-normed-ag-is-normed-ag}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sip-normed-ag-is-normed-ag}}
\vnbstmt{\forall v.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}pre\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{sip\text{-}normed\text{-}ag}(v)))}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cips-minkowski}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, y. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (y \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y) \rVert \leq (\lVert x \rVert + \lVert y \rVert) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{sip-minkowski}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y))} \leq (\sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, x)} + \sqrt{\langle\cdot\mid\cdot\rangle_{v}(y, y)}) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.5}
\begin{prop}[{Polarization identity}]\label{thm:fourier-integrals-1.5}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}semi\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}sesquilinear\text{-}form}(v, f)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad 4 \cdot f(x, y) \\ \quad \quad =\; (((f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) - f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(y)))) + (+i \cdot f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y))))) - (+i \cdot f(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y))), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(\operatorname{cact}(v)(+i, y)))))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.8}
\begin{lem}[{Triangle inequality for countable sums in L2}]\label{thm:fourier-integrals-1.8}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, u, f, g.; \forall p \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(a, b, u) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}measurable\text{-}fn}(a, b, g) \wedge (1 \leq p)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad I_{p}({\operatorname{ptwise\text{-}eplus}(a, f, g)}) \leq \operatorname{eplus}(I_{p}({f}), I_{p}({g})) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.11}
\begin{prop}[{Closest point in a closed convex set}]\label{thm:hilbert-closest-point-midpoint}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{hilbert-closest-point-midpoint}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \exists e.\; (e \in k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m_{1}, m_{2} \in k.\; (\operatorname{act}(v)(1/2, \operatorname{vadd}(v)(m_{1}, m_{2})) \in k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in k. \forall \mathit{hdp} \in k. \\ \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\mathit{hdp}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\mathit{hdp}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{hilbert-closest-point}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in k. \forall \mathit{hdp} \in k. \\ \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\mathit{hdp}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\mathit{hdp}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cips-midpoint-estimate-midpoint}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i, a, p_{1}, p_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad k \subseteq \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m_{1}, m_{2} \in k.\; (\operatorname{act}(v)(1/2, \operatorname{vadd}(v)(m_{1}, m_{2})) \in k) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in k. \\ \quad \quad a \leq \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \wedge \\ \quad p_{1} \in k \wedge \\ \quad p_{2} \in k \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{1}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(p_{2})), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{1}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(p_{2}))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (((2 \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{1}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{1}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)))) + (2 \cdot \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{2}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p_{2}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))))) - (4 \cdot a)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{hilbert-closest-point-midpoint}}}
%
\vnbprf{\textbf{Proof.} \texttt{theorem-\allowbreak{}library/hilbert-\allowbreak{}projection.scm} --- 650 recorded steps.}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.12}
\begin{thm}[{Orthogonal projection theorem}]\label{thm:fourier-integrals-1.12}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{hilbert-projection-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in k, b \in {k}^{\perp}.\; (i = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{hilbert-projection-point}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in k.\; (\operatorname{vadd}(v)(i, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)) \in {k}^{\perp}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{hilbert-decomposition-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a_{1}, a_{2}, b_{1}, b_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad a_{1} \in k \wedge \\ \quad a_{2} \in k \wedge \\ \quad b_{1} \in {k}^{\perp} \wedge \\ \quad b_{2} \in {k}^{\perp} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a_{1}, b_{1}) = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a_{2}, b_{2}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (a_{1} = a_{2}) \wedge (b_{1} = b_{2}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{orthogonal-projection-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists \mathit{hpk}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, \mathit{hpk}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{orthogonal-projection-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.15}
\begin{thm}[{Riesz representation theorem for Hilbert space}]\label{thm:fourier-integrals-1.15}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{riesz-representation}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(v, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{vec}(v). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) \leq (\lVert x \rVert \cdot \lVert e \rVert)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((0 \leq c) \wedge \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(f(x)) \leq (c \cdot \lVert x \rVert))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \lVert e \rVert \leq c \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{riesz-representation-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cc\text{-}linear\text{-}functional}(v, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}continuous}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), \operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}, f) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{riesz-representation-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, f, e_{1}, e_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad e_{1} \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad e_{2} \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e_{1})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(v).\; (f(x) = \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(x, e_{2})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad e_{1} = e_{2} \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.21}
\begin{prop}[{Orthogonal projections are the self-adjoint idempotents}]\label{thm:orthogonal-projection-idempotent}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{orthogonal-projection-idempotent}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(a(x)) = a(x) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{orthogonal-projection-fixes}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge \\ \quad y \in k \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(y) = y \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{orthogonal-projection-type}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \Rightarrow (a \in (\operatorname{vec}(v) \to \operatorname{vec}(v))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{orthogonal-projection-additive}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a, x, y. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(x, y)) = \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a(x), a(y)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\begin{lem}[{Method I outer measure of a clopen union}]\label{thm:rmc-premeasure}

\vnbpart{\texttt{rmc-outer-on-clopen}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, m, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, m) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{method\text{-}i\text{-}outer}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s), (\lambda u \in \operatorname{clopen\text{-}sets}(s).\; m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), u))))(a) \\ \quad \quad =\; m(\operatorname{indicator}(\operatorname{pts}(s), a)) \end{array}}

\end{lem}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.31}
\begin{prop}[{Riesz-Markov for totally disconnected compact spaces}]\label{thm:fourier-integrals-2.31}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{rmz-riesz-markov}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge (\exists x.\; (x \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u, f) \wedge (\operatorname{rintegral}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u, f) = a(f))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{rmz-riesz-markov-dense}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, q, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(s) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}dense\text{-}seq}(s, q) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}positive\text{-}functional}(s, x))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists u. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}measure}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall f \in \operatorname{cont\text{-}fns}(s). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}integrable}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u, f) \wedge (\operatorname{rintegral}(\operatorname{pts}(s), \operatorname{borel\text{-}sets}(s), u, f) = x(f))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{rmc-riesz-markov-k}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.2}
\begin{prop}[{A separating family of seminorms gives a vector space topology}]\label{thm:fourier-integrals-5.2}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{frm-add-continuous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, c, f, g, a, b. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, c) \wedge \\ \quad f \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{vec}(m) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, c), f, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, c), g, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, c), (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{vadd}(m)(f(n), g(n))), \operatorname{vadd}(m)(a, b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{frm-ball-seminorm}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x, y. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(m)) \wedge (\operatorname{dist}(\operatorname{fr\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(m, a))(x, y) < l))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad a(k)(\operatorname{vadd}(m)(x, \operatorname{vneg}(m)(y))) < s \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.3}
\begin{prop}[{Continuity of linear maps between seminormed spaces}]\label{thm:fourier-integrals-5.3}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{frm-cont-lin-iff-bound}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \exists g \in \mathbb{N}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq g) \Rightarrow (b(j)(x) \leq r)) \Rightarrow (f(k)(t(x)) \leq (h \cdot r)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{frm-bound-of-cont-lin}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, b, c, f, t.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, c, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, c, t) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivially\text{-}valued}(d) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}cont\text{-}lin}(a, b, c, f, t) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \mathbb{N}, h. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(h) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq g) \Rightarrow (b(j)(x) \leq r)) \Rightarrow (f(k)(t(x)) \leq (h \cdot r)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{fbs-ball-bound}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, a, f, g, h, t.; \forall c, b \in \operatorname{carr}(d), k, m, l, n.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, a, f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, g, h) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}map}(a, g, t) \wedge \\ \quad 1 < \operatorname{fnrm}(d)(c) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(d)(c, b) = \operatorname{one}(d) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(n) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq m) \Rightarrow (f(j)(x) < l)) \Rightarrow (h(k)(t(x)) \leq n) \wedge \\ \quad \forall j \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((j \leq m) \Rightarrow (f(j)(x) \leq r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad h(k)(t(x)) \leq (((\operatorname{fnrm}(d)(c) \cdot n) \cdot \operatorname{recip}(l)) \cdot r) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{11.8}
\begin{cor}[{H2\_loc(C\textasciicircum{}n) is a Frechet space}]\label{thm:fourier-integrals-11.8}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cc-cont-fns-frechet}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall u. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}), u) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}normed\text{-}field}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}fn\text{-}module}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{cc\text{-}exhaust\text{-}seminorms}(u, \operatorname{cc\text{-}cont\text{-}fns}(u))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{is-frechet-structure}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall d, m, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}frechet\text{-}structure}(d, m, a) \\ \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{is\text{-}seminorm\text{-}family}(d, m, a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{vec}(m)). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fr\text{-}cauchy}(m, a, q) \Rightarrow \exists b \in \operatorname{vec}(m).\; \operatorname{fr\text{-}conv}(m, a, q, b) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.2}
\begin{prop}[{Nested or equal balls in an ultrametric}]\label{thm:ultra-closed-ball-nested}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ultra-closed-ball-nested}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, r, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \leq r \wedge \\ \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, a, r).\; (x \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, b, q)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, b, q) \subseteq \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, a, r) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ultra-ball-nested}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, r, q. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad q \leq r \wedge \\ \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{ball}(s, a, r).\; (x \in \operatorname{ball}(s, b, q)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(s, b, q) \subseteq \operatorname{ball}(s, a, r) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ultra-closed-ball-equal}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, a, r).\; (x \in \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, b, r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, a, r) = \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, b, r) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ultra-ball-equal}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, b, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad b \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \exists x \in \operatorname{ball}(s, a, r).\; (x \in \operatorname{ball}(s, b, r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{ball}(s, a, r) = \operatorname{ball}(s, b, r) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ultra-le}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x, y, z, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, z) \leq r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(z, y) \leq r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y) \leq r \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ultra-lt}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x, y, z, r. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad r \in \mathbb{R} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, z) < r \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(z, y) < r \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y) < r \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.3}
\begin{prop}[{Balls in an ultrametric are clopen}]\label{thm:ultra-closed-ball-open}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ultra-closed-ball-open}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, a, r)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ultra-ball-closed}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, a, r. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{pts}(s)) \wedge ((r \in \mathbb{R}) \wedge (0 < r)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, \operatorname{ball}(s, a, r)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{closed-ball-is-closed}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall c \in \operatorname{pts}(s), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(s, \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(s, c, r)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ball-is-open}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s.; \forall x \in \operatorname{pts}(s), r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(s) \wedge ((0 \leq r) \wedge \neg (0 = r))) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(s, \operatorname{ball}(s, x, r)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall s, x, y, z. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ultrametric}(s) \wedge \\ \quad x \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad y \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad z \in \operatorname{pts}(s) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(z, y) < \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, z) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, y) = \operatorname{dist}(s)(x, z) \end{array}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.17}
\begin{prop}[{Valuation ring of the fraction field}]\label{thm:nv-domain-integral}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-domain-integral}}
\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.; \forall x \in a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)))}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-integers-iff-divisibility}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}fractions\text{-}of}(k, a)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \forall x, y \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(y)) \Rightarrow \exists l \in a.\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(k)(l, y)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-1-22}}

\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-residue-fp-iso}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, k, a, o. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad o \in (\mathbb{Z} \to a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m, n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad (o((m + n)) = \operatorname{add}(k)(o(m), o(n))) \wedge (o((m \cdot n)) = \operatorname{mul}(k)(o(m), o(n))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (o(-m) = \operatorname{neg}(k)(o(m))) \wedge \\ \quad o(0) = \operatorname{zero}(k) \wedge \\ \quad o(1) = \operatorname{one}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((o(m) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in a. \exists m \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(k)(b, \operatorname{neg}(k)(o(m))) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}ring\text{-}iso}(\operatorname{fp}(p), \operatorname{nv\text{-}residue}(k, a), f) \end{array}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.24}
\begin{prop}[{Ostrowski for non-archimedean valuations on Q}]\label{thm:ccr-1-24}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f \in (\mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f)) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}nv}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}nv}(f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 0 < r \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad r < 1 \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \mathbb{Q}, a, b \in \mathbb{Z}, i, j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\neg (x = 0) \wedge (\neg (b = 0) \wedge (((x \cdot b) = a) \wedge (\operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, a, i) \wedge \operatorname{zz\text{-}ord\text{-}is}(p, b, j))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (f(x) \cdot \operatorname{power}(r, j)) = \operatorname{power}(r, i) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\begin{prop}[{Open subgroups of Zp are principal ideals}]\label{thm:ccr-1-30}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-1-30}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), u) \wedge \\ \quad u \subseteq \operatorname{zp}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), \operatorname{zp}(p)), u) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p), u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{zp}(p).\; (u = \operatorname{nv\text{-}multiples}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p), g)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-4-13}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), u) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (u = \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p), u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)).\; (u = \operatorname{nv\text{-}multiples}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p), g)) \end{array}}

\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.32}
\begin{prop}[{Order and p\textasciicircum{}k x in Zp}]\label{thm:ccr-1-32}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-1-32}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, -\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x)), x) \in \operatorname{zp}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall q \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, q), x) \in \operatorname{zp}(p)) \Rightarrow (-\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x) \leq q) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-1-31}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x) \in \mathbb{Z}) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}. \exists x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \wedge (\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x) = n) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{qo-ppow-abs}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k) \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k) = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k)) = {2}^{-k} \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{qo-ord-value}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), m \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(x) = {2}^{m})) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x) = -m) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.33}
\begin{rem}[{-ord\_p(x) $>$= 0: the order of x mod Z\_p is p\textasciicircum{}(-ord\_p x)}]\label{thm:ccr-1-33}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-1-33}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \wedge (0 \leq -\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad -\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x) \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))), \operatorname{zp}(p)), x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{power}(p, -\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{qp-pruefer-order}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \wedge (-\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x) = n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))), \operatorname{zp}(p)), x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{power}(p, n)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{qag-pow-iden-iff}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, g, h.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(g). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}abelian\text{-}group}(g) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}subgroup}(g, h)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gpow}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h), \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(g), h), a), n) = \operatorname{iden}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(g, h)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{gpow}(g, a, n) \in h \end{array}}
%
\end{rem}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.43}
\begin{prop}[{Gauss lemma for content}]\label{thm:nv-gauss-content-one}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-gauss-content-one}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{finsupp}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}content\text{-}one}(k, p) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}content\text{-}one}(k, q))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}content\text{-}one}(k, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, p, q)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-strict-dominance}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) < \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(y))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{add}(k)(x, y)) = \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(y) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.44}
\begin{prop}[{Content is a valuation}]\label{thm:nv-content-multiplicative}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-content-multiplicative}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{finsupp}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}), c, d \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge ((0 < c) \wedge ((0 < d) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}content}(k, p, c) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}content}(k, q, d))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}content}(k, \operatorname{monalg\text{-}mul}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, p, q), (c \cdot d)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-content-ultra}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall p, q \in \operatorname{finsupp}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}), c, d \in \mathbb{R}, i \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}content}(k, p, c) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}content}(k, q, d))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{monalg\text{-}add}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{nn\text{-}add\text{-}monoid}, p, q)(i)) \leq \operatorname{max}(c, d) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.47}
\begin{prop}[{Neumann series in a complete NV domain}]\label{thm:ccr-1-47-neumann}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-1-47-neumann}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}u1}(k, a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in a. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(x, y) = \operatorname{one}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{sum\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{ring\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad (\lambda b \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), \operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{one}(k), \operatorname{neg}(k)(x)), b)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad n)), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad y) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-1-47-unit}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}u1}(k, a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow (x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-1-47-subgroup}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complete\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}u1}(k, a) \subseteq \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{one}(k) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}u1}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}u1}(k, a).\; (\operatorname{mul}(k)(x, y) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}u1}(k, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}u1}(k, a).\; \exists y \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}u1}(k, a).\; (\operatorname{mul}(k)(x, y) = \operatorname{one}(k)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-compact-one-minus-unit}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall x \in a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) < 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(k)(\operatorname{one}(k), \operatorname{neg}(k)(x)) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} A complete NV domain is IS-COMPLETE-NV-DOMAIN(K, A): IS-NV-DOMAIN plus IS-COMPLETE of SUBSPACE-MS(NF-METRIC-SPACE K, A). U1(A) is NV-U1(K, A) = \{x in A : |x - 1| $<$ 1\}. The series is read as the sum over k of (1 - x)\textasciicircum{}k (sign of the notes' series (17) corrected). Partial sums are SUM-AG over RING-ADDITIVE-AG of the commutative-ring view; convergence is CONVERGES-TO in NF-METRIC-SPACE(K). ccr-1-47-neumann: the inverse lies in A and the series converges to it; ccr-1-47-unit: x in NV-UNITS(K, A); ccr-1-47-subgroup: U1 is a subset of NV-UNITS(K, A), contains 1, is closed under products and inverses. nv-compact-one-minus-unit is the earlier compact-domain form. Proven 2026-11-09 (CCR-1109-A2).

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.1}
\begin{prop}[{Closed balls of a locally compact NV field}]\label{thm:nv-closed-balls-compact}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall a \in \mathbb{R}, b \in \operatorname{carr}(k), c \in \mathbb{R}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{zero}(k), a))) \wedge \\ \quad 0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(b) < 1 \wedge \\ \quad 0 < c \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{closed\text{-}ball}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{zero}(k), c))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%

\end{cor}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.6}
\begin{prop}[{Maximal ideal of a compact NV domain}]\label{thm:nv-maximal-ideal}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-maximal-ideal}}
\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}ideal}(k, a, \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)))}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-maximal-proper}}
\vnbstmt{\forall k, a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow \neg (\operatorname{one}(k) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)))}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-compact-proper-in-maximal}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, i.; \forall x \in i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}ideal}(k, a, i) \wedge \neg (\operatorname{one}(k) \in i))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-compact-maximal-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}ideal}(k, a, \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{one}(k) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall i. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}ideal}(k, a, i) \wedge \neg (\operatorname{one}(k) \in i)) \Rightarrow (i \subseteq \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\begin{prop}[{Units act transitively on generators}]\label{thm:nv-pid-maximal-generator}
%

\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-pid-maximal-generator}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}pid}(k, a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in a.\; (\operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, p)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-compact-units-transitive}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall p, y \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(y) = \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a).\; (y = \operatorname{mul}(k)(u, p)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\end{prop}

\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-residue-fp-iso}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, k, a, o. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad o \in (\mathbb{Z} \to a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m, n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad (o((m + n)) = \operatorname{add}(k)(o(m), o(n))) \wedge (o((m \cdot n)) = \operatorname{mul}(k)(o(m), o(n))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{Z}.\; (o(-m) = \operatorname{neg}(k)(o(m))) \wedge \\ \quad o(0) = \operatorname{zero}(k) \wedge \\ \quad o(1) = \operatorname{one}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m \in \mathbb{Z}.\; ((o(m) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{zz\text{-}divides}(p, m)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall b \in a. \exists m \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{add}(k)(b, \operatorname{neg}(k)(o(m))) \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}ring\text{-}iso}(\operatorname{fp}(p), \operatorname{nv\text{-}residue}(k, a), f) \end{array}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.7}
\begin{prop}[{Factorisation in a compact NV PID}]\label{thm:nv-uniformizer-factorization}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-uniformizer-factorization}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall l \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (l = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a). \\ \quad \quad \quad l = \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, e), u) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-uniformizer-factorization-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall b, c \in \mathbb{N}, u, v \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, b), u) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, c), v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (b = c) \wedge (u = v) \end{array}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.8}
\begin{prop}[{Factorisation in a local NV field}]\label{thm:ccr-4-8}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-4-8}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \mathbb{Z}, u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a).\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, e), u)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-4-8-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall b, l \in \mathbb{Z}, u, v \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, b), u) = \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, l), v) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (b = l) \wedge (u = v) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-local-factorization}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists e \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a). \\ \quad \quad \quad x = \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, e), u) \vee \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(x, \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, e)) = u \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.10}
\begin{prop}[{Elements of Qp as u p\textasciicircum{}k}]\label{thm:ccr-4-10}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-4-10}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{Z}, u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad x = \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(u, \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall k, l \in \mathbb{Z}, u, v \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(u, \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k)) = \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(v, \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, l))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (k = l) \wedge (u = v) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{qo-ppow-inverse}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, k), \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, -k)) = \operatorname{one}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-unit-iff-norm-one}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall u \in \operatorname{carr}(k). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow ((u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k))) \Leftrightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(u) = 1)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.12}
\begin{prop}[{Modules in a local NV field are principal}]\label{thm:nv-local-module-principal}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-local-module-principal}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(k, a, e) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (e = \operatorname{carr}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; (e = \operatorname{nv\text{-}multiples}(k, a, g)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-local-module-in-multiple}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, e.; \forall b \in \operatorname{carr}(k), y \in e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(k, a, e) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b \in e) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists t \in a.\; (y = \operatorname{mul}(k)(t, \operatorname{mul}(k)(b, w))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-multiples-unfold}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{nv\text{-}multiples}(k, a, g) \simeq \{x \in \operatorname{carr}(k) : \exists m \in a.\; (x = \operatorname{mul}(k)(m, g))\}) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%
\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{nv-local-module-principal}}}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.13}
\begin{cor}[{Open subgroups of Qp}]\label{thm:ccr-4-13}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-4-13}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, u. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), u) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), u) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (u = \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p), u) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)).\; (u = \operatorname{nv\text{-}multiples}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p), g)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{qo-open-subgroup-module}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}subgroup}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), u) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), u))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p), u) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{qp-maximal-principal}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p)) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), \operatorname{zp}(p), \operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(p)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-local-module-principal}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, e. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}module}(k, a, e) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (e = \operatorname{carr}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists g \in \operatorname{carr}(k).\; (e = \operatorname{nv\text{-}multiples}(k, a, g)) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.16}
\begin{prop}[{Order via uniformizer}]\label{thm:nv-order-nonneg}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-order-nonneg}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall e \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a), j \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, e), u) \\ \quad \quad \in\; \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, j)) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; j \leq e \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-order-negative}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(k), e \in \mathbb{N}, u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a), b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(x, \operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, e)) = u \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{mul}(k)(\operatorname{ring\text{-}power}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), w, b), x) \in a) \Leftrightarrow (e \leq b) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.19}
\begin{prop}[{p-adic expansion}]\label{thm:ccr-4-19}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-4-19}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a.; \exists n \in \mathbb{Z}.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, a, n, x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall a.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, b.; \forall m, k \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, a, n, x) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, b, m, x)) \Rightarrow (a(k) = b(k)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{qe-abs-convergent}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall a \in (\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{Z}), n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{series\text{-}converges}((\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(a((n + j))), \operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, (n + j)))))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-4-18-qp}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, a.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, x. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, a, n, x) \wedge \neg (a(n) = 0))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{qp\text{-}abs}(p)(x) = {2}^{-n} \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{qe-expansion-exists}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), n \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{mul}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))(\operatorname{qp\text{-}ppow}(p, -n), x) \in \operatorname{zp}(p))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a.\; \operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, a, n, x) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{qe-unique-le}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, a.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, b.; \forall m \in \mathbb{Z}, x.; \forall k \in \mathbb{Z}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, a, n, x) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}qp\text{-}expansion}(p, b, m, x) \wedge (n \leq m)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a(k) = b(k) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\vnbprf{\vnbproofpart{\texttt{ccr-4-19}}}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.4}
\begin{rem}[{Uniformizers differ by a unit}]\label{thm:ccr-remark-4-4}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-remark-4-4}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall w, b \in a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a).\; (b = \operatorname{mul}(k)(u, w)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-remark-4-4-unit}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall w \in a, u \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}units}(k, a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge ((\operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w)) \wedge \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mul}(k)(u, w) \in a \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, \operatorname{mul}(k)(u, w)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{mul}(k)(u, w) = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-remark-4-4-norm}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a.; \forall w \in a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge ((\operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w)) \wedge \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (w \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) < 1) \end{array}}
%
\end{rem}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.21}
\begin{prop}[{B(K) is a closed subfield with compact integers}]\label{thm:ccr-4-21-base}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-4-21-base}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact}(\operatorname{subspace\text{-}ms}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), (\operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \cap \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w)))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-4-21-base-char-p}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall w \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k), p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k), w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}characteristic}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad (w \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w)) \wedge ((0 < \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w)) \wedge (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w) < 1)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-base-subfield}}
\vnbstmt{\forall k, w.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}nf\text{-}subfield}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w)))}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-base-closed}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, w. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(k), \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-base-char-p}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall w \in \operatorname{carr}(k), p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(k) \wedge \operatorname{has\text{-}characteristic}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad w \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-base-char-0}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{4.23}
\begin{prop}[{w is a uniformizer of B(K) in characteristic p}]\label{thm:ccr-4-23-base-char-p}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k.; \forall w \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k), p. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k)) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k), w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{has\text{-}characteristic}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}as\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(k), p) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad w \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{nv\text{-}base}(k, w). \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) < 1) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(w)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
