\begin{rem}[{The leading digit fixes the absolute value}]\label{thm:ccr-remark-4-18}
%
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall k, a, w, p.; \forall n \in \mathbb{Z}, b, x. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}nv\text{-}domain}(k, a) \wedge \\ \quad w \in a \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{nv\text{-}maximal}(k, a) = \operatorname{nv\text{-}principal}(k, a, w) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (w = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \wedge \\ \quad a = \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}rep\text{-}set}(k, a, p) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}expansion}(k, w, p, b, n, x) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b(n) = \operatorname{zero}(k)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(x) = \operatorname{fnrm}(k)(\operatorname{nv\text{-}zpow}(k, w, n)) \end{array}}
%
\end{rem}

\begin{prop}[{Dual map Psi\_chi}]\label{thm:ccr-5-12-character}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-5-12-character}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, \operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, a)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-5-12-injective}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge (\operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, a) = \operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, b)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-5-12-continuous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(f)), a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), q, a))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{char\text{-}converges}(f, (\lambda k \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, q(k))), \operatorname{duality\text{-}map}(f, i, a)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.15}
\begin{lem}[{Lemma toward self-duality}]\label{thm:ccr-5-15-core}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-5-15-core}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall b, a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (b = \operatorname{zero}(f)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; ((\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(c) \leq 1) \Rightarrow (i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(b, c)) = 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(a) \leq \operatorname{fnrm}(f)(b) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad i(a) = 1 \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-5-15-bounded}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(f)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(a) \leq 1) \Rightarrow (i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(q(k), a)) = i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(q(0), a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \mathbb{R}.\; ((0 < b) \wedge \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(q(k)) \leq b)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-5-15}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, w, i.; \forall q \in (\mathbb{N} \to \operatorname{carr}(f)). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, w) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad (\operatorname{fnrm}(f)(a) \leq 1) \Rightarrow (i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(q(k), a)) = i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(q(0), a))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists b. \\ \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{strictly\text{-}mono\text{-}nn}(b) \wedge \exists l \in \operatorname{carr}(f).\; \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(f), \operatorname{subseq}(q, b), l)) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}

%

\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-5-23}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}separating\text{-}character}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p), l)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p)) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad b(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))), \operatorname{zp}(p)), x)) = l(x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c, d \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad b(\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p))(c, d)) = (b(c) \cdot b(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c, d \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (b(c) = b(d)) \Rightarrow (c = d) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{nv-separating-factor}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, l. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}nv\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}separating\text{-}character}(f, l)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in (\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(f), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f))) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}). \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad b(\operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(f)), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f)), x)) = l(x) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c, d \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(f), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad b(\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(f), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f)))(c, d)) = (b(c) \cdot b(d)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c, d \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{quotient\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(f), \operatorname{nv\text{-}integers}(f))). \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (b(c) = b(d)) \Rightarrow (c = d) \end{array}}

\begin{prop}[{Order of Lambda(x)}]\label{thm:ccr-5-24}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-5-24}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad (x \in \operatorname{zp}(p)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))), \operatorname{zp}(p)), x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad 1) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (x \in \operatorname{zp}(p)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad -\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x) \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))), \operatorname{zp}(p)), x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{power}(p, -\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{qp-pruefer-order}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall x \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p)), n \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \wedge (\neg (x = \operatorname{zero}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))) \wedge (-\operatorname{qp\text{-}ord}(p)(x) = n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}element\text{-}order}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{ag\text{-}zz\text{-}module}(\operatorname{normed\text{-}field\text{-}additive\text{-}ag}(\operatorname{qp\text{-}field}(p))), \operatorname{zp}(p)), x), \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{power}(p, n)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.25}
\begin{cor}[{Prufer group as roots of unity}]\label{thm:ccr-5-25}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-5-25}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p. \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists f \in \mathrm{Bij}(\operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p)), \operatorname{mu\text{-}pinf}(p)). \forall c, d \in \operatorname{carr}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p)). \\ \quad \quad \quad f(\operatorname{opr}(\operatorname{pruefer}(p))(c, d)) = (f(c) \cdot f(d)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{qp-lambda-onto-roots}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall p.; \forall w \in \operatorname{mu\text{-}pinf}(p). \\ \quad \operatorname{zz\text{-}prime}(p) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists r \in \mathbb{Q}.\; (\operatorname{qp\text{-}lambda}(p)(\operatorname{embed}(\operatorname{nf\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(\operatorname{qq\text{-}padic}(p)))(r)) = w) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{hom-cc-gpow}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall n \in \mathbb{N}, q, b.; \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(q). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}group}(q) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c \in \operatorname{carr}(q).\; (b(c) \in \mathbb{C}) \wedge \\ \quad b(\operatorname{iden}(q)) = 1 \wedge \\ \quad \forall c, d \in \operatorname{carr}(q).\; (b(\operatorname{opr}(q)(c, d)) = (b(c) \cdot b(d))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad b(\operatorname{gpow}(q, c, n)) = \operatorname{power}(b(c), n) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{6.3}
\begin{lem}[{Bilinear bicharacters of K+}]\label{thm:ccr-6-3-bicharacter}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-6-3-bicharacter}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \forall x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, a)(x, y) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, a)(y, x) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ch-bichar-value}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall a, x, y \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, a)(x, y) = i(\operatorname{mul}(f)(a, \operatorname{mul}(f)(x, y))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ch-bichar-type}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}add\text{-}character}(f, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, a) \in ((\operatorname{carr}(f) \times \operatorname{carr}(f)) \to \operatorname{unit\text{-}circle}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-6-3-converse}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}dualizing\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, w))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists a \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \forall x, b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad w(x, b) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, a)(x, b) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-6-3-converse-local}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, a, i, w. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}local\text{-}uniformizer}(f, a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}bilinear\text{-}bicharacter}(f, w))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \forall x, c \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \quad w(x, c) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, b)(x, c) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{ccr-6-3-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall f, i.; \forall a, b \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}normed\text{-}field}(f) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nontrivial\text{-}character}(f, i) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x, c \in \operatorname{carr}(f). \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, a)(x, c) = \operatorname{bichar\text{-}of}(f, i, b)(x, c) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a = b \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{8.3}
\begin{lem}[{Elementary matrices act by shifting columns}]\label{thm:col-equiv-elem}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{col-equiv-elem}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, a, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}elementary}(r, n, e))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, e)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-f-action}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n, p, k, l.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m), c \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(a, p, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(a, n, k, l)), i, c) \\ \quad \quad =\; \left(\text{if }(c = k)\text{ then }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, l)\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(c = l)\text{ then }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, k)\text{ else }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, c)\right)\right) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-f-ck-at}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n, k, l, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge (c = k))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(a, n, k, l), l, c) = \operatorname{one}(a) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-f-cl-at}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, n, k, l, c. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge ((c \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n)) \wedge (c = l))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(a, n, k, l), k, c) = \operatorname{one}(a) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%
\begin{proof}

\begin{prop}[{Elementary column operations as right multiplication}]\label{thm:ccr-8.5}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{col-equiv-elem}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, a, e. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge ((m \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge ((a \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r))) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}elementary}(r, n, e))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{col\text{-}equiv}(r, n, a, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, e)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{elem-f-action}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m, n, p, k, l.; \forall i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m), c \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{matmul}(a, p, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(a, n, k, l)), i, c) \\ \quad \quad =\; \left(\text{if }(c = k)\text{ then }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, l)\text{ else }\left(\text{if }(c = l)\text{ then }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, k)\text{ else }\operatorname{entry}(p, i, c)\right)\right) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{det-mul-elem-f-col}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, n, a, k, l. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad a \in \operatorname{mat}(n, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad k \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad l \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (k = l) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{matmul}(r, a, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(r, n, k, l))) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{det}(r, n, a), \operatorname{det}(r, n, \operatorname{elem\text{-}f}(r, n, k, l))) \end{array}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{8.8}
\begin{lem}[{Pivot clearing over a field}]\label{thm:smith-pivot-cross-minimal}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{smith-pivot-cross-minimal}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, p, q, m. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}((p + 1), (q + 1), \operatorname{carr}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \exists b \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (p + 1)), d \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (q + 1)). \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(m, b, d) = \operatorname{zero}(a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists f. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(a, (p + 1), (q + 1), m, f) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad f = \operatorname{border}(a, \operatorname{entry}(f, 1, 1), \operatorname{submat}(f, p, q), p, q) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(f, 1, 1) = \operatorname{zero}(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall c, i, j. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(a, (p + 1), (q + 1), f, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (p + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (q + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(c, i, j) = \operatorname{zero}(a)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{gauge}(a)(\operatorname{entry}(f, 1, 1)) \leq \operatorname{gauge}(a)(\operatorname{entry}(c, i, j)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{smith-pivot-divides-block}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, p, q, m, i, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad p \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad q \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad m \in \operatorname{mat}((p + 1), (q + 1), \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad m = \operatorname{border}(r, \operatorname{entry}(m, 1, 1), \operatorname{submat}(m, p, q), p, q) \wedge \\ \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(m, 1, 1) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall c, a, b. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(r, (p + 1), (q + 1), m, c) \wedge \\ \quad \quad a \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (p + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad b \in \operatorname{interval}(1, (q + 1)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \neg (\operatorname{entry}(c, a, b) = \operatorname{zero}(r)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{gauge}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(m, 1, 1)) \leq \operatorname{gauge}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(c, a, b)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, p) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, q) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r). \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{entry}(\operatorname{submat}(m, p, q), i, j) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(\operatorname{entry}(m, 1, 1), y) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.

%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{smith-diagonalization}}

\vnbpart{\texttt{smith-normal-form}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall k \in \mathbb{N}, n, p. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(a) \wedge ((n \in \mathbb{N}) \wedge (p \in \operatorname{mat}(k, n, \operatorname{carr}(a))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists d \in \operatorname{mat}(k, n, \operatorname{carr}(a)), b \in \mathbb{N}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(a, k, n, p, d) \wedge \operatorname{smith\text{-}staircase}(a, k, n, d, b) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{smith-equiv-divisor}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall r, m, n, p, e, c, i, j. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}euclidean\text{-}ring}(r) \wedge \\ \quad m \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad n \in \mathbb{N} \wedge \\ \quad p \in \operatorname{mat}(m, n, \operatorname{carr}(r)) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{mat\text{-}equiv}(r, m, n, p, e) \wedge \\ \quad c \in \operatorname{carr}(r) \wedge \\ \quad \forall \mathit{dvi}, \mathit{dvj}. \\ \quad \quad ((\mathit{dvi} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m)) \wedge (\mathit{dvj} \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{entry}(p, \mathit{dvi}, \mathit{dvj}) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{interval}(1, m) \wedge \\ \quad j \in \operatorname{interval}(1, n) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists y \in \operatorname{carr}(r).\; (\operatorname{entry}(e, i, j) = \operatorname{mul}(r)(c, y)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.1}
\begin{prop}[{Adjunction of a unit to a normed algebra}]\label{thm:unitization-is-complex-normed-algebra}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{unitization-is-complex-normed-algebra}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}na}(a)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{unitization-unit-left}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall u \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)([1, \operatorname{vzero}(a)], u) = u) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{unitization-unit-right}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall u \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)(u, [1, \operatorname{vzero}(a)]) = u) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{unitization-norm-unit}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)([1, \operatorname{vzero}(a)]) = 1) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{unitization-vnrm-submult}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)(u, v)) \leq (\operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)(u) \cdot \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)(v)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{unitization-vnrm-definite}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall u \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow ((\operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)(u) = 0) \Leftrightarrow (u = [0, \operatorname{vzero}(a)])) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{unitization-vnrm-homog}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c \in \mathbb{C}, u \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{unit\text{-}act}(a)(c, u)) = (\operatorname{magnitude}(c) \cdot \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)(u)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{unitization-vnrm-triangle}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall u, v \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{unit\text{-}vadd}(a)(u, v)) \leq (\operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)(u) + \operatorname{unit\text{-}vnrm}(a)(v)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{unitization-vmul-assoc}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall u, v, w \in \operatorname{unit\text{-}vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}normed\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)(\operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)(u, v), w) = \operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)(u, \operatorname{unit\text{-}vmul}(a)(v, w)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.3}
\begin{prop}[{Neumann series: 1 - x invertible for ||x|| $<$ 1}]\label{thm:neumann-series}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{neumann-series}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) < 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(x))) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), (\lambda j \in \mathbb{N}.\; \sum_{k < j} {x}^{k}), \\ \quad \quad \quad {\operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(x))}^{-1}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{neumann-series-bound}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) < 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)({\operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(x))}^{-1}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, x)))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \cdot \operatorname{recip}((1 - \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{neumann-inverse-norm-bound}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) < 1)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)({\operatorname{vadd}(a)(1_{a}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(x))}^{-1}) \leq \operatorname{recip}((1 - \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.4}
\begin{cor}[{The invertible elements form an open set}]\label{thm:invertibles-open}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{invertibles-open}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}open}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \operatorname{invertibles}(a)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{invertible-near-invertible}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, b) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(b, \operatorname{vneg}(a)(x))) < \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{vnrm}(a)({b}^{-1})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, x) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.6}
\begin{prop}[{The resolvent is analytic off the spectrum}]\label{thm:resolvent-derivative}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{resolvent-derivative}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), u \in \mathbb{C}, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((z + -u)) \leq l) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)}^{-1}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x)}^{-1})), \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vneg}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)((u + -z), \cdot_{a}({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x)}^{-1}, {\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x)}^{-1}))))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; s \cdot \operatorname{magnitude}((z + -u)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{resolvent-continuous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), u \in \mathbb{C}, s. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x)) \wedge \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists l. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(l) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \forall z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad (\operatorname{magnitude}((z + -u)) \leq l) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)}^{-1}, \operatorname{vneg}(a)({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, u, x)}^{-1}))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \quad \quad \leq\; s \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{resolvent-laurent}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) < \operatorname{magnitude}(z))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; \operatorname{act}(a)(\operatorname{recip}(z), \sum_{k < n} {\operatorname{act}(a)(\operatorname{recip}(z), x)}^{k})), \\ \quad \quad \quad {\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)}^{-1}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{resolvent-norm-bound}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge ((0 < \operatorname{magnitude}(z)) \wedge ((2 \cdot \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(z)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, \operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)) \wedge \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(a)({\operatorname{shift\text{-}el}(a, z, x)}^{-1}) \leq (2 \cdot \operatorname{recip}(\operatorname{magnitude}(z))) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{spectrum-in-closed-ball}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z \in \sigma({x}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} Analyticity is norm differentiability, stated as an eps-delta remainder estimate: for u off sigma(x), z near u is off sigma(x) and ||F(z) - F(u) - (u - z) F(u)\textasciicircum{}2|| $<$= eps |z - u|, i.e. F'(u) = -F(u)\textasciicircum{}2; the tree has no vocabulary for holomorphy of an algebra-valued map. The Laurent series is stated as F(z) = lim\_n z\textasciicircum{}(-1) sum\_(k$<$n) (z\textasciicircum{}(-1) x)\textasciicircum{}k for |z| $>$ ||x||; absolute convergence of sum z\textasciicircum{}(-(k+1)) x\textasciicircum{}k is not stated. The inclusion sigma(x) in B(0, ||x||) is spectrum-in-closed-ball. Also proven: ||F(z)|| $<$= 2 / |z| when |z| $>$= 2 ||x|| and |z| $>$ 0.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.7}
\begin{lem}[{||a\textasciicircum{}n||\textasciicircum{}(1/n) converges (Fekete)}]\label{thm:spectral-radius-limit}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{spectral-radius-limit}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, \\ \quad \quad \quad (\lambda n \in \mathbb{N}.\; {\operatorname{vnrm}(a)({x}^{(n + 1)})}^{{(n + 1)}^{\ast\!-1}}), \\ \quad \quad \quad \rho({x})) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{fekete-lemma}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall l \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}), v \in \mathbb{R}, g \in (\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}). \\ \quad \forall a \in \mathbb{N}.\; (0 \leq l(a)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall m, a \in \mathbb{N}.\; (((1 \leq m) \wedge (1 \leq a)) \Rightarrow (l((m + a)) \leq (l(m) \cdot l(a)))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq k) \Rightarrow (v \leq {l(k)}^{{k}^{\ast\!-1}})) \wedge \\ \quad \forall s. \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{pos\text{-}rr}(s) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \quad \exists k \in \mathbb{N}.\; ((1 \leq k) \wedge ({l(k)}^{{k}^{\ast\!-1}} < (v + s))) \wedge \\ \quad \forall n \in \mathbb{N}.\; (g(n) = {l((n + 1))}^{{(n + 1)}^{\ast\!-1}}) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{converges\text{-}to}(\operatorname{rr\text{-}ms}, g, v) \end{array}}
%
\end{lem}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%

%

%

\noindent\textbf{Deviation from the notes.} Stated for a Banach algebra with unit; the sequence is indexed from 1 (n |-$>$ ||x\textasciicircum{}(n+1)||\textasciicircum{}(1/(n+1))) and its limit is SPECTRAL-RADIUS(a, x) = inf\_(n $>$= 1) ||x\textasciicircum{}n||\textasciicircum{}(1/n). fekete-lemma (library analysis) is the statement for a nonnegative submultiplicative real sequence, the limit characterised as the greatest lower bound of the roots.

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.8}
\begin{prop}[{The spectrum lies in the disc of radius rho(a)}]\label{thm:spectrum-in-spectral-radius-disc}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{spectrum-in-spectral-radius-disc}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), z \in \sigma({x}). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq \rho({x})) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{spectral-radius-limit}}

\vnbpart{\texttt{gelfand-spectral-radius-max}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \sigma({x}). \\ \quad \quad \quad ((\operatorname{magnitude}(b) = \rho({x})) \wedge \forall z \in \sigma({x}).\; (\operatorname{magnitude}(z) \leq \operatorname{magnitude}(b))) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.10}
\begin{thm}[{Gelfand-Mazur}]\label{thm:gelfand-mazur}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{gelfand-mazur}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\neg (y = \operatorname{vzero}(a)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, y)) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (x = \operatorname{act}(a)(z, 1_{a})) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{gelfand-mazur-from-nonempty-spectrum}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \forall y \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; (\neg (y = \operatorname{vzero}(a)) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}(a, y)) \wedge \\ \quad \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; \exists z.\; (z \in \sigma({x})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \mathbb{C}.\; (x = \operatorname{act}(a)(z, 1_{a})) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{scalar-embedding-injective}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall z, w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{act}(a)(z, 1_{a}) = \operatorname{act}(a)(w, 1_{a}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad z = w \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.11}
\begin{cor}[{A / M is C for a maximal ideal M}]\label{thm:maximal-quotient-field}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{maximal-quotient-field}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall c \in \operatorname{vec}({a}/{i}). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge \neg (c = \operatorname{vzero}({a}/{i})))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}invertible\text{-}el}({a}/{i}, c) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{maximal-quotient-scalar}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists z \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \quad \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), x) \\ \quad \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \operatorname{act}(a)(z, 1_{a})) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{maximal-quotient-scalar-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i.; \forall z, w \in \mathbb{C}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, i) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \operatorname{act}(a)(z, 1_{a})) \\ \quad =\; \operatorname{class}(\operatorname{qmod\text{-}setoid}(\operatorname{uba\text{-}as\text{-}module}(a), i), \operatorname{act}(a)(w, 1_{a})) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad z = w \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{maximal-ideal-character}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, i)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists b \in \operatorname{characters}(a).\; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; ((b(x) = 0) \Leftrightarrow (x \in i)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{commutative-maximal-ideal-closed}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, m. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}maximal\text{-}ideal}(a, m)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ba\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(a), m) \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}
%
\begin{proof}
%
The proofs: the file that holds each, the lemmas it cites, its oracles and its bill.

\begin{prop}[{The characters form a weak* closed set}]\label{thm:characters-closed-in-product}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}top\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{tproduct\text{-}top}(\operatorname{vec}(a), (\lambda x \in \operatorname{vec}(a).\; \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}))), \operatorname{characters}(a)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{gelfand-space-compact}}
\vnbstmt{\forall a.\; (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}compact\text{-}t}(\widehat{a}))}
%
\end{prop}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.15}
\begin{prop}[{The Gelfand transform is a homomorphism of norm 1}]\label{thm:gelfand-transform-mul}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{gelfand-transform-mul}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a), c \in \operatorname{characters}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(\cdot_{a}(x, y))(c) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(x)(c) \cdot \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(y)(c) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{gelfand-transform-add}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x, y \in \operatorname{vec}(a), c \in \operatorname{characters}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(\operatorname{vadd}(a)(x, y))(c) \\ \quad \quad =\; \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(x)(c) + \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(y)(c) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{gelfand-transform-act}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall z \in \mathbb{C}, x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), c \in \operatorname{characters}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(\operatorname{act}(a)(z, x))(c) = (z \cdot \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(x)(c)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{gelfand-transform-one}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall c \in \operatorname{characters}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow (\operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(1_{a})(c) = 1) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{gelfand-transform-bounded}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a), c \in \operatorname{characters}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{magnitude}(\operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(x)(c)) \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{gelfand-transform-continuous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(\widehat{a}, \operatorname{metric\text{-}top}(\operatorname{cc\text{-}ms}), \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(x)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{gelfand-transform-in-ccont}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(x) \in C({\widehat{a}}) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%
\begin{proof}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.16}
\begin{prop}[{The range of G(a) is the spectrum; ||G(a)||sup = rho(a)}]\label{thm:gelfand-range-spectrum}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{gelfand-range-spectrum}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \sigma({x}) = \operatorname{image}(\operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(x), \operatorname{characters}(a)) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{gelfand-sup-spectral-radius}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}commutative\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \lVert \operatorname{gelfand\text{-}transform}(a)(x) \rVert_{\infty} = \rho({x}) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
%

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.18}
\begin{prop}[{The unitization of an involutive algebra is involutive}]\label{thm:unitization-is-involutive-banach-algebra}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{unitization-is-involutive-banach-algebra}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}nu\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(a) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}involutive\text{-}banach\text{-}algebra}(\operatorname{unitization\text{-}star}(a)) \end{array}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.24}
\begin{cor}[{Unital *-homomorphisms of C*-algebras have norm 1}]\label{thm:cstar-hom-contractive}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{cstar-hom-contractive}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f.; \forall x \in \operatorname{vec}(a). \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}c\text{-}star\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}c\text{-}star\text{-}algebra}(b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}hom}(a, b, f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(b)(f(x)) \leq \operatorname{vnrm}(a)(x) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{cstar-hom-norm-one}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall a, b, f. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}c\text{-}star\text{-}algebra}(a) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}unital\text{-}c\text{-}star\text{-}algebra}(b) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}star\text{-}hom}(a, b, f))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vnrm}(b)(f(1_{a})) = 1 \end{array}}
%
\end{cor}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{1.53}
\begin{thm}[{Orthogonal projection}]\label{thm:minimizer-orthogonal}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{minimizer-orthogonal}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a \in k \wedge \\ \quad \forall p \in k. \\ \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(a, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \\ \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(i, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a)) \in {k}^{\perp} \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{orthogonal-point-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i, a_{1}, a_{2}. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad i \in \operatorname{vec}(v) \wedge \\ \quad a_{1} \in k \wedge \\ \quad a_{2} \in k \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(i, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a_{1})) \in {k}^{\perp} \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{vadd}(v)(i, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(a_{2})) \in {k}^{\perp} \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad a_{1} = a_{2} \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{proj-op-is-orthogonal-projection}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, E_{k}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{proj-op-unique}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, a. \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge \\ \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}orthogonal\text{-}projection}(v, k, a) \Rightarrow \\ \quad \quad E_{k} = a \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{proj-op-linear}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}op}(v, v, E_{k}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{hilbert-closest-point}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, k, i. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}submodule}(v, k) \wedge (\operatorname{is\text{-}closed}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), k) \wedge (i \in \operatorname{vec}(v))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \exists p \in k. \forall \mathit{hdp} \in k. \\ \quad \quad \quad \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(p, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \\ \quad \quad \quad \leq\; \langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(\operatorname{vadd}(v)(\mathit{hdp}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i)), \operatorname{vadd}(v)(\mathit{hdp}, \operatorname{vneg}(v)(i))) \end{array}}
%
\end{thm}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{2.1}
\begin{prop}[{Four characterizations of a partial isometry}]\label{thm:partial-isometry-iff-adjoint-square-projection}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{partial-isometry-iff-adjoint-square-projection}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (u \in L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}projection\text{-}op}(v, {{u}^{*}}{u}) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}partial\text{-}isometry}(v, u) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{adjoint-square-projection-iff}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (u \in L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}projection\text{-}op}(v, {{u}^{*}}{u}) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{is\text{-}projection\text{-}op}(v, {u}{{u}^{*}}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{adjoint-partial-isometry-iff}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, u. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge (u \in L({v}, {v}))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}projection\text{-}op}(v, {u}{{u}^{*}}) \\ \quad \quad \Leftrightarrow\; \operatorname{is\text{-}partial\text{-}isometry}(v, {u}^{*}) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}graph}(v, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}functional\text{-}graph}(v, {g}^{*}) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}dense}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), \mathrm{dom}\,{g}) \end{array}}

\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, g. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}hilbert\text{-}space}(v) \wedge \operatorname{is\text{-}linear\text{-}graph}(v, g)) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}closable\text{-}graph}(v, g) \Leftrightarrow \operatorname{is\text{-}dense}(\operatorname{ip\text{-}metric\text{-}space}(v), \mathrm{dom}\,{{g}^{*}}) \end{array}}

\renewcommand{\thethm}{5.6}
\begin{prop}[{WOT is the weak topology of the pairing with L.(H)}]\label{thm:vec-functional-wot-continuous}
%
\leavevmode
\vnbpart{\texttt{vec-functional-wot-continuous}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, i, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((i \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{is\text{-}hom\text{-}top\text{-}space}(L({v})_{w}, \operatorname{cc\text{-}sn\text{-}top}, \omega_{{i},{a}}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{vec-functional-in-weak-dual}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, i, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((i \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \omega_{{i},{a}} \in \operatorname{weak\text{-}dual}(v) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{vec-functional-in-strong-dual}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, i, a. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((i \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (a \in \operatorname{vec}(v)))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \omega_{{i},{a}} \in L_{\bullet}({v}) \end{array}}
\vnbpart{\texttt{wot-pf-apply-pair}}
\vnbstmt{\begin{array}{@{}l@{}} \forall v, x, y, t. \\ \quad (\operatorname{is\text{-}complex\text{-}inner\text{-}product\text{-}space}(v) \wedge ((x \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge ((y \in \operatorname{vec}(v)) \wedge (t \in L({v}, {v}))))) \Rightarrow  \\ \quad \quad \operatorname{wot\text{-}pf}(v)([x, y])(t) = \operatorname{magnitude}(\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_{v}(t(x), y)) \end{array}}
%
\end{prop}
